jobs.description:
Work Setup: Fully Remote Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, Pacific Standard Time Salary: $3,300 - $3,700 Role OverviewThe person in this role will own both the technical infrastructure and the client experience for a portfolio of customer accounts, many of whom are technologically sophisticated, cutting-edge software startups and security-conscious VC firms.

 Work Setup: Fully Remote

 Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, Pacific Standard Time

 Salary: $3,300 - $3,700

Role Overview

The person in this role will own both the technical infrastructure and the client experience for a portfolio of customer accounts, many of whom are technologically sophisticated, cutting-edge software startups and security-conscious VC firms. This role is also the senior technical authority that clients rely on, and they need to be someone a non-technical founder trusts as much as a technical CTO respects.

If you are the type who can diagnose a security incident, explain what happened to an operations manager in plain language, and leave that person feeling confident, not confused, then YOU belong here.

This Role IS:

- The face of our company to technologically sophisticated, security-conscious clients — you own relationships, not just tickets

- Equal parts technical problem-solving and warm, clear client communication

- A Mac-first, Google Workspace-first, SaaS-security environment

- Autonomy with accountability — startup clients expect fast, independent judgment

This Role IS NOT:

- A backend NOC or infrastructure role where you work silently behind the scenes

- A pure engineering role — if you prefer zero client contact, this is not the right fit

- A Windows Server / Active Directory / on-prem data center environment

- A role with heavy supervision and rigid escalation paths

Responsibilities:

Technical Delivery

- Own the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of our security tool stack (SentinelOne, Okta, Entra ID, Cynomi, KnowBe4, etc.) across client environments.

- Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for escalated issues across Mac workstations, networks, Google Workspace, and SaaS platforms.

- Troubleshoot and resolve incidents independently with clear, client-readable documentation.

- Lead technical projects: migrations, security tool rollouts, network upgrades, compliance implementations.

- Develop process automation to reduce repetitive manual work (not infrastructure-as-code; think workflow efficiency).

- Own recurring technical issues and implement long-term root-cause fixes.

- Support monitoring, patching (including CVE remediation alerting), and incident response workflows.

- Evaluate new platforms to determine their suitability as part of our tool stack.

- Perform system updates, backups, and security audits.

Client Experience

- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned client accounts. You own the relationship, not just the ticket queue.

- Translate complex technical concepts into clear, confident language for non-technical stakeholders (startup founders, ops managers, office managers).

- Lead client-facing project presentations: scoping, status updates, and post-implementation reviews.

- Collaborate with Tier 1 and Tier 2 team members to share knowledge and elevate the team's client communication standards.

- Bridge the gap between subject matter experts and end-users – ensure that SOPs, documentation, and client-facing instructions are user-friendly and accessible.

- Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and proactively communicate them to clients and internal leadership.

- Contribute to and improve knowledge base documentation with a client-readability lens.

Required Qualifications

Technical Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, and security project implementation.

- Strong Mac/macOS support experience. Candidates without extensive Apple experience must obtain Apple Desktop Support certification within 90 days.

- Experience administering Google Workspace environments for distributed/remote teams.

- Strong cybersecurity literacy: hands-on experience with zero-trust SaaS security platforms (SentinelOne, Okta, Entra ID, Cisco Umbrella, KnowBe4, or equivalent).

- Solid networking fundamentals (VPNs, firewalls, routing), ideally supporting Cisco Meraki environments.

- Experience with endpoint management / MDM tools (Jamf, Intune, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading SaaS security implementation projects end-to-end: from scoping and proposal through deployment and client sign-off.

 Client-Facing Skills (Equally Weighted)

- Demonstrated experience as the primary point of contact for client accounts – not just an escalation resource, but the person the client calls first.

- Proven ability to explain technical issues to non-technical audiences in plain language and leave them feeling confident, not overwhelmed.

- Experience leading or co-leading client meetings, project kickoffs, and status reviews.

- High customer satisfaction scores or equivalent evidence of strong client relationships (references, testimonials, NPS).

- Comfort with ambiguity: startup clients often don't know what they need, and you help them figure it out.

Soft Skills

- Ownership mindset – if it's your account, it's your problem until it's solved.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision across multiple time zones.

- Continuous improvement orientation: you don't just fix the ticket, you fix the system that created the ticket.

- Strong written communication – client-facing emails and documentation should be clear, professional, and warm.

jobs.description:
About the RoleWe’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer, EMEA Channel to help drive NinjaOne’s expansion into the enterprise market.

About the Role

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer, EMEA Channel to help drive NinjaOne ’s expansion into the enterprise market. This is a builder role—your chance to shape how we engage complex accounts, scale technical wins, and define what great looks like in enterprise pre-sales. You’ll own the full technical sales cycle—from discovery and architecture through proof-of-concept and implementation—while partnering closely with AEs to influence deal strategy and deliver real-world impact. You won’t just run demos—you’ll build the playbooks, tools, and repeatable processes that help us scale. If you’ve done this before in B2B SaaS, thrive in high-stakes environments, and want your work to directly shape the next chapter of NinjaOne ’s growth, we’d love to hear from you.

 Location - Remote, anywhere in the UK
 Travel Requirements - ~50%, including strategic customer meetings, industry events, and team collaboration.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Own the full pre-sales technical experience for Enterprise Partners, Channel, MSPs, and Customers. This will include product demonstrations, architecture design, and key customer engagements to drive deal success

- Represent NinjaOne at enterprise-facing industry events, conferences, and customer forums.
Support the review and alignment of technical content within RFPs and RFIs without owning full proposal management

- Partner with Training and Customer Success teams to accelerate time-to-value and ensure long-term adoption success

- Serve as a strategic voice between Sales and Product—surfacing feedback, identifying feature gaps, and influencing roadmap direction

- Build and maintain reusable technical assets including lab environments, demo flows, battlecards, and scripts to support a scalable AE-to-SE model

- Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive growth and align technical value to business goals

- Help shape the future of the Enterprise SE function as a founding member of the team, contributing to playbooks, processes, and cross-functional alignment.

Technical Requirements

- Proficiency in Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting)

- Familiarity with Linux/macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting

- Strong understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and endpoint protections

- Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms and endpoint lifecycle management

- Scripting experience in PowerShell, Bash, and/or VBScript is preferred

- Comfortable navigating complex IT ecosystems and integrating with existing infrastructure

- Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Highspot, or equivalent systems is required.

About You

- 5+ years in a pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role supporting enterprise B2B SaaS customers

- Brings deep domain knowledge in enterprise IT operations, RMM, endpoint management, and ITSM-adjacent platforms

- Evolved from a technical background (e.g. TAM, Support, Systems engineer), with practical insight into IT operations at scale

- Strong communicator with executive presence—able to tailor messaging for admins, architects, and senior business stakeholders

- Understands how IT teams evaluate, implement, and scale solutions—along with insight into the limitations of legacy platforms and the shift toward unified, modern alternatives

- Known for high emotional intelligence, technical credibility, and a customer-first mindset

- Operates well in ambiguity and brings a builder’s mentality to scaling people, processes, and tools

- Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required

- Technical certifications (e.g. CISSP, Security+, cloud architecture) are a plus

- Fluent in English required. Additional fluent languages (German, French) are a plus.

About Us

 NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

 NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

Our flexible working hours with remote office options enable you to successfully balance your personal life and your job
You are insured through AXA Private Medical Insurance (PMI)
Enjoy a gym membership discount, access to EAP, Second Opinion Service, Working Body Service & Canada Life
Benefit from Group Income Protection WeCare (virtual services) & Lifeworks App (discounts and cashback)
Grow personally and professionally with one of the fastest growing companies
Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
Receive competitive compensation
Collaborate with a curious, kind, international and intercultural workforce

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.

jobs.description:
Job Description
What keeps the services behind a security company online, day after day, with almost no downtime? At ID-ware, it is the Platform Engineering team. They build and look after the cloud systems that colleagues and clients rely on every day.

As Senior Platform Engineer, you will lead the design, build and upkeep of our infrastructure on AWS and Azure using Terraform. You will keep it secure, reliable and scalable, and you will own solution architecture. You will work closely with the Platform team.

 What you will do

- Lead the design, build and maintenance of ID-ware and client infrastructure in the cloud, managed in Terraform

- Keep AWS and Azure infrastructure secure, reliable and scalable

- Work with the Platform team to find and fix infrastructure issues at the root cause

- Own solution architecture and respond to requests from colleagues who may have limited technical knowledge

- Support internal operations in Azure and Entra, and customer-facing applications that run mostly on AWS

- Take part in the on-call rotation for infrastructure that supports customer-facing applications

- Support internal security audits and client assessments

- Act on client feedback passed on by project managers, and contribute to new projects as directed by the Platform team manager

- Provide guidance and best practices for using cloud services

 What success looks like

- All AWS and Azure infrastructure is managed in Terraform, and is secure, stable and scalable

- Incidents are resolved quickly at the root cause, and on-call work is handled reliably

- Security audits and client assessments pass without major findings

- The Platform team works to clear, consistent standards that you set and share

- Project managers and colleagues see you as a credible technical partner

 Your profile
 Experience and education

- Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience

- 5+ years of experience in a similar role

- Fluent English

 Technical skills

- Experience designing solution architecture for cloud platforms

- Expert proficiency in Terraform, including using and implementing it

- Strong understanding of AWS and Azure services, and comfort working in both

- Expert knowledge of Linux and Unix systems

- Expert knowledge of identity and access management systems

- Experience with cloud security best practices

- Knowledge of how to make a product operationally ready

- Expert knowledge in troubleshooting and diagnosing platform issues

- Knowledge of databases

 Ways of working

- Clear and effective communicator, including with colleagues at all levels of the organisation

- Proactive and self-motivated, and comfortable pushing objectives forward

- Collaborative approach when working with the Platform team and project managers

- Security-conscious approach to design

- Patient and clear when explaining technical choices to colleagues with limited technical knowledge

 Nice to have

- AWS certification, for example AWS Solutions Architect or AWS DevOps Engineer

- Experience developing APIs using Node.js or Python

- Experience with Github Enterprise and Github Actions

- Working Knowledge of Jira Atlassian

- Knowledge of SQL Server

- Dutch language skills

 What do we offer?
You will join a growing, international company that is shaping the future of PIAM solutions, where Platform Engineering plays a key role in keeping the cloud infrastructure behind our services secure, reliable and available. At ID-ware you can expect a collaborative environment with room to learn from experienced colleagues, expand your responsibilities over time, and build a strong track record as a Senior Platform Engineer.

 What we offer in the Netherlands

- Being part of a fast-growing, international organization.

- Working in an open, supportive and inclusive environment.

- Opportunity to grow and develop with the company.

- 28 Holiday days.

- Pension from day one.

- Fietsplan : an opportunity to lease a bike through salary conversion.

 What is our hiring process?

- Recruiter screen

- Second interview with members of the Platform team (technical interview)

- Final interview in person with the hiring manager (technical) with a business case

jobs.description:
About Upsun (formerly Platform. sh) Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love.

 About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

- Predictable performance, even at scale

- Secure, compliant environments by default

- Real-time observability and profiling built in

- Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

- AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other.

 Impact of a Senior IT Systems Engineer

As a Senior IT Engineer, you help shape and improve the systems that our 250+ person remote company relies on every day. Your work spans identity and access, Google Workspace, device management, and our wider SaaS environment.
Reporting to the IT Director, you take ownership of complex problems and lead improvements from initial assessment through delivery. You identify what needs attention, recommend priorities, and make thoughtful decisions that balance security, reliability, and employee experience. You also help the team build stronger practices through clear documentation, shared knowledge, and practical guidance.

 What to expect

-
 Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward.

-
 Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs.

-
 Device management: Help lead the rollout and ongoing development of JumpCloud and our device management practices across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Define and implement device configurations, security policies, software deployment, and onboarding processes in partnership with IT Operations and Security.

-
 Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable.

-
 Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well.

-
 SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews.

-
 Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2.

-
 Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

 What you bring

-
 Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them.

-
 Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three.

-
 Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption.

-
 Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

-
 A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team.

-
 Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.

-
 Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable.

-
 Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective.

-
 Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years.

 Bonus points

-
Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including assessing and integrating identity systems, Google Workspace environments, devices, or SaaS tools.

-
Experience in a developer-heavy or engineering-led company.

-
Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection.

-
Professional proficiency in French.

 Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom . Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

 How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.

- 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition

- 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, IT)

- 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Site Reliability Engineering, Senior IT Manager)

- 45 Minutes with Executive (Senior Director, FP&A & IT)

 All roles require background checks.

 What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp .

 🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

 🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

 You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

jobs.description:
Role DescriptionAs a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform.

Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox ’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

Responsibilities

-
 Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment.

-
 Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation.

-
 Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues.

-
 Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate.

-
 Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment.

-
 Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity.

-
 Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team.

Requirements

- Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration.

- Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies.

- Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health.

- Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery.

- Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations.

- Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift.

- Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers.

About the Role

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer, EMEA Channel to help drive NinjaOne ’s expansion into the enterprise market. Support the review and alignment of technical content within RFPs and RFIs without owning full proposal management

- Partner with Training and Customer Success teams to accelerate time-to-value and ensure long-term adoption success

- Serve as a strategic voice between Sales and Product—surfacing feedback, identifying feature gaps, and influencing roadmap direction

- Build and maintain reusable technical assets including lab environments, demo flows, battlecards, and scripts to support a scalable AE-to-SE model

- Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive growth and align technical value to business goals

Technical Requirements

- Proficiency in Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting)

- Familiarity with Linux/macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting

- Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms and endpoint lifecycle management

- Scripting experience in PowerShell, Bash, and/or VBScript is preferred

- Comfortable navigating complex IT ecosystems and integrating with existing infrastructure

- Operates well in ambiguity and brings a builder’s mentality to scaling people, processes, and tools

- Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required

- Technical certifications (e.g. CISSP, Security+, cloud architecture) are a plus

- Fluent in English required. Additional fluent languages (German, French) are a plus.

Receive competitive compensation

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

 Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. You will set the technical direction for how employees and devices connect to Carrot systems, while staying hands-on in the tooling, automation, and complex problem-solving that make IT reliable at scale.

 This role sits at the center of IT engineering. You will lead larger initiatives from design through rollout, partner closely with Information Security on zero-trust and compliance priorities, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through standards, documentation, and mentorship. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.

 What You’ll Own 💼

 In this role, you will:

- Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience

- Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards

- Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale

- Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews

- Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues

- Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth

- Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs

- Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups

- Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders

 What Success Looks Like 📈

 In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

- Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on

- Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience

- Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume

- Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews

- Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards

- Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance

 About You ✨

 You likely have:

- 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms

- Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access

- Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement

- Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration

- Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams

- A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority

- Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences

 Nice to Have ⭐

 While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

- Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2)

- Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration

- Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts

- Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models

- Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations

- Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator)

 Why This Role Matters 🧡

 Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible.

 As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing.

  Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

 Highlights include:

- A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

- A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

- Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

- Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

- Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

- A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

- The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 Compensation 💰

 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package.

- Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range).

- Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

 Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

  Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to:

 A Note on AI

 At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

 For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

 Why Carrot?

 Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.description:
Role DescriptionAs a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform.

Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox ’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

Responsibilities

-
 Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment.

-
 Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation.

-
 Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues.

-
 Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate.

-
 Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment.

-
 Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity.

-
 Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team.

Requirements

- Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration.

- Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies.

- Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health.

- Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery.

- Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations.

- Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift.

- Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers.

- Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

- Production experience with FleetDM on Windows , including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps.

- Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results.

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration, continuous integration and delivery, and migration or coexistence between endpoint-management platforms.

- Experience with Automox, Patch My PC, or comparable tools , and with endpoint privilege management, application control, encryption, or other security controls.

- Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments and contributing reusable automation across Windows, macOS, or Linux.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

-
 Awareness: Understand yourself and others.

-
 Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.

-
 Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.

-
 Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.description:
Du hast beim MSP mehr Tenants betreut, als du zählen kannst, und nie die saubere Baseline bauen dürfen, weil immer das nächste Ticket kam.

Du hast beim MSP mehr Tenants betreut, als du zählen kannst, und nie die saubere

Baseline bauen dürfen, weil immer das nächste Ticket kam. Hier baust du sie . Von Grund

auf, nach deinem Standard, mit Automatisierung als Kern.

Darum gibt es diese Stelle

 Neurawork ist eine Beratung für Operational AI in Oberbayern. Um uns herum ist eine

Gruppe mit rund 50 Nutzern in mehreren Gesellschaften gewachsen. Ein Konzept für eine

Standard-IT auf Microsoft 365 ist angelegt: ein Tenant pro Gesellschaft, zentral verwaltet,

aus einer Vorlage ausgerollt. Es fehlt die Person, die es zu Ende denkt, umsetzt und danach

verantwortet. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und eng mit unserem Platform

Architect zusammen.

 Aufgaben

 Was du bei uns machst

-
Baseline für Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint und Defender bauen und per PowerShell und Microsoft Graph ausrollen

-
Alle Tenants zentral verwalten (CSP, GDAP, Lighthouse oder CIPP) und neue Gesellschaften in zwei Tagen startklar machen

-
Wiederkehrendes automatisieren: On- und Offboarding, Lizenzabgleich, Schnittstellen zu CRM und Buchhaltung mit Power Automate, n8n oder Make

-
Google Workspace, europäische Cloud, VPN und GitLab unter dieselbe Sicherheitslinie bringen: MFA, Gerätestandard, Backup, Offboarding

-
Secure Score, Lizenzen und ISO-27001-Nachweise regelmäßig prüfen und eine BI-Plattform auf Power BI aufsetzen

 Was die Stelle nicht ist

-
Kein Ticketsystem mit 5.000 Nutzern

-
kein Team unter dir

-
keine Softwareentwicklung- Die Produktplattform baut jemand anderes.

Qualifikationen

Was wir suchen

-
Mindestens vier Jahre Microsoft 365, idealerweise beim MSP oder Microsoft-Partner mit mehreren Tenants parallel

-
Sichere Praxis in Entra ID mit Conditional Access, Intune mit Autopilot, Exchange Online und Defender for Business

-
PowerShell und Microsoft Graph im Alltag, nicht nur im Lebenslauf

-
Deutsch auf C1-Niveau

-
Du dokumentierst, ohne dass jemand fragt, und sagst Nein, wenn jemand lokale Admin-Rechte will

-
Du hast Skripte geschrieben, die andere produktiv nutzen.

-
Schön, aber kein Muss: Google-Workspace-Administration, Erfahrung mit europäischen

Cloud-Anbietern, Zertifikate wie MS-102 oder MD-102.

Das bieten wir dir

-
Du erhältst eine komplette Home-Office-Ausstattung für deinen Arbeitsplatz zu Hause.

-
Du nimmst regelmäßig an Teamevents und Firmenfeiern teil.

-
Du profitierst von Angeboten zur beruflichen Bildung.

-
Du arbeitest komplett flexibel und überwiegend remote, mit regelmäßigen Präsenztagen in Oberbayern.

-
Du nutzt flexible Arbeitszeiten für deine optimale Work-Life-Balance.

-
Dir stehen zusätzliche Urlaubstage zur Verfügung.

Bewerbung: so geht es weiter.

Uns genügt Dein Lebenslauf genügt, wir brauchen kein Anschreiben.Wir freuen uns im ersten Gespräch ein Skript oder einen Workflow, der etwas Wiederkehrendes automatisiert hat von Dir zu sehen. Gleichzeitig zeigen wir Dir, was in den ersten 18 Monaten entstehen soll. Danach gibt es einen Termin mit der Geschäftsführung und unsere Entscheidung.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung !

jobs.description:
About Upsun (formerly Platform. sh) Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love.

 About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh )

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

- Predictable performance, even at scale

- Secure, compliant environments by default

- Real-time observability and profiling built in

- Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

- AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other.

 Impact of a Senior IT Systems Engineer

As a Senior IT Engineer, you help shape and improve the systems that our 250+ person remote company relies on every day. Your work spans identity and access, Google Workspace, device management, and our wider SaaS environment.
Reporting to the IT Director, you take ownership of complex problems and lead improvements from initial assessment through delivery. You identify what needs attention, recommend priorities, and make thoughtful decisions that balance security, reliability, and employee experience. You also help the team build stronger practices through clear documentation, shared knowledge, and practical guidance.

 What to expect

-
 Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward.

-
 Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs.

-
 Device management: Help lead the rollout and ongoing development of JumpCloud and our device management practices across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Define and implement device configurations, security policies, software deployment, and onboarding processes in partnership with IT Operations and Security.

-
 Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable.

-
 Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well.

-
 SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews.

-
 Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2.

-
 Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

 What you bring

-
 Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them.

-
 Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three.

-
 Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption.

-
 Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

-
 A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team.

-
 Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.

-
 Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable.

-
 Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective.

-
 Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years.

 Bonus points

-
Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including assessing and integrating identity systems, Google Workspace environments, devices, or SaaS tools.

-
Experience in a developer-heavy or engineering-led company.

-
Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection.

-
Professional proficiency in French.

 Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom . Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

 How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.

- 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition

- 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, IT)

- 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Site Reliability Engineering, Senior IT Manager)

- 45 Minutes with Executive (Senior Director, FP&A & IT)

 All roles require background checks.

 What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp .

 🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

 🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

 You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.

At Jamf , we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #One Jamf .

What you'll do at Jamf

The Senior Manager, IT Enterprise Applications, Digital Workplace is responsible for how technology works and feels for Jamf employees. This leader connects enterprise systems into a cohesive, scalable foundation that supports productivity and cross-team collaboration. You will own the roadmap, architecture, lifecycle management, and day-to-day operations of Jamf 's Service & Knowledge Management and Employee Experience platforms (currently ServiceNow and Atlassian), with the opportunity to take on additional digital workplace platforms over time. You will build and develop a team of platform administrators, developers, and technical architects, and partner with the Senior Director of Enterprise Applications on long-term platform strategy while holding decision-making authority over execution, vendor relationships, and cross-domain escalations.

What you can expect to do in this role:

jobs.summary: ABOUT WATERSHED Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and...
jobs.description:
ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

THE ROLE

As an IT Engineer at Watershed, you’ll own the internal technology and SaaS platforms our teams rely on every day and shape how employees experience IT across our global offices. It’s an exciting time to join: we’ve equipped employees with best-in-class AI tools, and you’ll help define what modern IT looks like when AI is woven into how we work. You’ll support employees directly while designing agent-driven workflows, integrations, and self-service resources that reduce toil and turn repetitive tickets into well-engineered systems that make your colleagues’ lives meaningfully better.

As we grow globally, you’ll have real ownership over the systems you build and a direct hand in shaping where IT goes next, partnering closely with teammates in San Francisco and London. We’re looking for someone with deep experience who finds joy in solving problems for people, thrives in a creative, collaborative environment, and has the judgment to balance quick fixes with long-term engineering. If you’re customer-obsessed, hard-working, proactive, inclusive, and optimistic, you’ll fit right in. This position is based in our San Francisco office, where you’ll work four days per week as part of our in-office culture.

YOU WILL:

 - Design and implement scalable IT solutions that enhance employee productivity and security across our global offices

 - Manage and maintain our core IT systems, including Okta, Kolide, Iru (formerly Kandji), Google Workspace, Notion, and Slack

 - Develop and optimize our global asset management processes for employee devices throughout their lifecycle

 - Build and maintain reliable automations and integrations across our IT systems, reducing repetitive work in onboarding, access management, device operations, and support

 - Own and improve employee onboarding, role change, and offboarding lifecycle processes through reliable provisioning, access controls, automation, and device workflows in partnership with People and Security

 - Partner with Security, People, Workplace, Engineering, and our external IT support provider to deliver reliable services and a thoughtful employee experience

 - Serve as an escalation point for elevated hardware, software, and network-related issues, as well as occasional in-person support within the San Francisco office

 - Maintain a secure, reliable macOS fleet through device provisioning, configuration, patching, endpoint protection, and compliance monitoring

 - Manage and optimize our conference room technology and A/V systems

 - Turn recurring issues into lasting improvements through root-cause analysis, clear run books, employee-facing guidance, and self-service tools; maintain IT policies and procedures that support consistent service delivery

 - Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, system architecture design and workflow development

 - Administer and support our AI platforms, including Claude, ChatGPT, Dust.tt, and Notion AI, managing access, configuration, integrations, and secure adoption across the company

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have 3+ years of increasing experience and responsibility in IT at high-growth technology companies

 - You have hands-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows, and understand least-privilege access

 - You have hands-on experience using AI to improve your work, can explain where it has helped, and know when to verify its output or use a different approach

 - You’re comfortable building scripts, using APIs, and workflow automation to solve operational problems, and you test, document, and maintain what you build

 - You have experience managing and supporting Mac-based environments

 - You have experience with asset management systems and lifecycle management for employee devices

 - You're knowledgeable about IT security best practices and compliance requirements

 - You have excellent problem-solving abilities and a track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 - You're an effective communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - You have experience supporting a breadth of modern SaaS applications

 - You have experience managing vendor relationships and external service providers

 - You're passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and find fulfillment in helping others succeed

NICE TO HAVE:

 - First-hand experience building custom tools and applications to solve internal business challenges

 - Experience with zero-trust security frameworks

 - Knowledge of corporate networking fundamentals and troubleshooting

 - Familiarity with office setup and infrastructure planning

 - Direct experience with IT compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO)

 - Industry certifications related to our technology stack (e.g., Okta, Google Workspace, Cisco)

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our classified software team. You will design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.

This is a hands-on role with real technical authority. You will be the first dedicated software engineer on this team, which means you set the architecture, choose the patterns, and establish the engineering standards the rest of the team builds to. As the team grows you will lead it technically, and there is a clear path into formal technical leadership of the software function for someone who wants it.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Act as technical lead for the classified software and platform team: own the architecture of the application portfolio, set the standards the team builds to, and make the tradeoff calls.

- Design and build production web applications in React and Go that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.

- Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.

- Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.

- Own the DevSecOps path to production: containerize and deploy to Kubernetes through GitOps CI/CD pipelines that scan, sign, and produce the evidence our accreditations require.

- Decompose multi-quarter programs into well-scoped work other engineers can deliver independently, and grow the engineers who join the team through design review, code review, and pairing.

- Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.

- Professional experience developing backend services in Go.

- Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.

- Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.

- Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.

- Experience leading technical work: owning a system's architecture, reviewing the designs and code of others, setting direction for a small team, and communicating clearly in design documents, tradeoff analyses, and decision records a peer can pick up and act on.

- Eligible to obtain and maintain a US Top Secret Clearance with customer's approval. May be required to obtain and maintain a DoD 8140/8570 qualifying certification.

 DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure or application and desktop brokering (e.g. Citrix, Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Leostream, Apache Guacamole, Kasm), and with virtualization orchestrated through Kubernetes such as KubeVirt.

- Experience implementing authorization systems (RBAC, ABAC, or relationship-based models), integrating applications against an external policy decision point, and Policy as Code (PaC) tools such as OPA, Oso, Cedar, or Kyverno.

- Experience with S3-compatible object storage APIs, POSIX filesystem semantics, or FUSE.

- Experience building software for air-gapped or network-isolated environments, including dependency vendoring and offline builds.

- Experience with DevSecOps supply-chain security practices including SBOM generation, artifact signing, and provenance attestation.

- Proficiency with core security concepts including encryption, authentication, identity and access management, and Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA), plus an understanding of NIST SP 800-53 controls and their technical implementation.

- Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.

- Experience as a tech lead or founding engineer on a product team, including establishing engineering practices from scratch, onboarding new engineers, and interviewing and hiring software engineers.

US Salary Range

 $166,000 - $220,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

About us:

 Thrive delivers upon the promise of technology by enabling our clients’ digital transformation journeys with best practices on an AI, cybersecurity and cloud focused NextGen managed services platform.

 Thrive ’s culture is powered by diverse talent, big ideas, and a customer-first mindset—and it’s what truly sets us apart. Thrive is built for people who want more than a weekday routine. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to tackle new challenges and ready to drive real impact in a rapidly expanding environment, then welcome to THRIVE!

Position Overview

System Administrators provide remote support across diverse, multi-tenant environments, handling escalated incidents and complex service requests. The role involves advanced troubleshooting, implementing changes, coordinating with other teams, and serving as an escalation point for engineers within the team, while maintaining clear client communication. Thrive seeks technically proficient professionals with strong verbal and written skills, a desire to learn across all aspects of IT, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with broad technical exposure and opportunities for growth.

Responsibilities

- Communicate with customers via phone, email, and chat in a timely, courteous, empathetic, and professional manner, providing clear updates and case status throughout the resolution process.

- Perform secondary response and advanced troubleshooting of escalated customer issues, addressing single-user and system-impacting incidents while accurately documenting all actions in Thrive ’s tools.

- Analyze and document unfamiliar client server, workstation, and network environments to determine the fastest and most effective path to incident resolution.

- Support and troubleshoot diverse computing environments across a wide range of business clients.

- Perform rapid root-cause analysis of workstation-, server-, and network-level incidents, including complex and escalated issues.

- Troubleshoot and resolve high-level workstation, server, and network incidents independently, following Thrive ’s standard operating procedures and best practices.

- Utilize appropriate software utilities and vendor- or application-specific tools to achieve timely resolution of customer incidents.

- Set and manage client expectations throughout the troubleshooting process, providing appropriate updates, next steps, and demonstrating the correct level of urgency.

- Communicate troubleshooting actions and resolutions clearly, using technical or non-technical language appropriate to the audience.

- Provide guidance to clients on applications, Thrive best practices, and general infrastructure standards.

- Develop, document, and help implement client standards based on Thrive best practices; evaluate client environments and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Certifications

- CompTIA Network+ / A+

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator (AZ-104) or Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS-102)

- ITIL v4 Foundation (modules)
