jobs.description:
Why Stifel

Stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole.

Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success.

What You'll Be Doing

The IT Endpoint Engineer is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and deploy functions of desktop, laptop and mobile hardware and operating systems. Expected for assisting in patch management as well configuration management activities and processes. This position performs a variety of tasks including top level endpoint support of hardware, OS and applications of all types. This position relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected.

What We're Looking For

Maintain the operating system(s) for the desktop environment.Work to maintain configuration management of base image and test updates as available.Work with deployment team to deploy updates and changes to the base image.Implement solutions for the desktop and mobile platforms.Test all new hardware for compatibility and security within the environment.High level troubleshooting of common applications and their interactions with the underlying operating systemsWork with vendors for issue escalation as needed.Analyze and remediate issues with operating system update deployment.Test remediation solutions and handoff to deployment team.Continually look for automation opportunities.Create documentation for new procedures and manual steps to complete tasks for soft handoffs and cross-training of support personnel and implementation teams.Ability and means to travel; Occasional night and weekend work required as well as overnight travel (up to 10%).
What You'll Bring

Knowledge of processors, memory, and other computer components and accessories.Knowledge of principles for providing strong customer and personal service. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.Ability to multi-task to address multiple and often conflicting priorities in a fast-paced environment.Ability to demonstrate proactive approach to problem resolution, strong troubleshooting, and problem solving skills.Understanding of compliance functions within a financial organization will be a plus.Knowledge of industry standard IT best practices, including disaster recovery and high availability concepts a plus.Uses logic and reasoning to identify complex problems; review related information and develop options and implement solutions.
Education & Experience

Minimum Required: High School diploma or equivalent and 5 years IT experienceMinimum Required: 5+ years' PC/Mac or Mobile support/maintenance experience
Licenses & Credentials

Minimum Required: None
Systems & Technology

Knowledgeable of Windows, Office product suite, Microsoft System Center suite, VPN and local area network.Knowledgeable of Mac products, and associated productivity applications
About Stifel

Stifel is more than 130 years old and still thinking like a start-up. We are a global wealth management and investment banking firm serious about innovation and fresh ideas. Built on a simple premise of safeguarding our clients’ money as if it were our own, coined by our namesake, Herman Stifel, our success is intimately tied to our commitment to helping families, companies, and municipalities find their own success.

While our headquarters is in St. Louis, we have offices in New York, San Francisco, Baltimore, London, Frankfurt, Toronto, and more than 400 other locations. Stifel is home to approximately 9,000 individuals who are currently building their careers as financial advisors, research analysts, project managers, marketing specialists, developers, bankers, operations associates, among hundreds more. Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success.

At Stifel we offer an entrepreneurial environment, comprehensive benefits package to include health, dental and vision care, 401k, wellness initiatives, life insurance, and paid time off.

jobs.description:
Omega Morgan believes that each employee makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this position description is designed to outline primary duties, qualifications, and job scope, but not limit the individual nor the organization to just the work identified. It is our expectation that each employee will offer his/her services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our endeavors.

The Endpoint Administrator owns the operational lifecycle of company endpoints and the technology aspects of employee onboarding and offboarding. This role is responsible for ensuring laptops, desktops, mobile devices, shared workstations, and related peripherals are securely standardized, provisioned, maintained, supported, recovered, and retired. The Endpoint Administrator works closely with Human Resources, hiring managers, IT support, security, and infrastructure teams to deliver a consistent employee technology experience while maintaining accurate asset and access records.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Own the complete lifecycle of company endpoints, including standards, procurement coordination, receiving, staging, deployment, assignment, support, reassignment, refresh, recovery, and secure retirement or disposal.Administer endpoint management, remote monitoring and management, deployment, and mobile device management platforms; maintain device enrollment, configuration profiles, policies, and compliance rules.Provision laptops, desktops, mobile devices, shared workstations, and peripherals using standardized builds, required applications, security controls, and role-based configurations.Coordinate and execute employee onboarding by preparing equipment, accounts, licenses, group memberships, applications, and access in partnership with Human Resources and hiring managers.Coordinate and execute employee offboarding by disabling access, reclaiming equipment and licenses, preserving or transferring business data as authorized, documenting disposition, and securely wiping devices for reuse or disposal.Maintain accurate endpoint and asset records, including assigned user, location, serial number, model, warranty, configuration, status, and planned replacement date.Manage operating system, application, driver, BIOS, and firmware patching; monitor compliance and remediate devices that fall outside established security or maintenance standards.Implement and maintain endpoint security controls, including encryption, endpoint protection, local administrator restrictions, screen-lock standards, and secure configuration baselines.Package, test, deploy, update, and remove business applications while supporting software licensing, standardization, and compatibility requirements.Troubleshoot endpoint, peripheral, profile, performance, connectivity, and application issues; identify root causes and coordinate vendor repair or replacement when necessary.Maintain ready-to-deploy inventory and forecast endpoint refresh, warranty, and accessory needs to support timely onboarding, replacements, and business growth.Create and maintain endpoint standards, onboarding and offboarding checklists, support documentation, knowledge articles, and audit-ready records; report on fleet health, patch compliance, inventory accuracy, and lifecycle status.

Required Skills

Strong endpoint troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, operating systems, applications, user profiles, peripherals, and connectivityAbility to organize and execute time-sensitive onboarding, offboarding, deployment, and device-recovery activities with a high degree of accuracyWorking knowledge of endpoint management, RMM, software deployment, patching, encryption, endpoint security, and remote support technologiesStrong customer service and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information clearly to employees and managersAbility to create and maintain clear procedures, checklists, asset records, and technical documentationStrong attention to detail, ownership, discretion, and sound judgment when handling company devices, employee data, credentials, and access

Required Experience And/or Education

Three or more years of experience in endpoint administration, desktop engineering, IT support, systems administration, or a related roleDemonstrated experience provisioning, managing, troubleshooting, and retiring Windows 10/11 endpoints in a corporate environmentExperience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, and role-based user and device provisioningExperience with endpoint management, RMM, deployment, or mobile device management platforms; Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot experience is preferredExperience with application packaging and deployment, patch management, disk encryption, endpoint protection, and security compliance remediationExperience maintaining hardware inventory, asset assignments, warranties, refresh schedules, and secure device disposition recordsRelevant certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, or equivalent practical experience preferred

*We are knowmad mood!* *Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología. Nacimos para provocar un cambio real a través de la innovación y el desarrollo sostenible, con la misión de aportar valor a los clientes e impulsar nuestro talento.* *Formado por más de 3.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto.* *Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza.* ¿Te apasiona la gestión moderna de dispositivos y entornos Microsoft? Buscamos un/a especialista en **Microsoft Intune** que quiera formar parte de un equipo tecnológico en constante evolución, participando en la administración, securización y mejora continua del puesto de trabajo digital.

**¿Cuál será tu misión?** Serás la persona responsable de la administración y evolución de la plataforma de gestión de dispositivos, garantizando una experiencia de usuario segura, eficiente y alineada con las mejores prácticas de Modern Workplace.

**Tus principales responsabilidades** ✅ Administración y gestión de **Microsoft Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager** .

✅ Gestión de dispositivos corporativos Windows y cumplimiento de políticas de seguridad.

✅ Implementación y mantenimiento de **Configuration Profiles** , **Compliance Policies** y configuraciones de **Endpoint Security** .

✅ Gestión de **Windows Autopilot** y procesos de incorporación de dispositivos.

✅ Despliegue y mantenimiento de aplicaciones Win32, MSI y Microsoft Store.

✅ Administración de identidades y dispositivos mediante **Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)** .

✅ Resolución de incidencias complejas y análisis técnico de endpoints.

✅ Automatización de tareas y procedimientos mediante **PowerShell** .

**¿Qué buscamos?** **Requisitos**

* Experiencia sólida administrando Microsoft Intune.
* Conocimientos avanzados de Windows 11 y dispositivos corporativos.
* Experiencia con Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Experiencia con Windows Autopilot.
* Gestión de políticas de cumplimiento y seguridad.
* Despliegue de aplicaciones corporativas.
* Conocimientos de PowerShell.
* Capacidad de troubleshooting y análisis de incidencias.

**Valoraremos especialmente**

* Microsoft Graph API.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Intune Remediations.
* Certificados digitales, PKI, SCEP y PKCS.
* Android Enterprise, macOS y Apple Business Manager.
* Experiencia en proyectos de implantación o migración MDM.

**¿Cómo es la persona que encajará en el equipo?** Buscamos una persona:

* Analítica y orientada a la resolución de problemas.
* Autónoma y responsable.
* Proactiva y con iniciativa.
* Con capacidad de trabajo en equipo.
* Con interés por seguir aprendiendo y evolucionando técnicamente

**Requisitos adicionales**

* Nivel de inglés B2 o superior.
* Certificación Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) valorable.

**💡 ¿Por qué te interesará este proyecto?** Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con tecnologías líderes del ecosistema Microsoft, participar en iniciativas de modernización del puesto de trabajo y contribuir de forma activa a la mejora continua del servicio.

Y con nosotros podrás disfrutar de:

✅Contrato Indefinido

✅**Hibrido Madrid (2 días oficinas cliente Madrid / 3 teletrabajo)** ✅Formación interna y acceso a certificaciones ♻Consulta nuestro calendario aquí:

https://www.knowmadmood.com/es/talento/formacion

✅Plan de retribución flexible (seguro médico, transporte, tickets guardería, tickets restaurante)

✅Embajador de nuestra marca, a través de nuestro plan amigo

¡Recomienda a tus amigos y llévate un extra!

✅¡Eventos, meetups, techdays, charlas...y mucho más!

✅ 26 días de descanso (22 días vacaciones, 2 días de libre disposición y 24 y 31 diciembre festivos por defecto)

✅ Horario: 8.30 a 18h ( flexible) L-J y V 8 a 15h e Intensiva de Verano Julio y Agosto de 8 a 15h

Para estar al corriente de nuestras novedades síguenos aquí -\> knowmad mood

*En* ***knowmad mood*** *nos comprometemos con la igualdad de oportunidades y el respeto a la diversidad. Aplicamos nuestro Plan de Igualdad y el principio de no discriminación en todos nuestros procesos de selección.*

jobs.title: Commercial Data Consultant (MDM / Data Platforms)

jobs.description:
Why this role

We are a consulting firm that helps life sciences companies, locally and globally, get their commercial data right, from master data and data platforms to customer engagement programmes. In this role, you'll be the person clients and project teams turn to when the data questions get hard.

We welcome people from two backgrounds: master data management (MDM) or data platforms. You don't need to cover both. We're looking for real depth in one.

What you'll do

* Act as the subject matter expert on MDM or data platform pre-implementation or implementations for life sciences clients, depending on your background
* Tackle the data challenges typical of customer engagement, such as HCP/HCO data quality, CRM master and reference data
* Bring third-party reference data (IQVIA, Veeva) together with client data
* Work with architects, functional consultants and client stakeholders to turn requirements into working data solutions

What you bring

* A proven track record as a subject matter expert in either:

* MDM implementations (e.g. Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM), or

* data platform implementations (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica IDMC)
* A solid understanding of data management and its typical challenges in the customer engagement (CE) domain
* A general understanding of CE processes within CRM, marketing automation, consent management, and event and engagement management
* Good knowledge of the data models of at least one key data provider: IQVIA OneKey, IQVIA sales and prescription data, or Veeva OpenData
* Clear communication, spoken and written
* Excellent English

A plus if you have

* Deep knowledge of one or more CE processes
* A certification in an MDM solution (Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM) or a data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica)
* GAMP 5 training or hands-on experience

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

* Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning
* Execution matters --- we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice
* Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines
* Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

* Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs
* Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance
* Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career
* A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work
* Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results
* The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay---++submit your application in English++ at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy++.++

jobs.title: Endpoint Manager Specialist (Night shifts 6 p.m.-2 a.m.)
jobs.summary: Company Description - ------------------ Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for...
jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for an**Endpoint Management Specialist** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.**

**Key responsibilities:**

**Endpoint Operations \& Support**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and device management issues.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle and perform root cause analysis.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and device provisioning activities.

**Endpoint Management**

* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services.
* Configure and test device policies, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Monitor endpoint compliance and support remediation activities.
* Assist with device lifecycle management and deployment processes.

**Software Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package, test, and deploy software applications and updates.
* Troubleshoot application deployment issues.
* Support application lifecycle management and software maintenance.

**Testing \& Continuous Improvement**

* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments and testing activities.
* Contribute to process improvements, automation, and service optimization initiatives.

**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Document recurring issues and standard solutions.
* Support knowledge sharing within the Endpoint Management team.

Qualifications
- -------------

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Fluent **English**(C1 or C2)

Additional Information
- ---------------------

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - AI Business Solutions (Cloud Endpoint)
jobs.summary: **Overview** As a Solution Engineer -- AI Business Solutions (Cloud Endpoint), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, helping them modernize their endpoint and virtual desktop environments for secure, cloud-native,...
jobs.description:
**Overview**

As a Solution Engineer -- AI Business Solutions (Cloud Endpoint), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, helping them modernize their endpoint and virtual desktop environments for secure, cloud-native, AI-enabled work.

You will lead technical engagements across the Cloud Endpoint portfolio, including Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Entra ID, translating customer business and technical requirements into scalable solution architectures. You will drive technical wins through discovery, architectural design, demonstrations, workshops, and proofs of concept, while partnering closely with sales, security, identity, engineering, and partner teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery and customer conversations to understand business, security, endpoint management, virtualization, and AI-related requirements and translate them into solution strategies.

* Design and present secure, scalable Cloud Endpoint architectures leveraging technologies such as Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Entra ID.

* Drive technical wins by delivering architectural design sessions, demonstrations, hands-on workshops, Proofs of Concept (POCs), and technical close plans that demonstrate solution value and integration with customer environments.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers modernize legacy VDI and endpoint management environments and adopt cloud-native, identity-first, and Zero Trust approaches.

* Partner with account teams, specialists, Cloud Solution Architects, security and identity teams, partners, and engineering to develop strategic win plans, resolve technical blockers, and accelerate customer adoption.

* Apply competitive, industry, partner, and technical knowledge to position Microsoft solutions effectively, identify competitive opportunities, and provide feedback to product and engineering teams.

* Continuously develop technical expertise across Cloud Endpoint, security, identity, virtualization, and emerging AI technologies while sharing knowledge and best practices with customers, partners, and internal teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required/minimum qualifications**

· Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.

· Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to lead technical discussions, presentations, demonstrations, and architecture conversations with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders in both written and verbal interactions.

**Additional or preferred qualifications**

· 6+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.

· 4+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.

· Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines (e.g., Office 365, Power BI, Azure Architect and Development exams, Cloud Platform Technologies, Information Security, Architecture).

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations. (https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/accessibility.html)

jobs.title: Platform Security / Endpoint Security Specialist
jobs.summary: 🛡️ ¡Únete a Accenture como SentinelOne Security Specialist! ¿Tienes experiencia en **Endpoint Security, EDR/XDR y respuesta ante incidentes** ? Buscamos un/a especialista para administrar y optimizar la protección de endpoints con **SentinelOne** ,...
jobs.description:
🛡️ ¡Únete a Accenture como SentinelOne Security Specialist!

¿Tienes experiencia en **Endpoint Security, EDR/XDR y respuesta ante incidentes** ? Buscamos un/a especialista para administrar y optimizar la protección de endpoints con **SentinelOne** , fortaleciendo la detección, investigación y respuesta frente a amenazas.

🔐 ¿Qué harás?

* Administrar la consola, tenants, sites, grupos, agentes y políticas de SentinelOne Singularity.
* Monitorear alertas, investigar amenazas y ejecutar acciones de contención, aislamiento, kill, quarantine, remediation y rollback según los procedimientos establecidos.
* Gestionar el despliegue, actualización, salud y cobertura de agentes en Windows, Linux y macOS.
* Analizar exclusiones y falsos positivos, evaluando su impacto y documentando las excepciones.
* Integrar la telemetría de SentinelOne con soluciones SIEM/SOAR.
* Colaborar con equipos de Threat Hunting, Incident Response y Vulnerability Management.
* Generar reportes de cobertura, detecciones, tendencias y cumplimiento operativo.
* Coordinar investigaciones e incidentes con equipos de SOC, infraestructura y soporte.

📍 Condiciones

* Rol: SentinelOne Security Specialist
* Especialidad: Cybersecurity / Endpoint Security / EDR
* Ubicación: Colombia

🌟 **Buscamos un perfil técnico, autónomo y orientado a la respuesta** , capaz de mantener una alta cobertura de endpoints, investigar amenazas y tomar decisiones efectivas frente a incidentes de seguridad.

📩 Si tienes experiencia en **SentinelOne, EDR/XDR y Endpoint Security** , ¡postúlate y sé parte de Accenture!

🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

* 4 años de experiencia en Endpoint Security, SOC, Incident Response o áreas relacionadas.
* Experiencia hands-on con SentinelOne Singularity o plataformas EDR/XDR equivalentes.
* Conocimientos sólidos de seguridad en Windows y Linux, malware, comportamiento de procesos, persistencia y respuesta a incidentes.
* Experiencia investigando alertas y ejecutando acciones de contención y remediación.
* Capacidad para documentar investigaciones y coordinar incidentes con equipos técnicos.
* Autonomía operativa y buen criterio para escalar incidentes de acuerdo con su criticidad.

⭐ Será un plus

* Certificación SentinelOne o formación específica en la plataforma.
* Experiencia con SIEM/SOAR, scripting, Threat Hunting y MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Experiencia en administración masiva de endpoints.
* Conocimientos de IAM/PAM y Cloud Workload Security.

jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

 Department overview:

 The Solutions Engineer builds, tests, and improves employee technology automations and integrations within agreed designs. The role helps shift support toward earlier detection and safe, repeatable resolution while making solutions easy to operate. Working with senior engineers, platform owners, and support teams, this individual delivers defined components and uses production feedback to improve them.

 What you’ll be doing:

   Implementation and quality

- Develop scripts, API integrations, workflows, and platform configurations for agreed employee technology use cases.

- Implement defined detection and approved remediation steps, including validation, error handling, logging, and escalation when a case cannot be resolved safely.

- Write and run tests; document configuration, operation, known limitations, and recovery steps.

- Monitor owned components, investigate defects, and improve reliability and usability from production feedback.

   Platforms and integrations

- Build and maintain assigned integrations and workflows across employee technology systems, which may include ServiceNow, Moveworks, Jira, Slack, Nexthink, Jamf , Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Graph.

- Use documented APIs and integration patterns to map data, handle authentication and common failure cases, and record actions and results.

- Contribute reusable scripts, connectors, and documentation that other engineers can use.

   Automation and AI delivery

- Implement defined detection, self service, support, and remediation use cases with clear eligibility checks, logging, exception handling, and escalation.

- Configure or integrate approved AI assisted steps, test them against representative cases, and report inaccurate or uncertain results for review.

- Validate whether a workflow ran and whether it achieved the intended technical result; help service owners assess employee outcomes.

   Engineering practices

- Write maintainable Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar code as appropriate to the assigned platform and use case.

- Use source control, tests, code review, deployment procedures, and runbooks to make changes safe to operate .

- Troubleshoot defects within owned components and bring cross-platform design or security questions to senior engineers.

   Team contribution

- Contribute technical ideas and implementation detail during solution design and code review.

- Follow established architecture, security, and engineering standards; raise design or policy questions early.

- Work with operations and platform owners to validate requirements and hand over completed changes.

- Share reusable components and practical lessons with the engineering team.

 What we are looking for:

   Required

- Practical experience building and supporting scripts, integrations, workflows, or software components.

- Working knowledge of a relevant language such as Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript and experience using APIs.

- Ability to test, troubleshoot, document, and improve delivered work.

- Collaborative problem solving and clear communication with technical and support colleagues.

- Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience using source control and participating in testing, review, and deployment of technical changes.

- Interest in applying telemetry and automation to practical employee support problems.

   Preferred

- Exposure to service management, endpoint management, telemetry, or employee collaboration platforms.

- Experience with automated testing, cloud services, or AI assisted workflows.

 Benefits:

- Discretionary bonus opportunity

- Private Medical Insurance

- Dental Scheme

- 25 days holiday per year

- On Site Gym

- Subsidised Café

- Free soft drinks

- On site bar

- Access to cycle garage and showers

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

jobs.description:
OverviewPLEASE NOTE: No corp-to-corp candidates will be accepted.

Overview

PLEASE NOTE: No corp-to-corp candidates will be accepted.

- The Microsoft Windows Engineer serves as the lead technical specialist for the Microsoft endpoint and identity ecosystem supporting this effort, including Windows workstation engineering, Intune, Windows Autopilot, Group Policy, Entra ID/Active Directory integration, passwordless authentication, hardware-backed credentials, and Windows endpoint telemetry.

- This role is responsible for engineering secure Windows endpoint baselines, device provisioning and compliance workflows, authentication and access controls, and the operational integration of Windows devices into the company's security monitoring and incident response framework.

Responsibilities

- Design, maintain, and secure Windows workstation images supporting both on-site and remote/VDI users.

- Engineer Windows endpoint baselines, policy settings, compliance configurations, and patch orchestration mechanisms using approved Microsoft technologies.

- Administer and optimize Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Group Policy, and associated endpoint compliance and configuration controls.

- Support implementation of passwordless authentication, hardware-backed credentials (e.g., YubiKeys, CAC, software keys), and other protections for privileged and sensitive accounts.

- Integrate endpoint enrollment and conditional access controls with Entra ID / Active Directory to ensure devices are securely configured before receiving access.

- Support device lifecycle operations including provisioning, compliance enforcement, reassignment, and decommissioning for Windows endpoints.

- Engineer and validate Windows endpoint logging, monitoring, and telemetry, including Windows Event Logs, endpoint agents, and SIEM/EDR forwarding.

- Coordinate Intune/GPO-based patch orchestration, policy enforcement, and remediation of Windows configuration drift.

- Produce documentation, standards, runbooks, validation artifacts, and technical guidance related to the Microsoft endpoint environment.

- Support escalated incident response, troubleshooting, and audit activities involving Windows devices and Microsoft-managed endpoint services.

Qualifications

Core Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, or related field preferred; equivalent experience acceptable

- Must possess an active or interim Top Secret security clearance

- 8 years of experience in IT, Endpoint Engineering, or Cybersecurity

- 6 years of experience performing engineering functions in enterprise environments

- Experience working under formal change control, audit, and security governance processes

Additional Qualifications:

- Experience with Microsoft Intune for provisioning, compliance, configuration profiles, and security policy enforcement

- Experience with Windows Autopilot for automated provisioning and device lifecycle management

- Experience with Group Policy Objects (GPO) for Windows configuration and policy delivery

- Experience with Entra ID / Active Directory integration, conditional access, and device/user association workflows

- Experience building and maintaining Windows workstation images

- Experience integrating Windows images with VDI, EDR, authentication tools, and logging agents

- Experience managing Windows patch orchestration, baseline enforcement, and configuration drift remediation

- Experience validating patch deployments and supporting rollback procedures

- Experience implementing passwordless authentication and hardware-backed credentials

- Experience configuring and maintaining Windows Event Logs and forwarding telemetry to SIEM/EDR platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel

- Experience monitoring enrollment, patch status, compliance posture, and operational failures across Windows endpoints

- Experience supporting audit readiness, forensic support, and technical validation reporting

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Palo Alto Networks is looking for an experienced and motivated solutions engineer with a passion for endpoint security controls that protect the workforce from attacks. This engineer will work closely with our sales team and ultimately be responsible for the technical “win” during the sales cycle. The Domain Consultant – Endpoint must demonstrate value during presentations, articulate technical challenges, pair with Palo Alto Networks solutions, and provide technical knowledge and experience to earn customer trust.

Palo Alto Networks Endpoint Privilege Manager (part of the Idira platform), a critical and foundational endpoint control addresses the underlying weaknesses of endpoint defenses against a privileged attacker and helps enterprises defend against these attacks.

Palo Alto Networks Domain Consultants work with the sales organization and are responsible for establishing the value of Palo Alto Networks products to prospective and current customers through demos, presentations, meetings, and proofs of concepts (POCs). Domain Consultants also help to create successful and happy customers by building relationships and technical trust with customers. The Domain Consultant is seen internally and externally as a technical expert on Palo Alto Networks products, as well as an industry expert in Identity and End Point security.

Responsibilities

Build and deliver product demonstrations and sales presentations to create excitement around Palo Alto Networks technology. Use your knowledge of various workforce operating systems and security concepts to understand and align with customer needs, matching their problems with Palo Alto Networks solutions.Plan and execute POC evaluations of Palo Alto Networks products with prospective customers. Use your sales experience to position Palo Alto Networks value and differentiators to acquire the technical win.Document customer interactions in Salesforce.Collect and deliver constant feedback to Palo Alto Networks product management team to influence product direction and champion the voice of your customers.Earn customer trust by demonstrating expertise in the area of endpoint and user security.Present and evangelize during tradeshows and customer events.

Qualifications

Advanced working knowledge (5+ years) of 2 of 3 primary workstation/server operating systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux).
Prior experience working primarily with endpoint/workstation products or solutions in a sales capacity. Hands-on experience with endpoint and identity management technologies such as: Active Directory, Intune, SCCM/MECM, Jamf and endpoint troubleshooting.Strong presentation skills and professional demeanor. Ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.An understanding of security concepts and the development of security roles within organizations that meet functional, technical and regulatory requirements.Ability to anticipate risks and devise solutions in the moment; adaptable.Proven ability to run technical discovery, design solutions, deliver demonstrations, answer RFPs and support complex sales opportunities.Travel as needed (<30%).Experience navigating enterprise-scale sales cycles preferred.Experience working with restAPIs with scripts or other no code/low code systems

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$206,400.00 - $283,800.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Position Title: Senior Enterprise Browser & Endpoint Engineer (ChromeOS / Enterprise Browser / Citrix)

Location: Columbus/Jersey City, NJ

Domain: Digital Workplace / End User Computing (EUC) / Endpoint Security

Duration : Longterm contract

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Enterprise Browser & Endpoint Engineer to design, manage, and optimize our enterprise browser ecosystem and modern endpoint platforms. In this role, you will hold global ownership of browser infrastructure—spanning ChromeOS, Chrome Enterprise, Edge Enterprise, Citrix Enterprise Browser, and Citrix Workspace Browser—ensuring secure access, seamless user experience, and automated lifecycle management across all devices and VDI environments.

The ideal candidate is an EUC/Endpoint Engineer at heart with deep expertise in identity, network, and browser-level policies, backed by modern automation skills and SRE/DevOps disciplines for enterprise-scale operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise Browser & Endpoint Architecture

Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise browser policies across Chrome, Edge, ChromeOS, and Citrix Enterprise/Workspace Browsers.Manage centralized browser management platforms, including Google Admin Console, Chrome Browser Cloud Management (CBCM), Microsoft Intune, and GPO/Group Policy.Enforce security baselines, enterprise extensions, proxy/PAC configurations, PKI/browser certificates, and SSO authentication flows (SAML 2.0, OIDC, Entra ID, ADFS).Oversee browser release rings (Canary, Dev, Beta, Stable, Extended), application compatibility, cross-browser redirection, and legacy web application access.2. VDI & Workplace Infrastructure Integration

Manage browser profile persistence, cookie containerization, and session state performance in Citrix, VDI, and FSLogix non-persistent desktop environments.Maintain golden images, optimize image provisioning, and troubleshoot browser behavior across virtual and physical Windows/ChromeOS endpoints.3. Advanced Troubleshooting & Observability

Perform deep-dive L3/L4 technical root cause analysis (RCA) on complex browser, authentication, extension, and network connectivity issues using tools such as Procmon, Sysinternals, Chrome DevTools, HAR capture, Fiddler, and Wireshark.Diagnose and resolve complex edge cases around SSL/TLS certificate chains, CORS, web proxy routing, and identity/SAML assertions.4. Automation & Self-Healing Workflows

Build scalable automation for operational tasks, endpoint health checks, and self-healing remediations using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Ansible.Implement orchestration for automated software deployment, browser extension management, and configuration audits integrated with ServiceNow or enterprise RPA tools.5. SRE & Operations Management

Apply SRE principles to the EUC ecosystem: define and monitor SLIs/SLOs, capture telemetry, and maintain real-time fleet health visibility.Execute controlled canary rollouts and automated rollback procedures for major browser updates, OS patches, and policy changes to eliminate production outages.Required Skills & Qualifications

Core Background

Proven Experience: 5+ years of production experience as an EUC Engineer, Endpoint Engineer, Browser Engineer, Workplace Technology Engineer, or Windows/Citrix EUC Specialist.Platform Depth: Hands-on ownership of large-scale browser management using Google Admin Console, Chrome Browser Cloud Management (CBCM), Intune/MECM, and Group Policy (GPO).

jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Senior Endpoint Engineer/Administrator (Level 3) responsible for the design, deployment, and advanced support of endpoint management solutions across a large, distributed physical and virtual device estate using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Microsoft Intune in a co-managed environment. Owns application packaging, third-party patch management, security vulnerability remediation, advanced PowerShell automation, and at-scale incident troubleshooting, partnering closely with Information Security, Networking, and Support teams to keep the endpoint fleet secure, compliant, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

Package, test, and deploy Windows and third-party applications through MECM and Intune (Win32 apps), using PSADT and other silent-install packages with reliable detection logic and dependency handling. MECM/Intune co-management experience: client settings, boundaries and boundary groups, deployment collections, Autopilot profiles, compliance policies, and configuration baselines across the enterprise endpoint estate. Design, write, and maintain advanced PowerShell scripts for automation, remediation, and reporting, including Intune and MECM. Identify, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities across the endpoint fleet in partnership with Information Security – driving CVE/patch-compliance reporting and mitigation timelines for OS and third-party applications. Third-party application patching lifecycle – identifying, packaging, testing, and deploying updates (e.g., via Patch My PC, MECM, application/patch deployment) to minimize vulnerability exposure windows. Networking knowledge (DNS, DHCP, IP addressing/subnetting, VLANs, boundary/content distribution) to resolve connectivity issues affecting client communication, application delivery, and patch distribution. Leverage AI-assisted tools (Claude, Copilot and other scripting assistants) and automation/orchestration to streamline packaging, remediation, and reporting – tracking work in JIRA and version-controlling scripts/configs in GitHub. Partner and collaborate with multiple technical teams (Architecture, Networking, Information Security, Support, etc.) to develop and support endpoint solutions. Triage and resolve escalations from Endpoint Support and Security, acting as a technical escalation point for Level 1/2 teams.

We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. Join FactSet's Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team as the Lead Infrastructure Operations Engineer, the senior technical owner of infrastructure operations at our Virginia data center.

You will combine hands-on engineering, project oversight, vendor and stakeholder management, and mentorship to keep the facility and its supporting infrastructure reliable, scalable, and cost-effective. As a key member of our collaborative team, you will be the point of contact between the data center, partner departments, and director-level stakeholders.

You will help ensure that the tools and processes behind our infrastructure keep improving. What You'll Do: 6+ Serve as the senior technical owner of infrastructure operations at the Virginia data center. Lead the enhancement of infrastructure software and hardware tooling to improve deployment, connectivity, and the user experience. Provide project management and technical oversight for large-scale technology rollouts and facility buildouts. Drive continuous improvement in infrastructure design, with a focus on autonomy and scalability. Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production issues, and act as the escalation point for infrastructure support. Partner with director-level stakeholders and other departments to align goals and integrate tools, systems, and projects. Manage contractor and vendor relationships to deliver regionalized services and contracts that are cost-conscious and beneficial to end users. Champion best practices, coach and mentor engineers, and foster technical excellence across the team. Monitor capacity across our infrastructure in the datacenter. What We're Looking For: Significant experience in data center or enterprise infrastructure operations, including hardware, networking, and systems support, with a record of increasing responsibility. Bachelor degree in computer science or related. Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and rollouts from planning through delivery. Experience with alerting, monitoring, and incident management in a production environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including with director-level and cross-departmental audiences. Experience coaching and mentoring engineers. Nice to Have: Experience negotiating and managing vendor and contractor relationships, particularly with telecoms. Experience with hybrid (on-premises and cloud) infrastructure environments. Scripting or automation skills used to improve operational tooling and deployment. Experience with facility buildouts, colocation, or regional service and contract management. Experience managing assets with ITSM and DCIM tooling. Company Overview:FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better.

Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support.

As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Job Description:
Overview:

We don't simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you - offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.

The Digital Workplace Engineer is part of the Digital Workplace Services team within Chatham's IT organization, focused on creating a modern, seamless technology experience for employees across the firm. This role on the team will focus on AI and automation, helping the firm scale intelligent, self-service solutions using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex, alongside tools like Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and PowerShell. In this role, you'll act as a modern solution evangelist within IT, working alongside a broader network of technology champions across the firm to drive adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace capabilities.

In this role you will:

Serve as a modern solution evangelist within IT, partnering with a firmwide network of technology champions to promote AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools-helping employees understand practical ways to apply these solutions to their work through articles, demos, webinars, and hands-on sessions.

jobs.description:
WELLTOWER – REIMAGINE REAL ESTATE WITH US

At Welltower, we’re transforming how the world thinks about senior living and wellness-focused real estate. As a global leader in residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure, we create vibrant, purpose-driven communities where housing, healthcare, and hospitality converge. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and endlessly ambitious—guided by our mantra: The only easy day was yesterday.

We’re looking for bold, independent thinkers who thrive on challenge, embrace complexity, and are driven to deliver long-term value. Every team member is empowered to think like an owner, innovate fearlessly, and lead from where they stand. If you're passionate about outcomes and inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure, we want you on our best-in-class team.

About The Role

Welltower is seeking a Digital Workplace Engineer with deep specialization in Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management. This role supports the design, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Welltower’s digital workplace ecosystem, with a primary focus on endpoint management, device security, application delivery, and user experience across Microsoft 365. The engineer will partner closely with Security, Identity, Service Desk, Infrastructure, and business teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable workplace technology services.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Workplace Engineering & Platform Ownership

Engineer and support modern digital workplace capabilities across Microsoft 365 and endpoint services. Maintain standards, configurations, documentation, and lifecycle practices for workplace technology platforms. Contribute to digital workplace roadmap execution with a focus on secure, reliable, and user-friendly experiences.

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Specialization

Lead Microsoft Intune design, implementation, governance, and operational management across Windows, iOS, and Android. Design and enforce device compliance policies, endpoint security baselines, configuration profiles, and enrollment strategies. Implement and optimize Windows Autopilot provisioning, device enrollment, zero-touch deployment, and device lifecycle processes.

Application, Patch & Configuration Management

Package, deploy, and maintain Win32, Microsoft Store, and mobile applications through Intune. Support software update rings, feature update policies, driver/firmware strategies, and patch compliance reporting. Troubleshoot application deployment failures, policy conflicts, and configuration drift to improve reliability and user adoption.

Endpoint Security, Access & Compliance

Partner with Security and Identity teams to align endpoint posture with Zero Trust principles and Conditional Access requirements. Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration, endpoint security policy deployment, attack surface reduction settings, and device risk remediation. Manage BYOD strategies including Mobile Application Management, app protection policies, and data protection controls.

Operational Support & Service Excellence

Provide Tier 2/3 escalation support for endpoint, application, compliance, and digital workplace service issues. Monitor endpoint health, compliance, deployment status, and service performance trends. Identify recurring issues and lead corrective actions, knowledge documentation, and service improvement initiatives.

Automation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Develop automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, and Intune reporting capabilities. Create operational reporting for device posture, application deployment, compliance, and remediation progress. Continuously improve endpoint performance, service reliability, and the employee technology experience.

Collaboration & Governance

Collaborate with Security, Identity, Service Desk, Infrastructure, Procurement, and business stakeholders. Participate in governance processes including change management, standards development, operational readiness, and documentation. Provide guidance and enablement to support teams for endpoint and digital workplace processes.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of this employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

TRAVEL

Minimal travel

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of experience in digital workplace, endpoint engineering, systems administration, or Microsoft 365 operations. Required specialization in Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, including Autopilot, enrollment, compliance, configuration profiles, and endpoint security baselines. Strong experience with Windows endpoint management, application packaging/deployment, update management, and troubleshooting endpoint policy behavior. Experience integrating or operating Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security controls in a modern workplace environment. Working knowledge of Conditional Access, Entra ID concepts, Zero Trust principles, and cloud-first workplace architecture. Hands-on scripting or automation experience using PowerShell; Microsoft Graph API experience preferred. Ability to translate technical standards into clear documentation, operational procedures, and support guidance. Strong troubleshooting, communication, collaboration, and ownership skills.

Preferred Skills

Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, SC-200, SC-300, or equivalent practical experience. Experience supporting M365 collaboration workloads such as Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, or Purview from an operational support perspective. Experience working with Service Desk teams, change management processes, endpoint governance, and enterprise technology standards. Experience with macOS management, Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise, or iOS/iPadOS management is a plus.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, drug screening, and verification of employment, education, and other credentials relevant to the position.

What We Offer

Competitive Base Salary + Annual Bonus Generous Paid Time Off and Holidays Employee Stock Purchase Program – purchase shares at a 15% discount Employer-matching 401(k) Program + Profit Sharing Program Student Debt Program – we’ll contribute up to $10,000 towards your student loans! Tuition Assistance Program Comprehensive and progressive Medical/Dental/Vision options Professional Growth And much more! https://welltower.com/newsroom/careers/

About Welltower

Welltower® Inc. (NYSE: WELL) an S&P 500 company, is the world's preeminent residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure company. Our portfolio of 1,500+ Seniors and Wellness Housing communities is positioned at the intersection of housing, healthcare, and hospitality, creating vibrant communities for mature renters and older adults in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada. We also seek to support physicians in our Outpatient Medical buildings with the critical infrastructure needed to deliver quality care.

Our real estate portfolio is unmatched, located in highly attractive micro-markets with stunning built environments. Yet, we are an unusual real estate organization as we view ourselves as a product company in a real estate wrapper driven by relationships and unconventional culture.

Through our disciplined approach to capital allocation powered by our data science platform and superior operating results driven by the Welltower Business System, we aspire to deliver long-term compounding of per share growth and returns for our existing investors – our North Star.

Welltower is committed to leveraging the talent of a diverse workforce to create great opportunities for our business and our people. EOE/AA. Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Vet

jobs.description:
Job Description

 Who We Are

HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.

We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and high-growth SaaS companies, to modernize operating models and embed data, automation, and AI into the core of how work gets done.

Our clients aren’t just upgrading technology. They are rethinking workflows, activating governed AI, and designing environments where humans and intelligent systems work side by side.

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long-term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

 The Role

HIKE2 is hiring a senior Master Data Management Engineer for its data and integration practice. You will architect and build resolved identity and relationship foundations for financial services clients.

 Own the end-to-end MDM and relationship-graph architecture on an engagement, from data modeling through integration, data quality, and governance. Design and configure match and merge logic, survivorship and trust rules, validation rules, and golden-record management. Build entity resolution, the golden record, and the graph, along with the pipelines that feed them and syndicate trusted master data back to consuming systems. Establish the data-quality baseline and the survivorship and stewardship operating model, including steward workflows and issue queues. Define the identity seam between the client identity platform and the MDM layer, turning an authenticated claim into a resolved party. Set engineering standards, document a repeatable delivery approach, and mentor and grow a small team. Collaborate with data governance, CRM and source-system owners, and business stakeholders, and translate complex MDM concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Requirements

The following is the depth we expect. A strong candidate is hands-on across most of these areas, not familiar with them in theory.

 Identity resolution and matching

 Design and implement deterministic and probabilistic match logic, configuring match rules, thresholds, and trust scoring, and tuning them over time to balance false merges against missed matches. Weight strong identifiers such as tax ID and date of birth above shared attributes like name and address, and handle nicknames, transliteration, and address standardization. Build and maintain crosswalks between each source system's local key and the canonical party identifier.

 Golden record and survivorship

 Design golden, or best, record construction with attribute-level survivorship and trust rules that define which source wins per attribute and why, with full lineage. Implement merge, unmerge, split handling, and manage record consolidation safely in production. Establish validation rules and the golden-record lifecycle: create, update, retire.

 Party and relationship data modeling

 Model the party domain across person, legal entity, household, and account, with relationships, hierarchies, crosswalks, and reference data. Design the relationship graph ontology: households, beneficial ownership (UBO) chains, advisor-to-client, entity-to-account, collateral, and exposure, with effective dating so relationships are time-valid. Define measurable data-quality metrics and the minimum required attributes for each domain.

 Data quality and stewardship

 Build automated data profiling and a measured baseline for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication. Implement data-quality rules, validation logic, and exception handling, and design steward workflows, issue queues, and dashboards that make stewardship efficient. Partner with governance to define master data policies, standards, and the stewardship operating model, and maintain data dictionaries per domain.

 Integration and pipelines

 Design inbound and outbound integration patterns to ingest source data and syndicate trusted master data back to operational, analytical, and reporting systems. Build ingestion and integration jobs, implement change data capture, and stand-up real-time resolve-and-lookup services with acceptable latency. Consume an authenticated claim from the identity platform and translate it to a resolved party identifier through the orchestration and integration layer.

 Cloud data platform

 Build on a modern cloud data stack, Azure preferred, using the medallion or lakehouse pattern across bronze, silver, and gold. Manage multiple environments (development, test, QA, production) with performance tuning, monitoring, and cost awareness.

 Graph engineering

 Implement the relationship graph on a property-graph store (Neo4j with Cypher, or Cosmos DB with Gremlin), keyed strictly on the canonical party identifier. Build graph queries and traversals for multi-hop questions such as UBO chains and advisor-to-borrower authorization, returning explainable, evidenced assertions with effective dates.

 Programming and platforms

 Strong SQL and proficiency in Python, with Java or .Net as needed to extend MDM platforms and build services. Hands-on with at least one enterprise MDM platform (Informatica MDM, Reltio, Semarchy, Ataccama, or Profisee) and the judgment to weigh build-lite on the existing stack against a packaged product. Comfortable with data governance and quality tool (for example Ab Initio or Collibra) and with workflow tooling.

 Security, governance, and regulatory

 Build for audit and regulatory review: full lineage, decision logs, and traceable survivorship. Apply KYC, AML, and beneficial ownership requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act, and handle PII, tokenization, and access controls appropriately. Desired ExperienceTen to fifteen years in enterprise data engineering and architecture, with master data management delivered in production, not just designed. Demonstrated ability to both architect and build, having designed the system and then implemented it, not a design-only background. Financial services required, private and commercial banking strongly preferred, where a client is at once a person, an entity, a household member, and a borrower, and where party is a regulated, first-class concept. Proven physical MDM design with a party model, and experience resolving duplicated or unresolved entities upstream in identity. Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms, including Ping, and how digital identity binds to data identity. Experience building for audit in a regulated industry, having survived a real audit or examination. AI-assisted MDM: intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship suggestions, and anomaly flagging, kept governed, auditable, and validated before promotion to master. Experience with the systems common to banking estates: core banking (for example Fiserv), CRM (for example Salesforce), loan origination and servicing (for example Broadridge), and client due diligence (for example Fenergo). A track record of mentoring or leading a small engineering team, and consulting or client-facing delivery experience. Exposure to externalized authorization or relationship-based access control, where the graph supplies context and a decision point applies policy.

 Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not mandatory. We value demonstrated, hands-on delivery above any credential, and a candidate certified on one platform who can clearly reason across others is stronger than one certification alone. A current certification in one or more of the following is a plus.

 MDM platforms

 Informatica: Professional or Practitioner certification in MDM, MDM SaaS or Cloud, or Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), and related Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) credentials. Reltio Certified Professional, for the Reltio Connected Data Platform. Semarchy xDM certification (Discovery or Practitioner). Ataccama ONE certification. Profisee certification, particularly for teams on the Microsoft and Azure stack.

 Cloud, data platform, and graph

 Microsoft Azure: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert, given our Azure-preferred stack. Databricks or Snowflake certification where the client stacks calls for it. Neo4j Certified Professional, or an equivalent graph credential, for the relationship graph work.

 Governance and adjacent

 Data governance or quality credentials such as Collibra Ranger, or the DAMA CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional). A recognized cloud security or privacy certification is a plus given the regulated setting.

The salary range for this position is: $125,000-$175,000+k/annually. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. This range is exclusive of any bonuses or commissions. HIKE2 offers a wide range of benefits for full time employees which may include medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more.

 Don’t meet every requirement? As an innovation consultancy, we recognize that talent is not always related to job history and skills come from valuable experiences that aren’t always shown on a resume. If you are excited to make a positive impact, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for our organization, whether it be this role or another.

If you require an accommodation to complete the application or participate in the interview process, please let us know.

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. At HIKE2, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

 US Citizenship Due to the nature of our client work, all applicants must reside in the U.S. and hold US Citizenship to be considered for employment. Hike2 cannot sponsor work authorizations or visas now or in the future.
