jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai http://Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox" security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection.

What You'll Do

You will lead Client Platform — the team responsible for the software that lives in customer environments and makes NodeZero's autonomous pentests possible. Client Platform owns two sub-teams: Image Build & Release (the factory that produces and signs the NodeZero runner container image) and OTA Services (the system that keeps runners current across thousands of customer environments). Every pentest NodeZero runs depends on this team's work being reliable, secure, and fast.

 - Team Building & Culture: Build, mentor, and grow Client Platform to ~10 engineers across Image Build & Release and OTA Services. You will directly manage the Engineering Managers of both sub-teams and set the technical and cultural direction for the full org. Establish engineering norms and a culture of ownership for a team whose software runs in environments you cannot control.

 - Image Build & Release: Lead end-to-end CI/CD workflows to create, sign, and reliably publish the NodeZero runner container image. Own software supply chain security: reproducible builds, image signing, SBOM generation, and vulnerability scanning in CI.

 - OTA Services: Architect and operate the over-the-air update delivery system that keeps NodeZero runners current across thousands of customer environments — reliably, securely, and without requiring manual customer IT intervention.

 - Security Research Partnership: Collaborate closely with Security Research to ensure the runner seamlessly executes new autonomous pentest capabilities as they ship.

 - Act as a Product Owner: Partner with product managers, security researchers, and customer success to manage the client-side roadmap.

What You'll Bring

Platform Leadership & Architecture

 - Demonstrated expertise leading teams that design, build, and operate containerized software (Docker, VM images) deployed into on-premise or customer-managed environments.

 - Experience implementing robust software supply chain practices — secure builds, image signing (cosign, Notary), reproducible builds, and vulnerability scanning in CI.

 - Experience designing and operating OTA update mechanisms for distributed agents or edge software at scale — including staged rollouts, rollback, and delivery verification.

 - Ability to reason about correctness in opaque, customer-controlled environments where you cannot observe failure modes directly.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

 - Experience building or significantly growing an engineering team — including hiring, onboarding, and establishing engineering norms tailored for shipped software.

 - Proven ability to define and instill engineering culture: rigorous code review standards, robust testing across diverse customer environments, and a strong culture of ownership.

 - Drives high-impact architecture decisions rigorously — requires design documents, runs structured reviews, builds consensus, and ensures decisions account for customer environment variables.

Technical Expertise

 - Proficient in Go (preferred), Python, or C++.

 - Strong Linux OS-level operations: container runtimes, networking in corporate environments, systemd, process isolation.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines for building and signing container images (cosign, Notary v2, or equivalent).

 - Familiarity with OTA update protocols and frameworks: TUF (The Update Framework), Omaha, or custom mechanisms.

 - Understanding of TLS, certificate pinning, and secure software delivery in hostile network environments.

Nice to Haves

 - Exposure to cybersecurity, pentesting tools, or vulnerability remediation.

 - Experience with cross-platform agents (Windows/Linux) and endpoint

Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

At Nutanix, you will have the opportunity to be part of the Ecosystem Integration team that drives core product integration with Nutanix Partners. You will be closely working with Partners, product management team and solution architect. The role requires deep technical acumen plus an ability to collaborate with various groups inside and outside of the company. The team fosters collaboration, innovation, and excellence, where every team member's contribution is valued and acknowledged. Working within this dynamic team, you will have the chance to learn from some of the best minds in the industry and work on cutting-edge projects that push the boundaries of technology.

About the Team

You will report to the Sr Director, Engineering and work in an onsite setup, where you will be required to be present in the office at least three days a week. This arrangement fosters a sense of camaraderie and allows for more seamless collaboration among team members, leading to increased productivity and creativity. Additionally, being in the office most of the week offers the chance to engage face-to-face with colleagues, enabling better communication and relationship building within the team

**Your Role**

- Contribute to the overall architecture, design and implementation of various integration.

- Ability to coordinate and influence internal and external groups (Solution, External partners, Cross functional engineering, product management) spread across geography.

- Develop a deep understanding of complex distributed systems, and design innovative solutions for customer requirements.

- Work closely with development, test, documentation and product management teams to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.

- Engage with customers and partners when needed to solve production issues.

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline with 5-8 years of industry experience

- Experience with Virtual Desktop Infrastructure and large-scale distributed systems preferred.

- Love of programming and rock-solid in one or more languages: C#, Python, Golang. Ideally for enterprise-quality software.

- Deep understanding of APIs and extensive experience of APIs development.

- Familiarity with MS technology and its stack including Azure Cloud

- Knowledge of AI tools and its usage in SDLC process.

**Visa sponsorship is not available for this role at this time.**

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real‑world problems with cutting‑edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We AreIn order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real‑world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real‑time problem‑solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job SummaryAs a Distinguished Engineer for Endpoint Engineering, you will be the chief architect and technical authority for Palo Alto Networks’ access agent platform. You will own the unified architectural vision across our core endpoint clients including GlobalProtect, Prisma Access Agent, ADEM, and many others spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. In this high‑visibility role, you will lead the evolution of our endpoint portfolio from distinct product agents into a unified, high‑performing platform foundation. By establishing shared networking, IPC, core application logic, and observability layers, you will ensure that every capability and performance optimization built in one agent automatically powers them all. Furthermore, you will define how endpoint software is engineered in an AI‑native world embedding automated defect verification, intelligent telemetry analysis, and smart crash triage into our global release pipeline. This is a high‑leverage "build‑the‑foundation" role with direct executive sponsorship, a clear evidence‑backed mandate, and an organization ready to execute under your vision.

Your ImpactDefine the Platform Architecture: Architect a high‑performance, modular core for networking, crypto, configuration, and telemetry that sibling products configure rather than rebuild.

Establish Secure Seams & Extensions: Create localized plugin models so that new auth methods, protocol extensions, or tunnel types land once and become immediately available across all platforms.

Systemic Quality & Reliability by Design: Own the endpoint architecture standardizing peer identity, least‑privilege decomposition, resilient error handling, and memory safety directly into type systems and CI/CD gates.

Pioneer AI‑Native Workflows & Supportability: Integrate AI‑driven software analysis, automated crash triage, and automated regression verification into standard build pipelines while driving unified crash analytics and product telemetry to maintain a world‑class Crash‑Free SLO across millions of active enterprise endpoints.

Drive Technical Excellence: Set engineering standards, author key Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), mentor principal and senior talent, and represent our technical strategy with customers and engineering partners.

QualificationsMinimum Qualifications

Seasoned and accomplished leadership in Endpoint systems development, core networking, and/or OS‑level software development.

Cross‑Product Impact: Track record of defining cross‑team architecture that was successfully adopted across multiple product groups.

Deep OS Internals: Expert hands‑on knowledge in at least two target platforms: Windows: Kernel/driver models, WFP, services, OS process architecture. macOS: XPC, System/Network Extensions, IOKit, code‑signing, notarization. Linux: Netlink, routing, network namespaces, DNS handling.

Legacy Refactoring: Proven experience decomposing complex C/C++ codebases into modular, testable components using incremental, safe refactoring patterns.

Technical Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to align senior engineers and executives behind complex architectural shifts.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands‑on experience with VPN, ZTNA, or SASE client technologies (IPsec/IKEv2, TLS/DTLS, QUIC/MASQUE, split tunneling, posture assessment).

Experience shipping multi‑platform agents at scale (millions of active endpoints) with staged rollouts and telemetry‑backed observability.

Background integrating AI/ML models into software engineering workflows (code review, test generation, defect triage).

jobs.description:
Description

 Leidos is seeking an experienced M365 Security and Compliance Administrator to join our Information Technology team. This role requires a seasoned professional who can strategically manage and enhance the security and compliance posture of the M365 environment within a GCC (Government Community Cloud) tenant, particularly in a federal agency context. This senior engineering role sits at the center of the organization’s device, identity, and M365 security ecosystem. The engineer is responsible for protecting enterprise Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS endpoints; ensuring compliant, reliable access to M365 services, and driving rapid engineering responses to vulnerabilities, outages, and operational risks. The successful candidate will apply with deep technical expertise, cross-platform engineering capability, and high operational security judgment.

Role Summary: Responsible for securing and maintaining compliance of the Microsoft 365 (M365) ecosystem and enterprise endpoints. Leads security governance, implements and enforces controls across M365, email, identity, devices, and telemetry, and provides incident response and audit/ATO support to ensure alignment with federal and organizational security requirements.

Must meet the following qualifications:

Bachelors Degree and 8+ years of experience. 4 additional years of experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.

Candidate MUST:

be a US Citizen or US Person with the ability to obtain a Public Trust level 5 clearance.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

Deep experience with Microsoft Defender (XDR, Endpoint, Cloud Apps).

Hands-on with Sentinel SIEM, and cross-platform telemetry pipelines.

Expert-level Intune engineering across Windows/macOS/iOS/iPadOS.

Advanced PowerShell for remediation, automation, and OS image manipulation.

Strong understanding of CAP architecture and identity risk enforcement.

Experience with ATO control evidence, compliance mapping, and audit support.

Soft Skills

Growth mindset and willingness to learn emerging security domains.

Strong cross-team collaboration (Cyber, Ops, EA, ICAM, Comms).

Excellent communication—clear summaries, user-impact translation, and documentation.

High reliability, ownership, and situational awareness during high-severity events.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience in federal security, high-compliance, or high‑assurance environments.

Experience with Jamf, Okta connectors, Copilot audit logging, Graph API operations.

Experience with mSCP baseline engineering and macOS security hardening.

Prior involvement in enterprise-wide Conditional Access enforcement.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic security oversight & governance

Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing management of M365 security policies, standards, and technical guardrails aligned to federal requirements and organizational controls.

Own governance for data protection capabilities including document classification, labeling, retention, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) using Microsoft Purview.

Email security & compliance management (Exchange Online)

Define and enforce email security policies such as encryption, sensitivity labeling, and secure mail flow to reduce unauthorized disclosure.

Implement and maintain email encryption solutions (S/MIME and/or Microsoft Information Protection) to protect confidentiality of email communications.

Administer and monitor anti-spam, anti-phishing, and anti-malware protections to defend against evolving threats.

Identity, access, and conditional access (Entra ID)

Engineer and validate device-compliance–based Conditional Access policies across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

Investigate and remediate Conditional Access failures, identity anomalies, and external/guest access issues, including M365 B2B trust and secure partner collaboration requirements.

Endpoint & device security engineering (Intune)

Design, test, and deploy Intune configuration and compliance policies for Windows, macOS, and iOS/iPadOS, including Enrollment Status Pages (ESPs) and OOBE workflows.

Develop remediation scripts (PowerShell/platform scripts/configuration profiles) to close compliance gaps and enforce security baselines.

Coordinate enterprise rollout of urgent vulnerability mitigations and validated vendor fixes; support vulnerability reviews and baseline rebuilds.

Risk management & compliance assurance (ATO / controls)

Establish and operate a risk management approach to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the M365 ecosystem.

Support ATO/control assessment activities by drafting implementation statements, collecting artifacts, and providing evidence aligned to audit/logging requirements.

Security monitoring, SIEM, and telemetry engineering (Defender / Sentinel)

Lead integration and operational management of Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel for threat detection, alerting, and response across M365.

Build and maintain SIEM integrations/connectors (e.g., M365, collaboration and identity systems) and develop ingestion pipelines (e.g., Azure Function Apps) for third-party logs.

Tune audit retention, analytic rules, and alert logic to improve signal quality and investigation readiness.

Incident response & operational support / collaboration

Provide Tier 3 troubleshooting for device compliance failures, identity/access incidents, telemetry gaps, and OS/app protection issues.

Partner with cross-functional teams to align security solutions with business objectives, deliver technical leadership, and support enterprise syncs and operational reviews.

Continuous improvement & innovation

Stay current on M365 security/compliance updates, industry trends, and emerging capabilities; drive improvements to security posture and operational efficiency (including use of GCC Copilot where appropriate).

Platform Scope / Tooling Microsoft 365 (GCC), Microsoft Purview (DLP/labels/classification/retention), Exchange Online, Entra ID & Conditional Access, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure (Function Apps / Log Analytics), plus integrations with collaboration/IT systems (e.g., ticketing and SaaS log sources).

“Day in the Life"

Morning

Review Sentinel incidents, Defender telemetry gaps, and compliance drift.

Respond to overnight CAP failures, Slack EMM issues, or OS update regressions.

Join device/enterprise standups.

Midday

Build/test remediation scripts (CVE fixes, NTLM disablement, compliance corrections).

Deploy or test Intune configuration profiles, ESP changes, or app protection updates.

Troubleshoot support cases with Microsoft (Purview DSPM, Copilot logs, Okta connector).

Afternoon

Conduct cross-team investigations (external-user access anomalies, Teams meeting forensics).

Validate CAP behaviors across platforms using test devices.

Work on ATO evidence packages and documentation.

End of Day

Update Jira tasks, Confluence documentation, and CR submissions.

Send status updates on active investigations, mitigations, and test results.

Please Note:

Please be advised that if you are moved to the interview stage, during the interview you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you

jobs.description:
AllSector Technology is growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, motivated IT professionals to join our team as Level 1 or Level 2 MSP Engineers.

This is not a role where you will spend every day doing the same repetitive tasks. As an L1/L2 Engineer, you will be at the heart of our client operations, providing comprehensive support that blends remote help desk calls with scheduled on-site client assistance. Beyond daily support, you will have the opportunity to directly assist senior engineers with complex client project implementations, gaining valuable real-world experience across a wide range of industries.

We provide an environment designed for growth. You will gain hands-on exposure to the latest IT platforms and technologies, including modern Microsoft Cloud solutions, advanced cybersecurity tools, and emerging automation/AI platforms (like Rewst.io and Copilot).

We are seeking individuals who are passionate about technology, genuinely enjoy problem-solving, and are committed to learning new things every day. While you will be part of a collaborative team, the ideal candidate must also possess the judgment and accountability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.

Responsibilities

While supporting our customers is the core of the position, our engineers are encouraged to become involved in much more than ticket resolution.

Core Technical Support:

Provide friendly, timely, and expert remote and onsite technical support to AllSector managed services clients.Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Windows desktop/server environments, hardware, applications, and peripherals.Support Microsoft 365 applications, Exchange Online, and core Azure/Intune services.Manage user accounts, permissions, and access issues within Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.Resolve networking, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall, and connectivity issues.Utilize RMM and monitoring platforms to proactively respond to alerts and investigate potential client issues before they escalate.Communicate clearly and professionally with customers regarding ticket status, updates, and resolutions.Maintain accurate and detailed documentation in IT Glue and create/update ConnectWise service tickets.

Projects & Advanced Initiatives:

Assist senior engineers with client technology projects, such as Microsoft 365 migrations and infrastructure upgrades.Participate in internal technology, automation, and AI initiatives.Help test new scripts, workflows, software integrations, and plugins in real-world environments.Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks using platforms like Rewst.io.

Qualifications

We do not expect candidates to be experts in every technology listed below, but you must demonstrate a strong technical aptitude and a genuine desire to learn and research unfamiliar technologies.

Company-Wide Requirements:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with both technical and non-technical users.Strong troubleshooting skills with a proactive, analytical approach to problem-solving.The ability to prioritize effectively and work well both independently and within a collaborative team environment.High standards for accountability, professional judgment, and quality documentation.Travel to clients

Travel Requirements:

This position may require occasional travel to client locations for on-site technical support, project implementations, installations, troubleshooting, and other client-related activities as needed. Most work will be performed remotely or from the AllSector Technology office; however, candidates must be comfortable providing on-site support when circumstances require it.Travel is primarily expected within the local/regional service area, with advance notice provided whenever practical. Candidates must possess a valid driver's license and have reliable transportation for travel to client locations.

Education & Professional Development:

College degrees and industry certifications are a plus, but equivalent hands-on experience, home labs, and technical projects are valued equally.We invest in you: AllSector Technology promotes continuous learning. We provide study materials, access to training platforms, and full financial support for relevant certification exams and courses for our staff.

Position-Specific Experience Levels:

Level 1 Engineer

Experience: 0–2+ years in professional IT.Technical Foundation: Solid understanding of desktop and end-user support, Windows 10/11 troubleshooting, Microsoft 365 fundamentals, basic Active Directory/Entra ID knowledge, and core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPNs).

Level 2 Engineer

Experience: 2–5+ years in professional IT (previous MSP or multi-client support experience preferred).Advanced Skills: Advanced Windows desktop troubleshooting and Windows Server administration; proficiency in Microsoft 365/Azure administration, Intune, and Group Policy; comprehensive understanding of networking (VLANs, firewalls, complex troubleshooting) and experience with RMM, Backup, and Endpoint Security platforms.

Why Join AllSector? Beyond Standard IT Support.

AllSector Technology is building something different. We believe an MSP should not only provide exceptional technology services to its customers — it should also create an environment where its employees can learn, experiment, contribute ideas, and build meaningful, long-term careers.

We are looking for ambitious candidates who want to grow with us as we expand. We aren't just maintaining legacy systems; we are actively innovating and operating at the intersection of modern IT services and software development.

When you join AllSector, you become part of an organization that is pushing boundaries:

We are Innovators & Developers: We don't just use other people's tools; we build our own. We have already developed and launched two proprietary software applications listed on The Tech Tribe and the ConnectWise Marketplace, with several more exciting apps currently in development. You will have a front-row seat to our internal software development and QA processes.

We are Impact-Driven (FCC, E-Rate, & Center4.com): We believe in helping those who help our communities. We are proud to hold a 498SPIN ID in the FCC Rural Healthcare program, helping eligible nonprofits secure subsidies upward of 65% off eligible technology costs. We are also registered providers in the E-Rate program, supporting schools and libraries. Furthermore, our Center4.com initiative acts as a technology entitlement think tank, providing nonprofits with vital information and free resources (templates, guides, E-books) to save them time and money.

We are Security-First: As a CISSP-Led IT Solutions Provider, we prioritize security in everything we do. You will gain exposure to enterprise-grade security frameworks and CISSP-backed offerings that set us apart from competitors.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted technical owner for our MDM platform and reliably drive initiatives from design through execution.

The ideal candidate should have strong Semarchy xDM and Master Data Management expertise, combined with solid data engineering, data analysis, team leadership, and business-facing communication skills.

Key Requirements

. 10+ years of relevant engineering and data experience.

            Strong hands-on expertise with Semarchy xDM. Deep understanding of Master Data Management concepts, including match/merge, survivorship, golden records, hierarchies, data quality, stewardship, workflows, and publishing/integration patterns. Proven experience implementing enterprise MDM solutions end-to-end, from requirements and data analysis through production implementation and support. Strong SQL, data profiling, and data analysis skills, with the ability to investigate anomalies, identify patterns, and drive root-cause analysis. Strong understanding of the underlying data domain and the ability to go beyond application configuration to understand source data, business processes, and downstream consumption. Solid data engineering background with experience building and supporting production-grade data pipelines. Experience with technologies such as Snowflake, Azure, ADF, dbt, Fivetran, Python, APIs, or comparable modern data technologies. Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, data governance, metadata, lineage, and stewardship concepts. Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch effectively between architecture, engineering, analysis, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement. Comfortable operating in a high-expectation, fast-moving environment with competing priorities and tight delivery timelines. Ability to provide hands-on technical leadership to onshore and offshore engineering teams. Experience reviewing and guiding technical designs, data models, SQL, pipelines, implementation approaches, and code. Strong ownership mindset someone who can take ambiguous problems, bring structure, make sound technical decisions, and drive them through completion. Strong curiosity about data and a genuine passion for solving difficult data problems. Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on identifying and addressing root causes rather than implementing short-term fixes. Outcome-driven, dependable, and committed to delivery. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong presentation skills and the ability to communicate effectively with Product Owners, Data Stewards, business stakeholders, architects, engineering teams, and senior technology leaders. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. Forward-looking mindset with an interest in modern engineering practices and AI-native approaches to data quality, automation, engineering productivity, and problem solving. Strongly Preferred

            Financial Services, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Capital Markets experience. Experience with Client, Customer, Organization, Contact, Account, Party, or similar master data domains. Salesforce integration experience. Experience modernizing or re-architecting an existing MDM implementation. Experience integrating MDM platforms with cloud data warehouses, operational systems, APIs, and downstream analytical platforms.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

 - Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

 - Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

 - Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

 - Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

 - Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

 - Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

 - Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

 - Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

 - Experience with OSquery and Santa

 - Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

 - Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote but if you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

* Experience working in global or multi-regional environments.

Job Description
We offer a competitive salary for this role, with an expected range of $70,600 to $89,400. The final offer will depend on your experience, skills, and overall qualifications. General Dynamics – Bath Iron Works also provides a variety of benefits including medical & dental insurance coverage, 401(k) retirement savings plan, flexible spending accounts/HSAs, life and disability insurance, company paid holidays, paid time off (PTO), health coaching, athletic trainers, employee assistance programs and onsite health services.

As part of the Endpoint Engineer team, the Endpoint Engineer III builds, administers, and maintains the client endpoint and mobile environment for Bath Iron Works under the direction of the Sr. Endpoint Engineer. The role executes established build standards and images, administers enterprise endpoint management tooling and mobile device management (MDM), develops PowerShell automation for defined tasks, and implements endpoint security configurations.

The Endpoint Engineer III serves as an L3 escalation point for the desktop and mobility technicians on documented complex issues and partners with the Infrastructure, Security, and Service Desk teams on project execution. Operating under the BIW Business Operating System (BOS), the Endpoint Engineer III ensures compliance with safety, quality, and performance standards while coordinating with other key stakeholders to meet overall milestones.

Key Responsibilities

 Safety Leadership:

 Comply with all BIW safety and security standards while working across office, manufacturing, and shipboard environments.
 Implement endpoint configurations that uphold BIW security and data-protection requirements, and follow established procedures when handling hardware, media, and sensitive data.

 Project Execution:

 Build and maintain client device images and standard build configurations for laptops, desktops, and mobile devices under the direction of the senior Endpoint Engineer.
 Administer enterprise endpoint management tooling (e.g., MCM) and MDM platforms for software deployment, patching, compliance reporting, and mobile device policy execution.
 Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate defined deployment, update, and endpoint administration tasks.
 Implement endpoint security configurations in alignment with BIW security policy, including antivirus, encryption, patching, and vulnerability remediation activities.
 Support endpoint lifecycle management activity, including hardware refresh execution and operating system upgrades across the estate.
 Other duties as assigned.

 Training and Development:

 Maintain and document working knowledge of endpoint platforms, management tools, and security practices. Pursue and obtain relevant certifications.
 Provide L3 guidance to the desktop and mobility technicians on documented issue types and grow technical depth under the mentorship of the senior Endpoint Engineer.

 Team Collaboration and Communication:

 Serve as L3 escalation for documented complex hardware, operating system, and application issues raised by Desktop Technician II; escalate architecture-level or undocumented issues to the senior Endpoint Engineer.
 Partner with the Infrastructure, Security, and Service Desk teams on assigned project execution and cross-team incident resolution.
 Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to technicians, peer IT teams, and stakeholders.

 Continuous Improvement:

 Identify opportunities to automate manual processes encountered during routine work and propose them for prioritization with the senior Endpoint Engineer.
 Contribute to technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles for endpoint tooling and procedures.

Required/Preferred Education/Training
Required:

 High school diploma or equivalent.

Preferred:

 Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Microsoft endpoint/Windows certifications (e.g., MD-102 Endpoint Administrator) and other relevant industry certifications.

Required/Preferred Experience
Required:

 Must be able to satisfy BIW background-check and site-access requirements.
 2–4 years of endpoint administration, senior desktop, or entry-level endpoint engineering experience in an enterprise environment.
 Hands-on experience administering an enterprise endpoint management platform (e.g., MCM), including image build, software deployment, patching, and compliance reporting.
 Working proficiency in PowerShell for endpoint automation, and working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, and identity management.
 Working understanding of core networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN) and endpoint security concepts (encryption, MFA, patching, and vulnerability remediation).

Preferred:

 Exposure to cloud-based endpoint management (Intune/Autopilot) and Entra ID, MDM administration, ServiceNow, Jira, and experience in a defense, manufacturing, or other regulated environment.

Company Description

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for an**Endpoint Management Specialist** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.**

**Key responsibilities:**

**Endpoint Operations \& Support**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and device management issues.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle and perform root cause analysis.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and device provisioning activities.

**Endpoint Management**

* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services.
* Configure and test device policies, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Monitor endpoint compliance and support remediation activities.
* Assist with device lifecycle management and deployment processes.

**Software Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package, test, and deploy software applications and updates.

jobs.description:
Dexian has an immediate opportunity available for a detail-oriented and motivated Endpoint Administrator with MS Intune experience to manage, maintain, and optimize a unified endpoint management environment for our premier aerospace customer. The Endpoint Administrator will be the primary point of contact for the deployment, configuration, compliance, and security of all corporate-owned and BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) endpoints. Utilizing the Microsoft 365 stack-specifically Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID-you will ensure seamless, secure hardware and software lifecycles across Windows and iOS platforms.

A typical workday may consist of the following duties as directed by the client:

Policy & Profile Management: Build, test, and deploy Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines to standardize client environments.Application Packaging & Deployment: Package, test, and distribute internal and third-party software updates, web links, and store apps across the enterprise.Modern Provisioning: Administer and monitor modern device deployment systems, such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager, ensuring a zero-touch or minimal-touch provisioning pipeline for new hires.Identity & Access Control: Collaborate with identity teams to manage device registration, primary user changes, group memberships, and targeted Conditional Access enforcement.Troubleshooting & Escalations: Act as the Tier 2/3 escalation point for device enrollment failures, application installation blocks, and profile synchronization issues.Reporting & Governance: Monitor Intune reporting dashboards daily to identify non-compliant devices, update patch status deficiencies, and remediate systemic configuration drift.Documentation: Maintain clear, concise documentation outlining deployment processes, app packaging standards, and device lifecycle flows.REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS:To be successful in this role, you should possess the following skills:

Security Stack Exposure: Familiarity integrating Intune with security tools like Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or implementing data protection via MAM (Mobile Application Management) without full device enrollment.Problem-Solving & Analytical Rigor: A structured, logical approach to debugging deployment failures, policy conflicts, and log file analysis.Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to explain technical enrollment steps or security restrictions clearly and empathetically to non-technical business professionals.Adaptability: Curiosity and willingness to stay current with Microsoft's continuous cloud release notes, feature changes, and best-practice evolutions.To be eligible for this position, you must meet or exceed each of the following:

Experience: Four to six (4 - 6) years of progressive experience in IT systems administration, with a minimum of 2-3 years dedicated specifically to managing and deploying policies within Microsoft Intune (Cloud-only or Hybrid/co-management configurations).Technical Ecosystem Knowledge: Solid foundation in Microsoft 365 workloads, including Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory), Conditional Access policies, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).Ability to install, configure, monitor and troubleshoot Microsoft and third-party enterprise applications across large endpoint environments.Maintain desktop and application packaging of standard, engineered, and tested configurations for remote distribution utilizing Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Intune.Managing endpoint configuration, compliance, and automation through enterprise tools such as MECM/SCCM, Intune, or similar technologies.OS Support: Demonstrated experience configuring, enrolling, and troubleshooting Windows 10/11 endpoints. Basic exposure to managing mobile operating systems (iOS) via MDM (Mobile Device Management) profiles.Scripting Essentials: Basic proficiency with PowerShell for writing, editing, and deploying automated scripts or application wrappers to endpoints.Performing post deployment remediation and cleanup patching using PowerShell or similar scripting tools to automate updates, enforce configuration baselines, and resolve inconsistent patch states.Core Infrastructure: Solid understanding of core networking and identity concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and modern identity provisioning.SECURITY CLEARANCE:This position requires an active Department of Defense security clearance at the SECRET level or ability to obtain and maintain this clearance. U.S. citizens ONLY are eligible for a security clearance and this position.

LOCATION:This is an on-site position, and the successful candidate may be based in one of the following locations: El Segundo, CA, Chantilly, VA or Colorado Springs, CO.EDUCATION and CERTIFICATIONS:Associate's degree or higher requiredPossession of or progress toward the Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) certification.COMPENSATION:Dexian reasonably expects to offer $38.00 - $45.00 per hour for this position based on location, skills and experience.Additional benefits include generous time off, health, vision and dental insurance and matching 401k.ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:Submit/Pass a 10-year background check, criminal history, drug screening, and fingerprints.Valid driver's license/Real-ID with clean driver's history.Applicants must have a strong work ethic, be extremely organized and detail-oriented, be a self-starter with excellent time management, problem solving, and multitasking skills.Excellent face-to-face customer service skills - at least 1 year experience in a customer service position, such as: call center, retail, or other customer facing role.Demonstrated problem solving skills with ability to research, resolve and complete tasks within pre-determined deadlines and schedules.Able to process work quickly and accurately despite interruptions, changing timelines and priorities, on a regular basis.Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Excel, and Word programs.Working knowledge of app/database ticketing systems. Knowledge of ServiceNow, a plus.Position may require dexterity and ability to sit, stand, walk extended distances.Keywords: Intune, Endpoint, MECM, SCCM

Dexian stands at the forefront of Talent + Technology solutions with a presence spanning more than 70 locations worldwide and a team exceeding 10,000 professionals. As one of the largest technology and professional staffing companies and one of the largest minority-owned staffing companies in the United States, Dexian combines over 30 years of industry expertise with cutting-edge technologies to deliver comprehensive global services and support.

Dexian connects the right talent and the right technology with the right organizations to deliver trajectory-changing results that help everyone achieve their ambitions and goals.To learn more, please visit https://dexian.com/.

Dexian is an Equal Opportunity Employer that recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

 As a Lead Infrastructure Engineer at JPMorganChase within Employee Platforms, you own the packaging, validation, and release execution for Office client software across a global virtual and physical desktop estate.

 In the Microsoft 365 Office Client Engineering space, you own the packaging, validation, and release execution for Office client software across a global virtual and physical desktop estate. You are accountable for getting validated updates and new capabilities onto the desktop safely, at scale, and on a predictable schedule. This is a hands-on engineering role with release accountability. You will build the test and deployment pipeline that turns a multi-week manual cycle into a repeatable run, define the ring strategy and go/no-go criteria that protect line-of-business add-ins and macros, and act as the technical escalation point with Microsoft. The environment is heavily customized and tightly controlled, so speed has to be earned through automation, evidence, and a rollback path that works.

Lead release planning and execution using pilot groups, deployment rings, quality gates, and rollback procedures. Automate deployment, testing, monitoring, and operational processes using scripting and infrastructure tools. Troubleshoot complex application and endpoint issues using logs, telemetry, and root-cause analysis. Serve as the technical escalation point for software releases, infrastructure incidents, and vendor support engagements. Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate infrastructure analysis and design documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements. Partner with application, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure compatibility, compliance, and operational readiness. Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted practices within delivery and automation routines to identify recurring issues and validate remediation options, ensuring changes are traceable/auditable and aligned to resiliency and security expectations. Deep experience with Microsoft Office 365 deployment, servicing, configuration, and support. Strong expertise with Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Intune, and endpoint management technologies. Experience managing enterprise software releases, deployment governance, validation, and rollback planning. Proven troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across endpoint and infrastructure platforms. Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity. Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations. Deep knowledge of one specific infrastructure technology and scripting languages. Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI-enabled workplace technologies. Experience supporting Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop, or similar virtual desktop environments. Experience with application compatibility testing, add-ins, and enterprise software packaging. Experience using telemetry, monitoring, and analytics tools to drive release and operational decisions. Experience implementing automation that improves operational efficiency and reduces manual effort.

jobs.description:
Job SummaryWe are looking for an experienced Device Management Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager) and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Device Management Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune (Endpoint Manager) and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The candidate will be responsible for designing, deploying, and managing modern workplace solutions, including device lifecycle management, application deployment, security compliance, and virtual desktop infrastructure on Azure.

 Key Responsibilities

Device Management (Microsoft Intune / MEM)

- Manage end-to-end device lifecycle (enrollment, configuration, compliance, retirement) for Windows, iOS, Android, and macOS devices using Microsoft Intune.

- Design and deploy configuration profiles, compliance policies, and conditional access policies in collaboration with the security team.

- Implement and manage Windows Autopilot for zero-touch device provisioning.

- Package, deploy, and update applications (Win32, MSI, LOB, Microsoft Store apps) via Intune.

- Manage Windows Update for Business rings, feature/quality update deployments, and patch compliance reporting.

- Implement endpoint security policies including BitLocker, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration, ASR rules, and device encryption.

- Handle mobile device management (MDM) and mobile application management (MAM/APP) policies for BYOD and corporate devices.

- Migrate devices from legacy management (SCCM/ConfigMgr, GPO) to modern cloud management, including co-management setups.

Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)

- Design, deploy, and manage AVD host pools, application groups, and workspaces.

- Create and maintain golden images using Azure Image Builder / custom images; manage image versioning via Azure Compute Gallery.

- Configure and manage FSLogix profile containers, including storage (Azure Files / Azure NetApp Files) and permissions.

- Implement autoscaling plans to optimize session host capacity and Azure consumption costs.

- Publish RemoteApps and full desktop sessions based on business requirements.

- Monitor AVD environment health, session performance, and user experience using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and AVD Insights.

- Troubleshoot session connectivity, profile load issues, latency, and host performance problems.

General / Cross-Functional

- Administer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) — device registration, hybrid join, group management, and conditional access.

- Automate routine tasks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.

- Maintain documentation — SOPs, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.

- Provide L2/L3 support for escalated endpoint and AVD incidents; work within ITIL-based incident/change management processes.

- Collaborate with security, network, and infrastructure teams on compliance audits and hardening initiatives.

- Stay current with Microsoft roadmap changes and recommend improvements to the modern workplace environment.

 Required Skills & Qualifications

- 4–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure/endpoint management, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune and Azure Virtual Desktop.

- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), conditional access, and identity-driven security.

- Proven experience with Windows Autopilot, application packaging, and compliance/configuration policy design.

- Hands-on experience with FSLogix, host pool management, image management, and AVD scaling.

- Solid PowerShell scripting skills; exposure to Microsoft Graph API is a plus.

- Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, proxy) as they relate to endpoint and AVD connectivity.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security baselines.

- Experience with SCCM/ConfigMgr and co-management scenarios preferred.

- Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

 Preferred Certifications

- MD-102: Microsoft 365 Certified – Endpoint Administrator Associate

- AZ-140: Configuring and Operating Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop

- AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator (nice to have)

- SC-300 or MS-102 (added advantage)

Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services. The North America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.Key Accountabilities• Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration.

• 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune administration and engineering experience supporting Windows and mobile platforms.
• 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join implementations.
• 2+ years of enterprise iOS/iPadOS device management experience using Intune and Apple Business Manager.

Other required technical skills:
• Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows management, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application packaging and deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management.
• Experience migrating SCCM and Group Policy-managed environments to cloud-native Intune management.
• Knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), and enterprise iOS deployment practices.
• Experience with Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, endpoint security baselines, compliance reporting, and governance requirements.

• Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, technical documentation, vendor engagement, roadmap planning, and stakeholder communication.

The Intune Engineer will ensure the secure, compliant, and efficient management of Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices while delivering an exceptional end-user experience.

The ideal candidate is passionate about endpoint management, automation, security, and modern workplace technologies. This individual will partner closely with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Identity & Access Management, Service Desk, and Digital Workplace teams to support key initiatives including Zero Trust, Microsoft 365 optimization, endpoint lifecycle management, and device modernization..

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Management & Engineering

Design, implement, and manage Microsoft Intune policies, device configurations, compliance policies, and endpoint security settings.

Administer and optimize Microsoft Endpoint Manager (MEM), Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft Defender integrations.

Develop and maintain device enrollment, provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management processes.

Security & Compliance

Configure and support Conditional Access policies integrated with Intune and Entra ID.

Support compliance initiatives related to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC, and other regulatory requirements.

Monitor and remediate endpoint vulnerabilities, configuration drift, and security risks.

Collaborate with Security Operations teams to strengthen endpoint detection, response, and threat mitigation capabilities.

Automation & Innovation

Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, and Power Automate.

Build proactive monitoring and remediation scripts to improve endpoint health and supportability.

Streamline onboarding, offboarding, device refresh, and lifecycle management processes.

Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Management technologies and recommend adoption opportunities.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve service delivery.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge articles.

Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.

Partner with Service Desk teams to improve support processes and reduce recurring issues.

Track and report key operational performance indicators and service-level objectives.

Provide recommendations to improve endpoint security, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, End User Services & IT Automation
jobs.summary: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks...
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

At Smartsheet, we're scaling our India Global Capability Centre, and we're hiring a Senior Manager to lead IT End User Services in a Mac-first environment.

You'll sit at the center of our AI and automation strategy for the service desk, leading two teams: Security & Desktop Systems, who pair Service Desk support with first-line security triage, and IT Automation, who build the AI agents and workflows that make that work faster. You'll decide where agents, deterministic automation, and people each belong, and own your teams' performance against SLAs and quality targets.

You'll partner daily with our US IT leadership, aligning on standards and sharing what works. For the right candidate, there is a clear path to Director within 12-18 months as we continue to scale the India GCC.

**A note on the role:** This is a hands-on leadership role, though not a hands-on-every-day one. You'll stay close enough to the technology to prototype, review, and debug alongside your engineers, and to step in when the team is stretched or something breaks. If you want to lead from a distance, this isn't the right fit. If you want to lead from credibility, it is.

#### You Will

**AI & Automation Strategy**

- Own the AI and automation strategy for the service desk, lead the IT Automation Engineers in delivering it, and decide which workflows suit AI agents, deterministic automation, or people
- Identify high-volume, repetitive Tier 1 work, prioritise it by impact, and ensure it is automated and measured
- Apply AI where it meaningfully reduces toil (e.g. intelligent ticket triage, SOC alert summarisation, AI-assisted knowledge base drafting), and design and review agent-based workflows end to end, including the tools they call and where a human approves
- Set guardrails for automated actions, including identity verification, least-privilege access, permissions-aware data retrieval, audit logging, and human approval for sensitive requests
- Set automation standards, review technical designs before deployment, and help build, debug, and fix automations when they fail or stall

**Security & Desktop Systems**

- Lead the India-based Security & Desktop Systems Specialists, working daily with US counterparts and peer service desk managers in other regions to align priorities, coverage, and ways of working
- Own team performance against SLAs, quality standards, and service desk metrics, and drive continuous improvement
- Oversee resolution of tickets across hardware, software, network, and user access
- Own desktop administration across a Mac-first fleet (macOS and Windows), including software deployment, system configuration, user provisioning, enrollment, and hardware lifecycle management
- Step in hands-on when volumes spike or critical issues arise, and coach people through the fix
- Keep knowledge base articles and process documentation current, high quality, and consistently maintained

**Security Operations (Tier 1)**

- Oversee the team's first-line SOC responsibilities, including alert triage, escalation, and response
- Ensure the team follows incident response playbooks, and improve them as threats and tooling evolve
- Partner with the wider security organisation so Tier 1 handoffs are fast, accurate, and well documented
- Track SOC quality and response metrics, and build the team's security capability over time
- Balance support and security workload so neither is neglected as volumes change

**People Leadership**

- Set clear direction, track progress, remove blockers, and escalate capacity constraints
- Partner with peer managers across regions to align service standards, share automation and best practices, and keep the global service desk experience consistent
- Design and lead onboarding for new team members
- Coach and mentor India-based engineers and specialists, support their career growth, and hire and develop top technical talent

#### You Have

**Experience**

- 8+ years in IT support, Service Desk, or end user services operations, with deep working knowledge of the systems and processes involved
- 4+ years leading technical support teams in matrixed or distributed organisations, including influencing peers and stakeholders across regions without direct authority
- Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM capabilities to IT workflows, such as function/tool calling, MCP, or API-based orchestration, and the judgment to know when to use agents, deterministic automation, or humans
- Experience overseeing Tier 1 security operations, such as alert triage, escalation, and incident response, ideally including endpoint (EDR) alerts
- Experience leading engineers who build automation or integrations, with enough technical depth to review their work, set direction, and contribute when needed
- A track record of setting direction and delivering cross-functional projects through ambiguity, and of stepping into technical problems credibly when the team needs it

**Technical skills**

- Strong hands-on expertise in macOS endpoint management through Jamf (or a comparable Apple MDM such as Kandji or Mosyle), including zero-touch enrollment, policy and patch management, and Apple Business Manager. Our fleet is roughly 80% macOS.
- Working knowledge of Windows endpoint management through Intune, covering the remaining 20% of our fleet
- Solid understanding of identity and productivity platforms (Okta, Entra ID, or Active Directory; M365)
- Working knowledge of an ITSM platform such as Freshservice, including workflow design, API integrations, and governance
- Working knowledge of scripting or programming (Python, PowerShell, or shell) sufficient to review and contribute to automation work
- Familiarity with EDR platforms (including macOS coverage), firewalls, and ITIL or equivalent frameworks

**Preferred**

- Experience building agents with LLM APIs/SDKs or agent frameworks, including retrieval (RAG) over IT knowledge
- Experience building and scaling a service desk or IT automation function

**Work Style**

- Excellent English communication, strong self-motivation, and reliable follow-through
- Comfortable moving between leading the team and rolling up your sleeves
- Willing to join a short early-morning call for US handover, and the occasional evening global meeting
- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

If you meet most of this but not every bullet, we'd still like to hear from you.

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

The M365 Engineer - Modern Workplace implements, administers, and supports business-focused Microsoft 365 services across SharePoint Online, Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, and Copilot. This role partners with business and technical teams to deliver secure, reliable, well-governed collaboration, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled workplace solutions. The engineer serves as an escalation point for complex incidents and service requests, supports platform governance and adoption, and maintains documentation, standards, and automation to improve operational efficiency.

Job Description
Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. To be considered, candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship as security clearance is required.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Modern Workplace Platform Administration & Governance: Administer and support SharePoint Online, Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, and Copilot capabilities with an emphasis on governance, lifecycle management, reliability, and service health.

SharePoint Online & Content Collaboration: Support collaboration sites, content management, permissions, site architecture, document management, adoption, and information governance practices across SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 workloads.

Business Enablement & Low-Code Solutions: Partner with business stakeholders to identify automation, workflow, reporting, and digital transformation opportunities using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, and related platform capabilities.

Microsoft Fabric & Analytics Support: Support Fabric and Power BI administration activities that enable data integration, dataflows, reporting, business intelligence, and analytics use cases in alignment with organizational governance standards.

Azure Services Management: Administer Azure services that support Modern Workplace solutions, including subscriptions, resource groups, storage accounts, serverless services, application integrations, automation, and operational governance outside of Entra ID administration.

Copilot Readiness & Adoption: Support Copilot for Microsoft 365 readiness, governance, adoption, communication, end-user enablement, and related operational processes.

Integration & Automation: Automate administrative and operational tasks using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform automation, Azure Automation, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and other scripting or integration technologies as appropriate.

Security, Compliance & Change Management: Partner with security, compliance, infrastructure, networking, and service desk teams to maintain a secure, stable, and compliant environment while supporting change management, release planning, DLP, retention, access controls, and platform governance activities.

Escalation, Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Serve as an escalation point for complex Microsoft 365 incidents and service requests; develop and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, standards, operational procedures, training materials, and adoption resources; and mentor or provide knowledge transfer to support staff as needed.

Continuous Improvement & Microsoft Roadmap: Monitor platform health, licensing, service advisories, Message Center updates, Azure and Microsoft 365 roadmap changes, emerging AI and collaboration capabilities, and recommend improvements that strengthen reliability, security, user experience, and operational efficiency.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, related field, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.

EXPERIENCE:

3+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment.

Experience administering and governing SharePoint Online and related collaboration workloads.

Experience with Microsoft Viva, Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, or similar business solution platforms.

Experience supporting Microsoft Azure services related to Modern Workplace solutions, including platform governance and application integrations.

Experience supporting Copilot for Microsoft 365 readiness, adoption, governance, or enablement activities.

Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Power Platform automation, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, or similar scripting and automation technologies.

Familiarity with security and compliance concepts such as MFA, Conditional Access, DLP, retention policies, and information governance.

Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently on complex incidents, problems, and service requests.

COMPETENCIES - SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES:

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to business and technical audiences.

Business acumen and the ability to translate business needs into feasible Microsoft 365, Azure, automation, reporting, and collaboration solutions.

Self-directed, highly motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic enterprise environment.

Ability to quickly learn new Microsoft technologies, business processes, and platform capabilities.

Ability to partner effectively with security, compliance, networking, infrastructure, service desk, business units, and vendor partners.

Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, service health management, operational documentation, and continuous improvement practices.

Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearance.

Knowledge in the area of NIST compliance strongly desired.

Compensation for this position is $75,000-$120,000 annually, depending on experience.
