jobs.summary: **DataSpurs** es *Partner Platinum en España y Portugal de Informatica by SalesForce* . Con un equipo liderado por personas con una dilatada trayectoria reconocida dentro del sector, como compañía se centra en su único ámbito de actuación en el que es...
jobs.description:
**DataSpurs** es *Partner Platinum en España y Portugal de Informatica by SalesForce* . Con un equipo liderado por personas con una dilatada trayectoria reconocida dentro del sector, como compañía se centra en su único ámbito de actuación en el que es especialista: ***Data*** . En DataSpurs defendemos una ***alta especialización*** para la definición, desarrollo e implantación de soluciones en el ámbito de *Big Data, Data Governance y Cloud Data Management*, especialmente con productos de la Plataforma Informatica IDMC.

Nuestro modelo de negocio está centrado en la realización de acciones puramente de *consultoría estratégica* en *cliente final*; nuestro crecimiento no viene determinado por la asignación de consultores a clientes, sino por la incorporación de personas a un equipo interno que contribuyan a desarrollar conocimiento y soluciones que posteriormente serán implantadas en cliente para dar respuesta a esas acciones de consultoría estratégica.

Debido al proceso de desarrollo interno que *DataSpurs* está atravesando, en la actualidad queremos ampliar el equipo dentro del áreade consultoría con perfiles de **CONSULTOR** para iniciativas de **Master Data Management (MDM)** . Incorporando a una persona con amplia trayectoria técnica para nuestra oficina de **MADRID** en un modelo de trabajo principalmente en remoto.

**FUNCIONES**:

Participará activamente en la puesta en marcha de iniciativas de MDM multidominio en entornos Cloud o híbridos, contribuyendo en la definición de la estrategia y enfoque más adecuado en función de las distintas casuísticas planteadas ya sea en el ámbito técnico y/o funcional. Contribuirá al diseño de soluciones realizando, entre otras funciones:

* definición e implementación del *framework* de MDM para garantizar una única fuente de verdad (*single source of truth*) en los datos más críticos de la organización
* consolidación e integración de datos maestros provenientes de múltiples sistemas origen (ERP, CRM, *eCommerce* , etc.) con diferentes patrones de ingesta (*batch, realtime, cdc*...)
* diseño y creación de reglas de calidad, limpieza y duplicación de registros inconsistentes o duplicados
* definición de políticas de gobierno de datos y flujos de trabajo (*workflows*) para establecer reglas claras sobre la creación, modificación y mantenimiento de datos maestros
* definición de las reglas de *match, merge, survivorship* para la generación del*golden record*
* modelado de datos maestros y diseño de arquitecturas para la distribución de la versión correcta de los datos a todos los sistemas consumidores
* gestión de requerimientos con el cliente y colaboración estrecha con otros miembros del equipo

**REQUISITOS**:

* experiencia previa de 3 años en proyectos de gestión de datos, idealmente enfocados en Master Data Management (MDM)
* conocimientos sólidos de:
* modelado de datos (modelos relacionales) y lenguaje SQL
* arquitecturas de datos y flujos de integración
* aspectos funcionales en los distintos procesos de negocio involucrados en la gestión de datos maestros (clientes, proveedores, productos)
* definición de reglas: calidad y aplicabilidad de las reglas de calidad propuestas
* experiencia real y demostrable con herramientas líderes de mercado, con especial interés en Informatica MDM (MDM cloud / IDMC), o soluciones similares como *SAP Master Data Governance, IBM Master Data Management, Stibo Systems o Semarchy*
* alta capacidad de interlocución con los diferentes *stakholders* implicados
* capacidad para trabajar en entornos ágiles y colaborativos
* perfil analítico, orientado a la calidad y resolución de problemas

**IMPORTANTE**:

* CERTIFICACIONES: debido al nivel de *partnership* que mantenemos y el *expertise* ofrecido, se mantiene un programa de certificaciones muy activo ayudando al equipo a obtener las certificaciones necesarias

**¿POR QUÉ DATASPURS?:**

* Visión a largo plazo: incorporarmos profesionales para que crezcan con nosotros en nuestras disciplinas clave, más allá de contrataciones para proyectos concretos
* proyectos tecnológicamente punteros y de alta especialización en el área de Data Management
* trabajo principalmente en remoto y flexibilidad horaria
* programa de inglés individualizado y 100% financiado por la compañía
* entorno de trabajo con calidad y calidez, en contenido y forma
* retribución flexible (cheques restaurant, seguro médico, cheque guardería)
* desarrollo profesional personalizado, considerando los intereses y motivaciones de cada persona
* ambiente de trabajo: informal a la vez que altamente profesional y competente

*DATASPURS está comprometida con la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de trato, promoviendo una política transparente de atracción, selección y contratación que garantice la igualdad de oportunidades a todos los candidat@s, sin hacer ninguna exclusión por motivos de sexo, edad, raza u otra condición no relacionada con el buen desempeño del puesto que se desea cubrir.*

jobs.description:
Create a better #TomorrowWithUs 🚀

At Siemens, we build technology solutions to shape the world we live in. We transform industries and societies by combining the real and digital worlds. With over 300.000 of the world's most forward-thinking minds and the power of a presence in more than 190 countries, we make a truly global impact.

The Cyber Defense Endpoint Detection and Response specialist is a member of the Siemens Cyber Defense Center, whose primary mission is to defend Siemens against cybersecurity threats worldwide.

This role combines hands-on technical expertise in close collaboration with multi-disciplinary Cyber Security Team members (Security Analysts, Threat Hunting, Incident Response, Data Science, SecDevOps, Threat Intelligence etc) to help improving Siemens cyber threat protection posture. As an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) specialist, you should have a team-oriented, client-facing mindset and proven experience in EDR infrastructure and platform deployments.

You will play a key role in supporting the design, deployment, configuration, optimization, operation, and monitoring of large-scale EDR deployments across Siemens using leading vendor technologies. This role requires the ability to respond to a wide range of issues, from enhancing existing detection and prevention measures to maintaining and expanding deployments and supporting customer end users.

Are you ready to be part of the change? Come join us! ⭐

Your mission will be..

* Actively contribute to an international team of Siemens cybersecurity professionals supporting globally deployed EDR solutions.
* Be engaged in the evaluation, design, implementation and management of new approaches leveraging the EDR solutions and capabilities of our state-of-the-art detection platforms.
* Interface with cybersecurity groups across business units and with supported end users to resolve EDR-related challenges.
* Contribute to cybersecurity-related events and provide status information to the management team to support effective response and decision-making.
* Help improve Siemens' security posture by supporting governance policies, increasing EDR coverage, and maintaining a strong company-wide security posture.
* Help drive new EDR capabilities by applying automation methods, API-based integrations, and CI/CD approaches.
* Contribute to knowledge creation and sharing.
* Participate in 24x7 on-call support for EDR platform management and vendor escalation.

We are looking for someone with...

* Minimum 2 years of practical proven experience with CrowdStrike Falcon Platform administration.
* Availability for performing 24x7 On Call Management Support.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Good interpersonal communication skills and strong collaboration in international and virtual teams.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with peers, partners, and customers especially in translating security topics into business language.
* Proactive monitoring and ownership mentality while maintaining a collaborative international group approach to support our Global EDR deployments.
* Operating system (Windows and Linux) advanced troubleshooting knowledge.
* Experience writing structured technical documentation.
* University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a similar field, or equivalent overall experience in cybersecurity.
* Willingness to build up and share your technical knowledge.
* Ability to travel internationally and nationally as business and time permits.

jobs.description:
The L2 Endpoint Engineer is responsible for **administration, support, and optimization of Apple device management platforms** , primarily **JAMF Pro** , covering **macOS and iOS/iPadOS devices**.

This role includes **device lifecycle management, application packaging \& deployment, patching, policy enforcement, and compliance management** . The engineer is expected to **troubleshoot complex Apple endpoint issues and ensure a seamless user experience**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**JAMF Platform Administration**

* Administer and support **JAMF Pro** environment
* Manage:
* Device inventory and smart groups
* Policies and configuration profiles
* Enrollment workflows (DEP/Automated Device Enrollment)
* Monitor JAMF health, sync status, and device communication

**Device Lifecycle Management (macOS \& iOS)**

* Handle end-to-end lifecycle:
* Enrollment (Automated \& manual)
* Provisioning and configuration
* Decommissioning
* Support:
* macOS devices (laptops/desktops)
* iOS/iPadOS devices (iPhones, iPads)
* Ensure devices are compliant with corporate standards

**Application Packaging \& Deployment (macOS)**

* Package and deploy applications using:
* PKG / DMG formats
* JAMF policies
* Handle:
* App testing and validation
* Version upgrades and patching
* Troubleshoot installation failures and dependency issues

**Patch Management (macOS \& iOS)**

* Manage OS and third-party patching using JAMF
* Define and deploy patch policies and schedules
* Monitor patch compliance and remediation
* Troubleshoot patch deployment failures

**Policy \& Configuration Management**

* Create and manage:
* Configuration profiles (Wi-Fi, VPN, security settings)
* Restrictions and compliance policies
* Integrate with:
* Apple Business Manager (ABM)
* Identity providers (Azure AD / Okta)
* Ensure alignment with security baselines

**Incident \& Problem Management**

* Act as L2 resolver for:
* Device enrollment failures
* Application deployment issues
* Patch failures
* Policy conflicts
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues
* Escalate to L3/vendor with proper logs when required

**Automation \& Scripting**

* Use scripting for automation:
* Bash / Shell scripting (primary for macOS)
* Basic Python (good to have)
* Automate:
* Application deployments
* Device configurations
* Remediation tasks

**Compliance, Reporting \& Documentation**

* Generate reports on:
* Device compliance
* Patch status
* Application deployment success
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge base
* Support audit requirements

**Collaboration \& Support**

* Work with L1 team for triage improvements
* Collaborate with:
* Security teams (compliance \& policies)
* Identity teams (SSO, conditional access)
* Provide clear communication to end users and stakeholders

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

**Technical Skills (Core)**

* Strong hands-on experience in:
* **JAMF Pro administration**
* macOS device management
* iOS/iPadOS device management (MDM)
* Good understanding of:
* Apple Business Manager (ABM)
* Automated Device Enrollment (DEP)
* Apple Volume Purchase Program (VPP / Apps \& Books)

**Packaging \& Scripting**

* Application packaging:
* PKG / DMG
* Scripting:
* Bash / Shell (mandatory for macOS support mindset)

**Integration Knowledge**

* Identity integration:
* Azure AD / Okta (preferred)
* Basic understanding of:
* Certificates, profiles, and device trust

**Process Knowledge**

* ITIL processes:
* Incident, Problem, Change Management
* Experience in patch cycles and compliance reporting

**Soft Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting mindset (must understand Apple ecosystem behavior)
* Clear communication with global users
* Attention to detail (Apple policies can be strict and sensitive)

**Experience \& Education**

* 3--6 years of experience in Apple endpoint / JAMF support
* Bachelor's degree in IT or related field
* Certifications (good to have):
* JAMF 100/200
* Apple Device Support

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Device compliance rate (%)
* Patch compliance (macOS \& iOS)
* Application deployment success rate
* Incident resolution time (MTTR)
* Reduction in repeat issues
* User experience / CSAT

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 SR. IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR (TOP SECRET CLEARANCE)

SpaceX is looking for a Sr. Systems Administrator with deep knowledge and broad experience across Microsoft-based technologies, in addition to broader experience and capability with networking and Linux technologies. This employee will be a member of the Information Technology team and will support SpaceX personnel and systems. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast paced and challenging environment. He or she should be a self-starter, self-motivator and possess ingenuity to excel at this position.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Work closely with other SpaceX IT administrators and engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support enterprise software platforms and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams. Build highly-resilient, high-performance, scalable, and flexible systems.

- Take lessons learned and technology standards from the SpaceX Enterprise and apply them in smaller air-gapped environments.

- Exercise a high degree of responsibility for the processes, systems, and tools you create and manage; all supporting the goal of making humanity an interplanetary species.

- Make recommendations, justify, and implement improvements using an accepted change control methodology.

- Work within a diverse group to design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner by interacting with internal business units.

- Define, document and follow standards and best practices for systems design, testing, and implementation.

- Drive scripting and automation to develop solutions to common problems.

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 4+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Experience with Windows servers in physical and virtualized enterprise level environments.

- Experience with Active Directory, Kerberos, and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with networking technologies and the Linux operating system environment.

- PowerShell scripting experience.

- Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Significant experience designing, deploying, supporting and troubleshooting classified networks.

- Working knowledge of Windows-based systems and services, including the ability to set up, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot.

- Expert working knowledge (including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot) Windows-based systems and services such as DHCP, DNS, IIS, MS-SQL, NPS, etc.

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identity environments

- Experience with Enterprise Microsoft Exchange and SharePoint deployments.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Hands-on experience with Windows Server 2012/2016 (AD, DNS, DHCP, etc.)

- Experience in IPv4, switching, routing, firewalls and HA architecture.

- Must be comfortable working with mission critical and sensitive systems, with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Active Top Secret or TS/SCI with Polygraph. Note that an active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions. If so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.

- Willing to work after-hour on-call rotations, extended hours, and weekends when needed.

- Must be willing to do some travel domestically (<10%) in the future as needed.

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $150,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Position Summary

The Endpoint Administrator II is responsible for the deployment, configuration, management, and security of endpoint devices across the CallTower organization. This role focuses on Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, Windows and macOS device management, and modern endpoint administration practices.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a dedicated Endpoint Engineer to join our client's technology team as an embedded, full-time engineering resource. * Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 administration and optimization
* Working knowledge in Cisco Meraki and foundational networking concepts

* Experience creating technical documentation and runbooks
* Ability to work independently as an embedded team member
* Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
* Ability to travel to the United States approximately 10% of the time
* Knowledge of AI capabilities and practical business applications is a plus

jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is where millions of people hang out every day - 90% of them play games, spending over 5 billion hours across thousands of titles each month. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Client Platform Data Science team, where you’ll help make sure that Discord just works. You’ll partner with the teams that design, build, and support Discord - improving app performance, enhancing the user experience, and driving growth. Your work will span strategic analyses, experimentation, and dashboarding. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can help us take Discord’s mobile and desktop reliability to the next level through better metrics, monitoring, and automation.

If you’re passionate about data and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

 What you'll be doing

- Partner with teams throughout Discord through the full analytics lifecycle - from exploratory analyses to dashboards, reports, and A/B testing

- Define KPIs and diagnostic metrics that improve the user experience, and build dashboards to make them timely and actionable

- Build custom datasets to monitor novel product features and processes

- Share insights with technical and non-technical audiences, and iterate based on feedback

- Champion A/B testing best practices - helping teams design, analyze, and interpret experiments correctly

- Collaborate with data and engineering teams to design scalable and future-proof instrumentation and self-serve tooling

 What you should have

- 2+ years of hands-on analytics experience turning ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable insights

- Experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting A/B tests at scale

- Strong SQL skills and experience building clean, performant dashboards (Tableau, Looker, or similar)

- Clear communication skills, with the ability to make complex findings easy to understand

- Curiosity, a collaborative attitude, and a drive to solve hard problems

 Bonus Points

- Passion for Discord or online communities

- Experience with performance/reliability analytics for online services

- Familiarity with social or subscription products (social graphs, LTV, funnel analysis)

- Production ETL or BigQuery experience

- Experience using AI in data science work

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $160,000 to $200,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

 Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Channel to help drive NinjaOne’s expansion into the enterprise market.  Proficiency in Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting). Familiarity with Linux/macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting. Develop self-healing capabilities for device health, application performance, configuration drift, compliance gaps, network connectivity, and Microsoft 365 experience issues. Use NQL and platform analytics to identify trends, root causes, and automation opportunities. Translate telemetry and UX data into actionable recommendations for IT and business stakeholders. Employee Engagement & Digital Adoption Design and manage Nexthink Campaigns to gather feedback, measure sentiment, and drive digital adoption through targeted communications and guided remediation. At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The System Solutions team is seeking a Senior Principal Systems Engineer to lead the definition, development and evolution of complex aerospace systems through strong systems engineering and architectural expertise. This role will own system architecture decisions, establish technical direction and provide technical leadership across engineering teams to enable the successful implementation and adoption of system solutions.

The ideal candidate will bring deep systems engineering expertise and hands-on experience across system architecture, requirements management, engineering automation, verification, validation and aerospace certification processes. The candidate will translate complex technical and business needs into scalable system architectures, establish engineering approaches and best practices, and provide technical guidance across multiple stakeholders and engineering disciplines.

Experience with DevSecOps frameworks, aerospace development standards such as ARP4754, Digital Engineering and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) is highly desirable. Experience applying these practices to modernize and automate systems engineering processes is especially valuable.

If you are passionate about advancing systems engineering through automation, collaboration and innovative technologies, we encourage you to apply.

This is a hybrid position based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

What You Will Do:

MBSE Strategy and Development:

Lead the systems engineering team through all phases of system product development including stakeholder’s requirements capture, behavioral analysis, system architecture design, system verification, system validation and life-cycle product support.Lead the definition, development, and execution of the System Solutions strategy and roadmap for System Solutions.Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams to enable effective adoption, continuous improvement and support to programs across different business units.

Collaboration and Coordination:

Support coordination with System Method Representatives and System Discipline Boards by providing technical inputs, aligning priorities, and ensuring system engineering needs are represented.Support external stakeholder collaboration, such as with the Digital Product Lifecycle (DPLC) Technical Advisory Board, through alignment and dependency meetings and collaboration on System capabilities and initiatives.Work closely with System Solutions teams and the System Program Manager to coordinate dependencies, enable knowledge transfer across teams. Provide technical inputs, status, risks and recommendations.

Additional Responsibilities:

Support proposal and business development activities leveraging System engineering methodologies and automation practices.Mentor and train junior systems engineers, ensuring the long-term growth of expertise within System Solutions team. Travel up to 15% as needed to support program and collaboration efforts.

Qualifications You Must Have:

Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experienceExperience in multiple areas of the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements development, design, integration, verification, validation, and technical documentation. Ideal candidate will have experience across the full development lifecycle for civil certification programs.Hands-on experience applying ARP4754 throughout the system development lifecycle.Experience with requirements management tools (Jama, Polarion, DOORS)Experience/Interest in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) principles and tools such as Cameo/MagicDraw/Teamwork Cloud and SysML modeling.Experience or familiarity with emerging technologies, including computer vision, machine learning and/or optical character recognition.Experience or familiarity with DevSecOps framework.Experience or familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.Experience with Git or other version control systems.Experience working in aerospace or another highly regulated engineering environment.Experience working in a configuration-controlled environment, including problem reports and change requests.Ability to work within Eastern Time Zone core and global teams, including India Standard Time.
Qualifications We Prefer:

Experience developing automation with scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and thoroughly test implementations.Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex technical issues.Strong communication skills, with the ability to work with internal teams, external suppliers and stakeholders.Practical project management capability, including the ability to manage complex projects, multiple stakeholders and the definition of common technical processes.Ability to collaborate across teams.
What We Offer:

Some of our competitive benefits package includes:

•Medical, dental, and vision insurance

•Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees

•Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option

•Tuition reimbursement program

•Student Loan Repayment Program

•Life insurance and disability coverage

•Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection

•Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits

•Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning

•Adoption Assistance

•Autism Benefit

•Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions

•Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program

•Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits

•Bright Horizons, child and elder care services

•Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program

• And more!

Eligible for relocation

Learn More & Apply Now!

*Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.

Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.

At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibility. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other -- propel us all higher, again and again.

Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

Remote with occasional travel in West Midlands:

In the Security Engineer role, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) is secure and protected against cyber threats. Your expertise will help identify potential risks and vulnerabilities specific to OT and IT environments and develop effective mitigation strategies. By providing guidance and support, you will contribute to our vision of being a world-leading Information Technology and Digital function in the energy sector.

Key Responsibilities

 What you'll do
As an employee in the Security Engineer role, your key roles and responsibilities will include:

- Administer and maintain the End Point Security platform(s) (Tanium & Sentinel One) across enterprise environments.

- Deploy, configure, and manage End Point Security including Tanium modules including Asset, Patch, Deploy, Threat Response, and Comply.

- Monitor system performance and ensure high availability and reliability of End Point security services.

- Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and queries to support IT operations and security teams.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate End Point security services with other security and IT tools.

- Perform regular audits and ensure compliance with internal and external security standards.

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to endpoint visibility, patching, and software deployment.

- Provide training and support to internal teams on End Point security services usage and best practices.

- Stay current with Tanium/Sentinel One updates, features, and industry trends.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

-
 Tanium Certified Administrator (TCA) certification is preferable .

- Proven experience administering Tanium and other End Point security products in a medium to large enterprise environment.

- Strong understanding of endpoint management, cybersecurity principles, and IT operations.

- Experience with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for automation and reporting.

- Familiarity with Windows, Linux, and MacOS operating systems.

- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits

We have a high-performance culture which is balanced evenly with world-class well-being initiatives and benefits:

- Flexible Working: Balance your work and personal life with our flexible working options.

- Generous Holiday Allowance: Enjoy 25 days of holiday, plus bank holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 additional days of annual leave.

- Medicash & Critical Illness Scheme

- Community & Volunteering Programmes: Make a difference in your community with our volunteering opportunities.

- Cycle Scheme: Stay fit and healthy with our cycle-to-work scheme.

- Special Time Off: Take time off for those big moments in life, like getting married/entering into a civil partnership, becoming a grandparent, and welcoming home a new pet.

- Family Planning: Benefit from our generous maternity and paternity leave, as well as time off and support for those undergoing fertility treatments.

Formarás parte del equipo técnico y participarás activamente en un proyecto y servicio, asumiendo funciones como:

* Soporte y administración de plataforma Ivanti.

* Oportunidad de desarrollo profesional en un sector en pleno crecimiento.

* Contrato indefinido.

jobs.summary: Contexte et positionnement du poste Afin de renforcer notre équipe Operations, nous recherchons un profil senior spécialisé dans les services Microsoft 365 Collaboration et Power Platform. Le poste combine un rôle de référent L3 sur Teams, SharePoint...
jobs.description:
Contexte et positionnement du poste

Afin de renforcer notre équipe Operations, nous recherchons un profil senior spécialisé dans les services Microsoft 365 Collaboration et Power Platform. Le poste combine un rôle de référent L3 sur Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive avec la responsabilité du support technique Power Platform sur nos contrats de Managed Services.

 Positionnement du poste

Il s’agit d’un rôle orienté Run et support avancé. Le collaborateur ne porte pas de projets de déploiement ou de développement de nouvelles solutions. Il intervient sur les environnements existants, leur stabilité, leur support, leur gouvernance opérationnelle et leur amélioration continue.

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Microsoft 365 Collaboration – L3 Operations

 n Assurer le support de niveau 3 et le troubleshooting avancé sur les environnements Microsoft 365 de nos clients.

 n Être le référent technique de l’équipe Operations pour Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive for Business.

 n Prendre en charge les incidents complexes, problèmes et escalades provenant des équipes L1/L2.

 n Analyser les dégradations de service, problèmes de configuration, droits d’accès, synchronisation, partage et intégrations.

 n Intervenir sur Microsoft 365 Groups et sur les dépendances Entra ID liées aux services collaboratifs.

 n Piloter les escalades techniques auprès de Microsoft ou de fournisseurs tiers lorsque nécessaire.

 n Réaliser des analyses de cause racine et contribuer au Problem Management.

 n Identifier les incidents récurrents et proposer des améliorations techniques ou opérationnelles.

 n Maintenir la documentation technique, les procédures d’exploitation et les articles de connaissance.

 n Assurer le transfert de compétences et l’accompagnement technique des équipes L1/L2.

Power Platform – Référent technique L3

 n Être le point de référence technique pour le support Power Platform sur les contrats MSP pris en charge par Sword.

 n Assurer le support avancé de Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, environnements Power Platform, connecteurs et gateways.

 n Diagnostiquer les erreurs d’applications et de flows, problèmes de connecteurs, authentification, permissions et dépendances de plateforme.

 n Prendre en charge les incidents sur les solutions existantes sans responsabilité de développement de nouvelles applications.

 n Contribuer à l’administration des environnements et à la gouvernance opérationnelle de la Power Platform.

 n Coordonner avec les propriétaires d’applications, développeurs ou équipes projet lorsqu’une correction applicative ou une évolution sort du périmètre Run.

 n Construire et maintenir les procédures de support et standards opérationnels Power Platform.

Managed Services Operations

 n Gérer les incidents, problèmes et demandes de service dans nos outils ITSM, en respectant les priorités et SLA contractuels.

 n Participer aux échanges techniques avec les Service Delivery Managers et les équipes IT de nos clients.

 n Contribuer aux revues opérationnelles lorsque son expertise technique est requise.

 n Collaborer avec les spécialistes Azure, Workplace, Identity, Security et Business Applications.

 n Participer aux démarches d’amélioration continue et de capitalisation au sein de l’équipe Operations.

 n Participer au service d’astreinte lorsque le périmètre du contrat le nécessite.

Votre profil

 n Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans des environnements Microsoft, avec une expérience significative en support L2/L3 ou Managed Services.

 n Expérience solide et opérationnelle des services Microsoft 365 Collaboration.

 n Expérience concrète de l’administration et du support Microsoft Power Platform.

 n Expérience comme technical lead, référent senior, expert d’escalade ou technical advisor.

 n Capacité à diagnostiquer des problèmes complexes impliquant plusieurs services Microsoft et à identifier rapidement la cause racine.

 n Autonomie, sens du service et capacité à proposer des solutions pragmatiques.

 n Aisance dans un environnement Managed Services avec engagement de service, priorisation et relation client.

 n Rigueur, organisation, esprit d’équipe et bonne communication.

 n Capacité à documenter clairement les sujets techniques et à transférer ses connaissances aux autres ingénieurs.

Compétences techniques

 Microsoft 365 Collaboration

 Power Platform

Microsoft Teams

Power Apps

SharePoint Online

Power Automate

OneDrive for Business

Dataverse

Microsoft 365

Connectors & integrations

Microsoft Entra ID

On-premises Data Gateway

PowerShell

Power Platform Admin Center

Compétences complémentaires appréciées

 n Microsoft Purview

 n Exchange Online

 n Microsoft Graph

 n Azure

 n Intune

 n Power Platform ALM / Solutions

 n CI/CD principles for Power Platform

Langues

 n Anglais professionnel obligatoire : niveau B2 minimum, C1 souhaité.

 n Français professionnel fortement souhaité.

 n Une autre langue européenne constitue un atout.

Ce qui caractérise le poste

 n Un rôle senior d’expertise technique centré sur le Run, le troubleshooting et la responsabilité opérationnelle.

 n Le point d’escalade L3 de référence pour Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive au sein de la BU Operations.

 n Le référent L3 Power Platform pour les contrats de Managed Services opérés par Sword.

Pourquoi rejoindre Sword ?

Organisé selon un modèle de centres de compétence spécialisés, Sword a développé une expertise forte sur les technologies Cloud Microsoft et les Managed Services.

Vous rejoignez une organisation où les équipes Operations, Collaboration, Business Applications, Workplace, Identity et Security travaillent ensemble sur des environnements clients exigeants et variés. Le poste offre un haut niveau d’autonomie et une responsabilité technique claire sur le périmètre Run.

About the position

The Endpoint Administrator II is responsible for the deployment, configuration, management, and security of endpoint devices across the CallTower organization. This role focuses on Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, Windows and macOS device management, and modern endpoint administration practices. As a member of the Endpoint team, this individual will help manage the full device lifecycle, including provisioning, enrollment, compliance, application deployment, security configuration, patch management, and user support for corporate endpoints. The Endpoint Administrator II will also assist with endpoint security initiatives, automation, and continuous improvement of device management processes.

Responsibilities

Configure, deploy, and manage Windows and macOS devices using Microsoft Intune.Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including group management, device identities, Conditional Access, and authentication-related services.Manage endpoint enrollment and provisioning processes, including Windows Autopilot and Apple device enrollment.Deploy, configure, and maintain device compliance policies, configuration profiles, and security baselines.Administer Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and participate in endpoint security initiatives.Manage mobile device and application management (MDM/MAM) policies for corporate and BYOD environments.Deploy and maintain software packages, updates, and operating system upgrades through Intune.Monitor endpoint health, compliance, inventory, and security status through management platforms and reporting solutions.Troubleshoot device management, enrollment, authentication, compliance, and application deployment issues.Create and maintain documentation for endpoint management processes, procedures, and standards.Participate in endpoint-related projects, migrations, upgrades, and technology rollouts.Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and support teams to ensure a secure and reliable endpoint experience.Maintain asset inventory accuracy and support device lifecycle processes including onboarding, refreshes, and offboarding.Requirements

About the Company:
  At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

  The Role You'll Play

  Drive the strategy, configuration, and scaling of Playlist's global Apple and Windows device fleets using Jamf and Intune.
  Develop and maintain runbooks for future M&A scenarios—ensuring device management practices can scale securely and efficiently.
  Ensure endpoint fleets consistently meet Playlist's security baselines and implement iterative improvements.
  Support integration planning and execution for systems related to mergers and acquisitions.
  Own and manage technical projects—including requirements gathering, task tracking, and stakeholder communication.
  Partner cross-functionally to identify and resolve technical or workflow-related friction points.
  Participate in the IT Engineering "shield" rotation to support escalations from our internal support team.

 Experience You Bring

  6+ years of IT Engineering experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  4+ years of hands-on experience managing MDM tools, especially Jamf and Intune.
  Proven track record in automating processes across Cloud SaaS platforms
  Advanced knowledge of cloud infrastructure and endpoint management
  Strong time management and prioritization skills, with a disciplined approach to documentation and knowledge sharing
  Experience influencing both short- and long-term IT strategy and roadmaps.

 Must have experience with:

  Cloud platforms: Azure, AWS
  MDM tools: Jamf Pro (Connect + Protect), Microsoft Intune
  Server & device management: Windows Server, macOS device compliance
  SSO & Identity: Experience implementing SSO and managing identity systems
  System integration: Proficient in API-based integrations

 Compliance & Security Knowledge

  Familiarity with leading IT and InfoSec frameworks:
  ITIL, COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls
  PCI, GDPR, HIPAA, SOX, HITRUST
  Understanding of regulatory requirements related to:
  PII, PHI, and financial data
  Data residency and international compliance standards

 Additional Strengths

  Excellent verbal and written communication skills—able to explain complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.
  Comfortable presenting recommendations and documentation to business and executive audiences.
  Stakeholder management

 Playlist intends to pay all Team Members competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair, and equitable. The goal of our compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees, and encourage Team Members to stay with our organization.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Distinguished Engineer for Endpoint Engineering, you will be the chief architect and technical authority for Palo Alto Networks’ access agent platform. You will own the unified architectural vision across our core endpoint clients including GlobalProtect, Prisma Access Agent, ADEM, and many others spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

In this high-visibility role, you will lead the evolution of our endpoint portfolio from distinct product agents into a unified, high-performing platform foundation. By establishing shared networking, IPC, core application logic, and observability layers, you will ensure that every capability and performance optimization built in one agent automatically powers them all. Furthermore, you will define how endpoint software is engineered in an AI-native world embedding automated defect verification, intelligent telemetry analysis, and smart crash triage into our global release pipeline.

This is a high-leverage "build-the-foundation" role with direct executive sponsorship, a clear evidence-backed mandate, and an organization ready to execute under your vision.

Your ImpactDefine the Platform Architecture: Architect a high-performance, modular core for networking, crypto, configuration, and telemetry that sibling products configure rather than rebuild.Establish Secure Seams & Extensions: Create localized plugin models so that new auth methods, protocol extensions, or tunnel types land once and become immediately available across all platforms.Systemic Quality & Reliability by Design: Own the endpoint architecture standardizing peer identity, least-privilege decomposition, resilient error handling, and memory safety directly into type systems and CI/CD gates.Pioneer AI-Native Workflows & Supportability: Integrate AI-driven software design, development, automated crash triage, and automated regression verification into standard build pipelines across millions of active enterprise endpoints.Drive Technical Excellence: Set engineering standards, author key Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), mentor principal and senior talent, and represent our technical strategy with customers and engineering partners.

Qualifications

Minimum QualificationsSeasoned and accomplished leadership in Endpoint systems development, core networking, and/or OS-level software development.Cross-Product Impact: Track record of defining cross-team architecture that was successfully adopted across multiple product groups.Deep OS Internals: Expert hands-on knowledge in at least two target platforms:Windows: Kernel/driver models, WFP, services, OS process architecture.macOS: XPC, System/Network Extensions, IOKit, code-signing, notarization.Linux: Netlink, routing, network namespaces, DNS handling.Legacy Refactoring: Proven experience decomposing complex C/C++ codebases into modular, testable components using incremental, safe refactoring patterns.Technical Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to align senior engineers and executives behind complex architectural shifts.Preferred QualificationsHands-on experience with VPN, ZTNA, or SASE client technologies (IPsec/IKEv2, TLS/DTLS, QUIC/MASQUE, split tunneling, posture assessment).Experience shipping multi-platform agents at scale (millions of active endpoints) with staged rollouts and telemetry-backed observability.Background integrating AI/ML models into software engineering workflows.#LI- DREESE2

Who We Are

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. jobs.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the...
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

 ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Senior IT Security Engineer to architect, build, and own classified infrastructure for Anduril's Space team from the ground up. This is a foundational role — you won't be inheriting an existing environment, you'll be designing and standing up the systems, standards, and processes that the team will rely on as it scales. That means making decisions about architecture, tooling, and automation frameworks, then implementing and hardening them to full compliance. You'll work at the intersection of security, infrastructure, and engineering to ensure our classified environments are built right from day one and remain resilient, compliant, and mission-ready.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design and build classified infrastructure from scratch, including server environments, virtual platforms, networking, and enterprise services — establishing the architecture and hardened baselines the Space team will operate on

- Define and implement STIG compliance strategies across Windows, RHEL, and VMware, using SCAP, SCC, and manual validation; stand up repeatable processes for ongoing compliance scanning and remediation

- Architect and deploy virtual infrastructure (primarily VMware vSphere, and potentially vSAN and Horizon/VDI), making foundational decisions on topology, resource allocation, and scalability

- Build out enterprise services from the ground up, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, WSUS/patch repositories, and repository servers

- Develop automation frameworks using Ansible, scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python), and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure environments are reproducible, consistent, and minimally dependent on manual intervention

- Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes for system health, performance, and security posture

- Lead vulnerability remediation efforts, driving technical implementation for CAT I/II/III findings and partnering with ISSO/ISSM stakeholders to meet required timelines

- Design and implement backup and disaster recovery strategies, defining RPO/RTO targets and validating them through regular testing

- Guide environments through the ATO process, producing documentation, compliance evidence, and technical demonstrations for security assessments

- Create comprehensive runbooks, architecture documentation, and knowledge transfer materials to enable the team to scale beyond a single point of ownership

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years administering and hardening Windows Server and Linux (RHEL) in classified or regulated environments

- Demonstrated experience building infrastructure from scratch, not just maintaining existing environments

- Deep knowledge of STIG application and validation using SCAP/SCC tools, with the ability to design compliance programs, not just execute checklists

- Strong VMware vSphere experience, including architecture decisions, provisioning, and patching

- Experience standing up and managing Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise patch management in new environments

- Advanced scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) with hands-on Ansible experience

- Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience architecting VMware vSAN and Horizon/VDI environments

- Familiarity with engineering applications such as Siemens NX, Teamcenter, or other CAD/CAM/CAE software

- Track record of leading environments through the full ATO lifecycle

- Experience mentoring junior administrators or leading small infrastructure teams

- Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, RHCSA, RHCE, VCP, or CISSP

US Salary Range

 $166,000 - $220,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox is seeking a Principal Client Platform Engineer to serve as the technical architect of our global endpoint ecosystem. Reporting to the Client Services Manager, you will define the long-term strategy for how our fleet scales, secures, and evolves. This role goes beyond day-to-day management — you will establish architectural standards, drive automation-first platform design, and ensure thousands of builders have secure, reliable tools to do their best work. From strengthening our security posture in a complex hybrid environment to mentoring senior engineers, you will shape the technical foundation that powers innovation at Roblox.

 You Will:

- Standardize the global security and management strategy for our entire fleet of macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and ChromeOS devices to ensure peak performance and ironclad compliance.

- Evolve of our deployment pipeline, driving the automated rollout of patches, OS upgrades, and complex certificate lifecycles for all endpoints.

- Lead the hardening of our endpoint security posture, partnering with InfoSec to architect automated remediation workflows and deploying advanced observability tools like CrowdStrike, and Kolide.

- Design and scale internally owned systems within our hybrid environment.

- Lead complex platform initiatives from architecture through global deployment and operational maturity.

- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Corporate Engineering, Security, Engineering, and People Ops to align technical roadmaps with broader company goals.

- Navigate and resolve high-level ambiguity, transforming vague technical requirements into scalable engineering solutions.

jobs.description:
**Job Description** Objetivo del puesto

Apoyar la operación y monitoreo de controles de **Endpoint Security** , contribuyendo a la protección de equipos corporativos, detección de amenazas y atención inicial de eventos e incidentes de seguridad relacionados con endpoints.

Responsabilidades

* Monitorear y analizar alertas de seguridad generadas en endpoints.
* Apoyar la operación de herramientas de Endpoint Protection, EDR/XDR y antivirus.
* Realizar análisis inicial de eventos relacionados con malware, actividad sospechosa y amenazas en dispositivos.
* Apoyar la investigación y seguimiento de incidentes de seguridad relacionados con endpoints.
* Participar en actividades de aislamiento, contención y remediación de dispositivos afectados, siguiendo procedimientos establecidos.
* Apoyar el seguimiento de vulnerabilidades, parches y configuraciones de seguridad en endpoints.
* Validar el estado y funcionamiento de agentes y controles de seguridad instalados en los dispositivos.
* Apoyar la aplicación y revisión de políticas de seguridad y hardening de endpoints.
* Documentar alertas, incidentes, hallazgos y acciones de remediación.
* Colaborar con equipos de Ciberseguridad, Infraestructura y Soporte en la resolución de incidentes.

Perfil

* 0--2 años de experiencia en Ciberseguridad, Endpoint Security, Security Operations, Infraestructura o áreas relacionadas.
* Conocimientos básicos de Endpoint Security, EDR/XDR y protección contra malware.
* Conocimientos básicos de Windows Security y deseable Linux.
* Conocimiento básico de vulnerability management, patching y hardening.
* Capacidad para realizar troubleshooting y análisis inicial de alertas de seguridad.
* Conocimientos fundamentales de redes: TCP/IP, DNS, puertos y protocolos.
* Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Sistemas, Informática, Ciberseguridad, Redes o carrera afín.
* Inglés técnico deseable.

Tecnologías deseables

No es necesario contar con experiencia avanzada. Se valorará conocimiento o exposición a tecnologías como:

**Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, Trellix/McAfee, Symantec Endpoint Security, Trend Micro** o herramientas equivalentes.

También se valorará exposición a **SIEM, vulnerability management y herramientas de administración de endpoints** , siempre como complemento de la experiencia principal en Endpoint Security.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Endpoint Engineer - InTune

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI seeks an experienced Endpoint Engineer - InTune for a critical role supporting the United States Secret Service (USSS) contract within the Department of Homeland Security. This position strengthens federal IT infrastructure by leading modern endpoint management, cloud integration, and security automation across enterprise systems serving national security missions.

You will be part of a dynamic team of Systems and Desktop Engineers and security specialists, driving the administration and evolution of Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Azure-based endpoint solutions. As a technical leader, you'll bridge on-premises and cloud environments, implementing hybrid identity solutions, automating deployments, and ensuring compliance with federal security standards while maintaining operational excellence.

This role combines hands-on technical engineering (Intune policy management, application deployment, device compliance, scripting automation) with strategic leadership (designing cloud-native solutions, mentoring junior engineers, driving adoption of emerging technologies). Working across endpoint management and server operations teams, you'll ensure adherence to customer SLAs, accelerate deployment cycles through automation, and reduce operational workload by implementing modern cloud-based management solutions.

Responsibilities:

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management -

\- Lead Microsoft Intune administration and engineering, including policy creation and management, application deployment, device compliance, and conditional access configurations

\- Implement and manage Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune + SCCM) for comprehensive endpoint management

\- Manage device enrollment, policy management, application deployment, compliance enforcement, and conditional access across the enterprise

\- Administer InTune AutoPilot for modern device provisioning and deployment

Hybrid Cloud & Identity Solutions -

\- Design and implement hybrid cloud solutions leveraging Azure AD and on-premises Active Directory for seamless identity management

\- Utilize Azure Automation and Intune to manage and secure cloud-based and on-premises Windows workstations and servers, ensuring they are patched to correct levels

\- Develop and maintain Azure-based system templates and images for rapid deployment

Systems Administration & Engineering -

\- Manage and maintain Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 systems and Windows 11 PC images in both Azure and on-premises environments

\- Identify, analyze, and resolve system problems with both short-term workarounds and long-term cloud-based solutions

\- Perform expertise in MDT and SCCM including capturing images (.WIM), creating packages, advertisements, task sequences, operating system deployment (OSD), and queries

\- Support SCCM software packaging and patching across the enterprise

Automation & Scripting -

\- Write advanced PowerShell scripts and leverage Azure Functions to automate systems administration tasks across cloud and on-premises environments

\- Develop automation solutions to customize configurations and streamline operational tasking

Security & Compliance -

\- Design and implement Azure-based security solutions, including Azure Security Center and Azure Sentinel

\- Execute IAVA process including CYBERCOM release process, testing, approval, and deployment processes

\- Manage Active Directory Security Groups, OUs, DNS, and GPO management to enforce security policies

\- Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication and VPN solutions

Leadership & Collaboration -

\- Provide guidance and work leadership to less-experienced cloud and systems engineers

\- Collaborate across endpoint management and server operations teams to drive automation and cloud-native solutions

\- Test and evaluate new/emerging technologies to deliver faster deployments and decreased workload

Qualifications:

Required:

\- Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance

\- Bachelor's degree + 13 years of applicable experience (equivalencies: 19 years no degree, AA + 15 years, MA + 10 years)

\- Minimum 5+ years SCCM experience supporting software packaging and patching

\- Minimum 5+ years InTune AutoPilot administration experience

\- Strong working knowledge of SCCM and Intune including device enrollment, policy management, application deployment, compliance enforcement, and conditional access

\- Solid understanding of VMware vCenter virtualization platform

\- Functional understanding of Microsoft SQL Server and Active Directory

\- Expertise in MDT and SCCM: capturing images (.WIM), creating packages, advertisements, task sequences, operating system deployment (OSD), and queries

\- Solid knowledge of PowerShell scripting to automate tasking and customize configurations

\- Expertise with IAVA process including CYBERCOM release process, testing, approval, and deployment processes

\- Solid knowledge of Active Directory Security Groups, OUs, DNS, and GPO management

\- Solid Windows troubleshooting skills across server and desktop environments

\- Strong understanding of networking concepts including VPN and certificate-based authentication

\- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate certification

\- SCCM Certified

Desired:

\- ITIL v4 certification

\- Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Manager Specialist

\- Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate

\- Additional Autopilot experience beyond baseline requirements

\- Cloud services familiarity, particularly Microsoft Azure platform and services

-

A culture of integrity.

jobs.title: MDM Sales Manager Costa Rica (M/F)
jobs.summary: With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such...
jobs.description:
With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such as bacterial barrier substrates and preformed sterilization packaging, serving both hospitals and medical device manufacturers.

Sterimed stands out with its strong entrepreneurial DNA and has been pursuing a highly dynamic external growth policy for several years. Since its founding in 2016, the group's size has quadrupled, and 10 acquisitions have been completed since 2017.

To support this growth, we are looking for a Sales Manager M/F for our MDM business unit covering Costa Rica and Mexico.

Reporting to the MDM Sales Team Leader Americas, the Sales Manager is responsible for managing, developing, and closing profitable new business across Costa Rica and parts of Mexico, primarily the surrounding areas of Mexico City. The primary focus of this role is selling medical packaging solutions to medical device manufacturers while also managing and growing an existing portfolio of customers. This is a remote role based in in Costa Rica.

This position requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent prospecting skills, and the ability to convert business opportunities into sustainable and profitable orders. The Sales Manager will work closely with customers, internal technical teams, and key stakeholders to support product validation, strengthen customer relationships, and drive order intake and market growth.

The ideal candidate will be a collaborative and transparent team player who can operate successfully in a multicultural, cross-border environment. This role also requires strong project management skills, the ability to build annual sales forecasts and budgets, and a commitment to delivering results in a dynamic, international business setting.

The position involves frequent travel throughout the assigned territory, including surrounding areas of Mexico City and Costa Rica and France for company seminars and business meetings.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

• Grow sales within the assigned territory of surrounding areas of Mexico City and Costa Rica

• Develop new business opportunities with medical device manufacturers.

• Manage and expand an existing customer portfolio.

• Prospect actively to identify and convert new commercial opportunities.

• Support product validation projects in coordination with customers and the technical department.

• Act as the link between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and follow-up.

• Turn business opportunities into profitable orders.

• Build annual sales budgets based on customer forecasts and new business opportunities.

• Maintain accurate reporting and CRM updates.

• Apply company marketing and commercial policies consistently.

• Travel regularly within the territory and occasionally internationally as required.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Business Negotiation, Packaging En-gineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an export sales or B2B sales position.

• Experience in medical sterile packaging is preferred; experience in general packaging or food packaging will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer development, and account management.

• Experience working with technical or project-based sales cycles is an asset.

**Skills and Competencies**

• Strong prospecting and business development skills.

• Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer projects simultaneously.

• Strong reporting, planning, and forecasting capabilities.

• Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.

• Knowledge of Incoterms is preferred.

• Able to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.

• Customer-focused, proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented.

• Strong relationship-building and problem-solving abilities.

• Adaptable and eager to learn about a new industry or market segment.

**Language Requirement**

• Bilingual in English and Spanish is required.

**Travel Requirement**

• Travel approximately 50% to 70% of the time within the assigned territory.

• Occasional travel outside of territory but within the Americas and France for company seminars or business meetings.

*Sterimed is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment. Feel free to let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.*
