jobs.title: Executive Director Employee Technology & Digital Workplace
jobs.summary: This role leads Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, a significant function within Digital and Technology, directing the Service Desk and ServiceNow ITSM platform, employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding), digital workplace engineering,...
jobs.description:
This role leads Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, a significant function within Digital and Technology, directing the Service Desk and ServiceNow ITSM platform, employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding), digital workplace engineering, field/deskside support, and M365 and collaboration platform delivery through subordinate management. The Executive Director determines the organizational structure and operational direction for the function and participates with senior management in developing the strategic plans and objectives that govern it, ensuring the function's direction remains tied to company-wide performance and responds effectively to Regeneron's constantly changing business needs.

The Executive Director brings in-depth knowledge of the functional area, Regeneron's business strategies, and the company's goals to reposition employee-facing IT as a modern, consumer-grade digital experience. Decisions on strategy, investment, and operating model in this function have a measurable, long-term effect on employee productivity, cost-to-serve, and the company's ability to attract and retain talent — the Executive Director is expected to bring strength and clarity to the function during periods of growth or major change, and to lead effectively even where direction is ambiguous.

This is the next iteration of IT service delivery at Regeneron — evolving the function from a ticket- and SLA-driven operation into a proactive, experience-led organization measured on employee sentiment, self-service adoption, and time-to-resolution, not just uptime. The Executive Director partners closely with Enterprise Architecture on technical standards and platform decisions, and with IT Strategy & Transformation, which sponsors chartered modernization initiatives into this tower without assuming direct reporting authority.

Where and When

This is an on-site position 4 days/week, primarily based at our Sleepy Hollow, NY or Warren, NJ office. If eligible, we can offer relocation benefits; we cannot offer a fully remote option.

What You'll Lead

Employee Technology Strategy & Digital Experience Vision

Participate with senior IT and business leadership in developing the strategic plans and objectives for employee technology, ensuring the function's direction stays tied to company-wide performance and adapts to constantly changing business needs.

Define and own the vision, roadmap, and operating model for Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, positioning IT as a modern, consumer-grade digital experience rather than a traditional service organization.

Translate employee and business feedback into a prioritized modernization roadmap across service desk, ITSM, endpoint, and lifecycle technology.

Champion a "digital-first, self-service-first" philosophy, shifting volume away from live support and toward intuitive, automated, and AI-enabled experiences.

Partner with IT Strategy & Transformation to align sponsored modernization initiatives (e.g., virtual agent/AI deflection, unified employee portal) with this tower's operational roadmap and capacity.

Service Desk & ITSM Operations (ServiceNow)

Own end-to-end Service Desk operations, including tiered support, major incident management, and escalation processes across a global, follow-the-sun model.

Drive continuous modernization of the ServiceNow platform — intelligent routing, virtual agent/chatbot deflection, knowledge management, and workflow automation — to reduce ticket volume and resolution time.

Establish and monitor experience-led metrics (CSAT, first-contact resolution, deflection rate, mean time to resolve) as the primary measures of success, alongside traditional SLAs.

Ensure ticketing, request, and knowledge processes are simple, consistent, and easy for employees to navigate regardless of how they choose to engage (portal, chat, phone, walk-up).

Own GRC, vendor risk management (VRM), and policy exception workflows on the ServiceNow platform, ensuring timely processing and audit-ready records.

Own portal and content management for the ServiceNow platform, ensuring employees can easily find and act on the right services and policies.

Employee Lifecycle Technology (Onboarding & Offboarding)

Own the technology experience for onboarding, transfers, and offboarding, ensuring new hires are productive on day one and departures are secure and frictionless.

Modernize onboarding/offboarding into an automated, orchestrated workflow spanning identity, access provisioning, equipment, and collaboration tools — eliminating manual handoffs across HR, IT, and Security.

Partner with HR, Security, and Facilities to design a seamless, employee-centric lifecycle journey, with clear accountability for every step and status transparent to the employee and their manager.

Continuously reduce time-to-productivity for new hires and time-to-deprovision for departures, tracking both as core experience and risk metrics.

Digital Workplace Engineering & Endpoint Experience

Own engineering and lifecycle management for employee-facing technology: endpoints, mobility, unified endpoint management (UEM), collaboration tools, and meeting room/AV technology.

Drive modernization of the digital workplace — proactive device health monitoring, zero-touch provisioning, self-healing endpoints, and simplified software deployment — to minimize disruption to employees.

Ensure collaboration and meeting technologies (video, conferencing, messaging) provide a consistently excellent experience across office, lab, and hybrid work settings.

Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security to ensure digital workplace standards remain secure, scalable, and aligned to enterprise architecture principles.

M365 & Collaboration Platform Delivery

Own service delivery for the M365 platform — Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, OneDrive, and Power Automate — including platform guardrails, governance, and adoption.

Own voice and unified communications service delivery, ensuring reliable, modern calling and conferencing capability across the enterprise.

Drive continuous improvement of collaboration tooling to reduce friction and support hybrid and global ways of working.

Partner with Enterprise Architecture on platform roadmap decisions and with Security on data governance within M365 workloads.

Field & Deskside Support Operations

Own field and deskside support across all Regeneron sites, ensuring consistent, high-quality in-person support where self-service and remote resolution aren't sufficient.

Right-size the deskside support model as digital self-service and remote resolution capabilities mature, reallocating capacity toward higher-value, in-person needs (labs, executive support, events).

Ensure support models scale appropriately across site types (corporate, R&D/lab, manufacturing) with services tailored to how each site's population actually works.

Own end-to-end lifecycle management of end-user assets — procurement coordination, deployment, tracking, refresh cycles, and secure disposal/decommissioning.

Maintain accurate asset inventory and compliance reporting to support audit, cost management, and security requirements.

Experience Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Establish a consistent employee experience measurement framework (CSAT, NPS, effort scores) across every touchpoint in this tower, replacing purely operational SLA reporting.

Run a continuous improvement cadence — mining ticket, sentiment, and usage data to identify friction points and prioritize fixes before they become recurring complaints.

Report employee technology experience trends and improvement outcomes to executive stakeholders, connecting operational data to business and workforce impact.

Vendor & Platform Management

Own vendor relationships and contracts for service desk, ITSM, endpoint, and digital workplace tooling, ensuring value, performance, and roadmap alignment.

Establish a vendor governance cadence — performance scorecards, quarterly business reviews, and value/ROI tracking — holding vendors accountable to continuous improvement commitments rather than static contract terms.

Partner with Finance and Procurement to manage the cost-to-serve for employee technology, balancing experience improvements against operating budget discipline.

Evaluate emerging digital workplace and AI-enabled support technologies, building the business case for adoption where they meaningfully improve employee experience or reduce cost-to-serve.

People Leadership, Mentoring & Team Culture

Determine the organizational structure and operational direction for the function, directing critical work through subordinate managers and senior leaders.

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed organization across service desk, lifecycle technology, digital workplace engineering, and field support.

Mentor and coach people leaders across the organization, investing in career growth, succession planning, and bench strength.

Model and reinforce a customer-obsessed, continuous-improvement culture, holding the team accountable to employee experience outcomes, not just ticket throughput.

Champion development and team culture within the function, fostering collaboration across a global, follow-the-sun operating model.

Key Working Relationships

This role is viewed across Regeneron as a role model for employee-centric technology delivery and is regularly sought out by leaders at all levels for advice on employee technology matters. Because much of this role's influence runs through governance and partnership rather than direct authority over every function it touches, it also serves as the principal spokesperson for employee technology and digital workplace matters on highly significant issues, and is expected to negotiate difficult matters with senior management and functional heads, both internally and externally.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field is required. A master's degree or MBA is preferred.

17+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, end-user computing, digital workplace, or IT operations leadership roles.

Deep expertise in ITIL or equivalent service management frameworks, and hands-on experience modernizing an ITSM platform (ServiceNow strongly preferred).

Proven experience redesigning employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding) into an automated, cross-functional workflow spanning IT, HR, and Security.

Strong grounding in digital workplace and end-user computing technologies — unified endpoint management, collaboration platforms, mobility, and AV/conferencing.

Track record of building and using experience metrics (CSAT, NPS, deflection rate, first-contact resolution) to drive continuous improvement, not just SLA compliance.

Experience leveraging automation, self-service, and AI/virtual agent technologies to reduce support volume and improve employee experience.

Proven ability to build, scale, and lead large, globally distributed service organizations, including hiring, developing, and retaining talent across a follow-the-sun model.

Experience operating in a matrixed, governance-driven environment — partnering with peers in Enterprise Architecture and IT Strategy & Transformation without direct authority over their teams.

Strong vendor and contract management experience, including negotiating and managing platform and outsourced support relationships, with a track record of driving ongoing vendor performance and value through structured governance (scorecards, business reviews).

Sound business and financial acumen, with experience managing cost-to-serve and building business cases for employee technology investment.

Proven ability to bring strength and clarity to a business during periods of growth or major change, exercising sound judgment and taking a positive leadership role amid ambiguity or limited direction.

jobs.description:
The Endpoint Solutions Lead is responsible for **end-to-end ownership of the Endpoint (EUC) tower**, covering:

* Windows Endpoint (SCCM / Intune)
* Apple Endpoint (JAMF / macOS / iOS)
* VDI (Citrix / AWS WorkSpaces / AppStream)
* Print Services (Enterprise Print Infrastructure)

This role combines **technical leadership, delivery ownership, client engagement, and escalation management** to ensure a **stable, secure, and high-performing end-user environment**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Tower Ownership**

* Own overall delivery of Endpoint services:
* Device management (Windows \& Apple)
* VDI platforms (Citrix / AWS)
* Print infrastructure
* Ensure services meet:
* SLA / KPI targets
* Security and compliance standards
* Drive **service stability and continuous improvement**

**Technical Leadership (Hands-On)**

* Act as **technical authority (L3/L4 escalation)** across all endpoint technologies
* Provide guidance on:
* SCCM / Intune architecture and co-management strategy
* JAMF and Apple ecosystem design
* Citrix / AWS VDI optimization
* Print infrastructure standardization
* Review and approve:
* Complex changes
* Architecture decisions
* Major deployments

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as **primary technical interface for client stakeholders**
* Lead:
* Service reviews (weekly/monthly)
* Technical discussions and escalations
* Translate technical issues into **business impact language**
* Build client confidence through **proactive insights and roadmap**

**Escalation \& Major Incident Management**

* Own **critical escalations (P1/P2 incidents)** across Endpoint tower
* Lead technical bridge calls during outages
* Ensure:
* Quick triage and resolution
* Clear communication to stakeholders
* Drive RCA and preventive actions

**Service Improvement \& Transformation**

* Drive initiatives such as:
* Intune-first / modern endpoint transformation
* Apple zero-touch deployment (ABM + JAMF)
* VDI optimization and cloud adoption (AWS)
* Print standardization and reduction of legacy issues
* Reduce:
* Ticket volume
* Repeat incidents
* Manual effort

**Automation \& Standardization**

* Promote automation using:
* PowerShell / scripting
* Endpoint management tools
* Standardize:
* Application packaging
* Patch management processes
* Policy configurations
* Drive **engineering mindset vs support mindset**

**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**

* Lead L1, L2, and L3 teams across Endpoint tower
* Mentor and upskill team members
* Conduct:
* Technical reviews
* Performance evaluations
* Improve **technical depth and ownership mindset** in team

**Governance, Compliance \& Reporting**

* Define and track KPIs:
* Patch compliance
* Endpoint health
* VDI performance
* Ticket trends
* Ensure audit readiness and compliance adherence
* Provide structured reports and insights to stakeholders

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

**Technical Expertise (Must-Have Breadth + Depth)**

* Strong hands-on experience in:
* **SCCM / Intune (co-management, patching, packaging)**
* **JAMF / Apple device management**
* **Citrix VDI (CVAD / DaaS)** + exposure to AWS VDI
* **Active Directory, GPO, endpoint security**
* Good understanding of:
* Networking fundamentals
* Identity \& access (Azure AD / Entra ID)

**Architecture \& Strategy**

* Ability to design:
* Endpoint management architecture
* VDI solutions (on-prem + cloud)
* Strong understanding of:
* Modern endpoint trends (Intune-first, zero-touch)
* Hybrid environments

**Automation \& Tools**

* Strong scripting:
* PowerShell (mandatory)
* Exposure to:
* APIs / automation frameworks (preferred)

**Process \& Governance**

* Strong ITIL knowledge:
* Incident, Problem, Change, Service Improvement
* Experience in:
* CAB
* RCA
* SLA governance

**Leadership \& Soft Skills (Critical)**

* Strong client-facing communication (must handle US stakeholders confidently)
* Decision-making under pressure (especially during outages)
* Ability to challenge and improve existing setups
* Ownership mindset (not reactive, but proactive)

**Experience \& Education**

* 12--15+ years of experience in Endpoint / EUC / Infrastructure
* 5+ years in leadership / architect role
* Bachelor's degree in IT or related field
* Certifications (strong advantage):
* Microsoft (MD-102 / AZ-104)
* JAMF certifications
* Citrix certifications
* AWS (Solutions Architect -- Associate)

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Overall Endpoint SLA adherence
* Patch compliance (\>95--98%)
* Reduction in repeat incidents
* VDI performance (login time, session stability)
* Endpoint compliance \& security posture
* CSAT improvement
* Automation adoption

**What Good Looks Like in This Role**

* Endpoint environment is **stable, predictable, and scalable**
* Strong reduction in:
* Ticket volume
* Escalations
* Clear roadmap toward:
* Modern endpoint (Intune-first)
* Apple automation (zero-touch)
* Cloud VDI adoption
* High client confidence and minimal escalations

jobs.description:
The L2 Endpoint Engineer is responsible for **administration, support, and optimization of Apple device management platforms** , primarily **JAMF Pro** , covering **macOS and iOS/iPadOS devices**.

This role includes **device lifecycle management, application packaging \& deployment, patching, policy enforcement, and compliance management** . The engineer is expected to **troubleshoot complex Apple endpoint issues and ensure a seamless user experience**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**JAMF Platform Administration**

* Administer and support **JAMF Pro** environment
* Manage:
* Device inventory and smart groups
* Policies and configuration profiles
* Enrollment workflows (DEP/Automated Device Enrollment)
* Monitor JAMF health, sync status, and device communication

**Device Lifecycle Management (macOS \& iOS)**

* Handle end-to-end lifecycle:
* Enrollment (Automated \& manual)
* Provisioning and configuration
* Decommissioning
* Support:
* macOS devices (laptops/desktops)
* iOS/iPadOS devices (iPhones, iPads)
* Ensure devices are compliant with corporate standards

**Application Packaging \& Deployment (macOS)**

* Package and deploy applications using:
* PKG / DMG formats
* JAMF policies
* Handle:
* App testing and validation
* Version upgrades and patching
* Troubleshoot installation failures and dependency issues

**Patch Management (macOS \& iOS)**

* Manage OS and third-party patching using JAMF
* Define and deploy patch policies and schedules
* Monitor patch compliance and remediation
* Troubleshoot patch deployment failures

**Policy \& Configuration Management**

* Create and manage:
* Configuration profiles (Wi-Fi, VPN, security settings)
* Restrictions and compliance policies
* Integrate with:
* Apple Business Manager (ABM)
* Identity providers (Azure AD / Okta)
* Ensure alignment with security baselines

**Incident \& Problem Management**

* Act as L2 resolver for:
* Device enrollment failures
* Application deployment issues
* Patch failures
* Policy conflicts
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues
* Escalate to L3/vendor with proper logs when required

**Automation \& Scripting**

* Use scripting for automation:
* Bash / Shell scripting (primary for macOS)
* Basic Python (good to have)
* Automate:
* Application deployments
* Device configurations
* Remediation tasks

**Compliance, Reporting \& Documentation**

* Generate reports on:
* Device compliance
* Patch status
* Application deployment success
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge base
* Support audit requirements

**Collaboration \& Support**

* Work with L1 team for triage improvements
* Collaborate with:
* Security teams (compliance \& policies)
* Identity teams (SSO, conditional access)
* Provide clear communication to end users and stakeholders

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

**Technical Skills (Core)**

* Strong hands-on experience in:
* **JAMF Pro administration**
* macOS device management
* iOS/iPadOS device management (MDM)
* Good understanding of:
* Apple Business Manager (ABM)
* Automated Device Enrollment (DEP)
* Apple Volume Purchase Program (VPP / Apps \& Books)

**Packaging \& Scripting**

* Application packaging:
* PKG / DMG
* Scripting:
* Bash / Shell (mandatory for macOS support mindset)

**Integration Knowledge**

* Identity integration:
* Azure AD / Okta (preferred)
* Basic understanding of:
* Certificates, profiles, and device trust

**Process Knowledge**

* ITIL processes:
* Incident, Problem, Change Management
* Experience in patch cycles and compliance reporting

**Soft Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting mindset (must understand Apple ecosystem behavior)
* Clear communication with global users
* Attention to detail (Apple policies can be strict and sensitive)

**Experience \& Education**

* 3--6 years of experience in Apple endpoint / JAMF support
* Bachelor's degree in IT or related field
* Certifications (good to have):
* JAMF 100/200
* Apple Device Support

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Device compliance rate (%)
* Patch compliance (macOS \& iOS)
* Application deployment success rate
* Incident resolution time (MTTR)
* Reduction in repeat issues
* User experience / CSAT

jobs.description:
Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.

  Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

  The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior IT Security System Administrator to own both sides of a critical mandate: keeping our systems running reliably and keeping them secure. This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting directly to the IT Director. You'll split your time roughly equally between systems administration Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, identity, and SaaS platforms) and security operations (policy enforcement, access control, compliance, threat monitoring, and incident response).

You'll be the person who implements, monitors, and enforces security controls across a rapidly growing distributed workforce. The ideal candidate is technically sharp, operationally disciplined, and comfortable owning both the "does it work" and "is it safe" questions simultaneously. This role is essential for maintaining the reliability, performance, and security of our systems.

  What You Will Own

- Administer Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 environments, while facilitating the setup and full migration to Microsoft 365.

- Manage a mix of Windows and Mac endpoints using MDM tools for device enrollment, configuration, compliance, and patch management policies.

- Administer SSO, MFA, and directory integrations; maintain identity provider configuration and authentication policy.

- Administer and manage security toolsets (DLP, EDR, email security, and SIEM logs) to ensure effective threat detection and policy enforcement.

- Provide tier 2/3 support for firm-wide SaaS applications as necessary.

- Monitor, triage, and respond to security alerts across endpoint, email, identity, and cloud environments.

- Support compliance activities and internal audits; maintain evidence and documentation for security controls.

- Contribute to incident response: detection, containment, remediation, and post-incident review.

- Assist with vulnerability management, including patch cadence tracking and endpoint hygiene reporting.

- Identify gaps in security coverage or operational process and drive remediation.

- Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and best practices relevant to a remote-first professional services environment.

- Develop dashboards & reports for security metrics, compliance status, and operational health.

- Manage relationships with key vendors and service providers, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met.

- Oversee security operations and ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and internal policies.

- Strategy and planning: Translate business needs into operational capability, capacity planning, DR/BCP design, cloud migration strategy, and lifecycle roadmaps.

  What You Bring

  Required:

- Minimum of 7 years experience in IT systems administration, security, operations, or a combined role.

- Proven expertise in managing modern, complex IT environments.

- Enterprise level collaboration suite administration experience (Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace)

- Security fundamentals: Identity/access controls, patching, vulnerability management, and secure configuration practices.

- Disaster recovery & backups: Design and testable DR plans, RTO/RPO understanding, and backup validation.

- Working knowledge of EDR, email security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, anti-phishing), DLP, or SIEM tooling in an operational capacity

- Hands-on MDM/UEM experience across Mac and Windows (Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or equivalent); comfortable managing device compliance at scale

- Demonstrated experience administering SSO, MFA, and an identity provider (Okta, Google Identity, Azure AD / Entra ID, or equivalent)

- Solid understanding of security fundamentals: identity lifecycle management, endpoint hygiene, phishing defense, zero-trust principles

- Experience supporting a fully remote or distributed workforce.

- Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.

  Preferred (Nice to Have):

- Experience in a law firm, legal technology, or professional services environment.

- Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, NIST CSF, or similar).

- Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in a leadership or management role, overseeing a team of IT professionals.

- Understanding of monitoring and logging tools (i.e. Nagios, Splunk, ELK stack).

- Scripting or automation experience (n8n, Python, Bash, Google Apps Script).

- Experience with cloud security posture management or SaaS security review.

- Demonstrated experience with disaster recovery planning and testing.

  Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

-
  Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"

-
  Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.

-
  No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.

-
  Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.

-
  Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

  What We Offer

- Base Salary: $115,000 and $135,000 per year, commensurate with experience

- Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.

- Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

  Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

Job Overview

The Lead Endpoint Engineer will play a critical role as a technology service owner within the Department of Digital Information Infrastructure and Engineering team. A Lead Endpoint Engineer is a jack-of-all-trades regarding endpoint management and utilizes their skills, experience, and talent to recommend, design, implement, and support next generation technologies across the enterprise. Lead Endpoint Engineers also provide mentorship and coaching to Endpoint Engineers and Specialists as required. The position serves as a primary technology service owner responsible for enterprise endpoint management practices including software distribution, OS and Application patching, antivirus, application deployments, desktop virtualization, device provisioning, application testing, license management, and device configuration. These technologies support a dynamic learning environment that empowers 15,000 staff to deliver a world class education for 80,000+ students.

Roles and Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the overall nature and scope of the work being performed. This is not a comprehensive listing of all responsibilities or tasks; work may differ and other work may be assigned when deemed appropriate. Principally owns several technology services within LCPS that includes software distribution, OS and Application patching, antivirus, application deployments, device imaging, application testing, desktop virtualization, cloud service management, and device configuration Provides mentorship, coaching, and training to Endpoint Engineers and Specialists and take lead on new projects and initiatives Escalates concerns to the Endpoint Management Team and acts as a direct liaison to Endpoint Supervisor Documents the processes and procedures as related to the mission of Endpoint Management Develops strategies and collaborates with technical and non-technical staff on core infrastructure projects Designs and deploys new systems and enhancements to existing systems Measures effectiveness of existing core infrastructure systems and strategically design and implements improvements Monitors and tests system performance to include the delivery of statistics and reports Manages projects and reports status updates to senior leadership on a regular basis Provides guidance to other technical staff Solves complex engineering issues while working collaboratively with other departments in a team first approach Resolves issues by applying outstanding communication, analytical, technical, critical thinking, and creative problem-solving skills to ensure all systems operate effectively and efficiently to maximize education opportunities for students Provides excellent customer service to both external and internal customers Qualifications

- Ensure OT systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g., Purdue Model, IEC 62443).

jobs.description:
Healthcare IT powers technology delivery across One Medical's nationwide clinic network and Amazon Pharmacy's fulfillment operations. Our team owns the engineering, deployment, management, patching, and support of healthcare endpoints once they reach the field, ensuring clinicians and pharmacy staff have reliable, secure technology that stays out of their way so they can focus on patients.

As a Systems Engineer on the Healthcare IT team, you will own the operational health of a fleet of over 7,000 endpoints spanning Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android across hundreds of clinic and fulfillment center locations. You will use technology to solve difficult operational problems: keeping devices patched, compliant, and performant at scale, root-causing failures across endpoint, identity, and network systems, and building the automation that lets a talented team operate a large fleet. You will serve as tier 3 support for on-site technology teams, owning the escalation path for complex endpoint infrastructure issues that require deep technical investigation.

This is a hands-on operational engineering role. You will identify the patterns behind recurring device failures and automate them away, script fleet-wide configuration and patching changes, build monitoring that surfaces device health and compliance across the fleet, and drive operational excellence initiatives that produce measurable results. You will make trade-offs between time, resources, and operational burden, and you will resolve, mitigate, or escalate security and reliability risks with sound judgment.

Healthcare IT is a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as the business grows. You will work across multiple technology domains (endpoint management, identity, networking, cloud infrastructure) and must be comfortable context-switching between project execution and operational support.

On-Call Responsibility:
This position involves on-call responsibilities for high-severity events related to critical endpoint infrastructure and identity systems. We invest in fault-tolerant design and root-cause resolution to minimize pages. When we do get paged, we work together to fix the underlying issue so it does not recur.

- Build reusable automation and tooling that scales fleet operations: device provisioning, patching, compliance enforcement, and configuration management
- Serve as an excellent diagnostician: interpret logs, understand dependencies, and root-cause failures across endpoint, identity, and network systems
- Provide tier 3 support for production healthcare endpoint infrastructure, resolving complex escalations from field teams
- Integrate device management platforms (MDM), identity providers (Active Directory, SAML/SSO), and operational tooling through scripting and APIs
- Identify and remediate operational and security risks across the fleet; participate in security compliance reviews and vulnerability management
- Build monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and metrics reporting for device health, patch compliance, login latency, and fleet-wide anomalies
- Support specialized device fleet infrastructure including image tuning, patching, and monitoring
- Drive operational excellence initiatives that demonstrate measurable improvements in reliability, compliance, or support burden
- Create and review SOPs, runbooks, and operational documentation; drive engineering and operational best practices
- Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation for critical infrastructure services Healthcare IT powers technology delivery across One Medical's nationwide clinic network and Amazon Pharmacy's fulfillment operations. - Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP(S), DNS, and TCP/IP
- Experience in systems administration (Windows/MacOS) - Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security

jobs.description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

 Our philosophy:

- We believe in relentless automation of repetitive tasks.

- We have the curiosity and drive to dig deep and find creative solutions.

- We believe our goal is to find the right solution rather than always being right.

- We provide exceptional customer service to our teams and trading desks.

- We care more that the right thing is done than about rigid job descriptions or boundaries.

 What you’ll do:

- Administer core Microsoft services: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Exchange (on-premise, Online, hybrid).

- Deploy, maintain and support Windows Server environments (2016–2025).

- Support Microsoft cloud services (Entra ID, OneDrive, Copilot, Microsoft 365 services).

- Configure single sign on and federation (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM).

- Triage and resolve tickets from the operations queue; respond to critical production incidents.

- Implement planned and ad hoc changes in accordance with firmwide change management processes.

- Maintain clear system documentation and capture specialized configurations as repeatable runbooks.

- Participate in a global support team with on call rotation and occasional weekend maintenance.

 Your background:

- 5+ years managing Windows Server infrastructure in high visibility, mission critical environments.

- Deep expertise in Windows Server services: Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Failover Clustering, load balancers.

- Hands on experience with Entra ID, Exchange (Server/Online/Hybrid), MECM (SCCM).

- Proficient with scripting (PowerShell, Python), IAC (e.g. Terraform, Ansible) and version control (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket).

- Strong networking knowledge and experience with server hardware and hypervisor/VM deployments.

- Excellent documentation and knowledge management skills; ability to turn ad hoc tasks into documented, repeatable processes.

- Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve critical issues under pressure (trading/low latency environments a plus).

- Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can work across teams and have evidence-based discussions on technical and operational topics

- You are eager to learn, collaborate, and find solutions under interesting constraints

 Bonus points if you have:

- Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Alertmanager, Prometheus

- Familiarity with containerization and Kubernetes.

- Prior experience in the trading or financial services industry.

The annual base salary range for this position is $155,000 to $185,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

jobs.description:
Coretek is seeking a skilled EUC Support Engineer to join our Managed Services team.

Coretek is seeking a skilled EUC Support Engineer to join our Managed Services team. This role is responsible for the operational support, optimization, automation, and continuous improvement of customer end user computing environments built on Azure Virtual Desktop, Nerdio, and Citrix. The EUC Support Engineer works within our L3 team, supporting enterprise clients and delivering project work that keeps high-performance virtual desktop experiences reliable, secure, and aligned with industry best practices.

The ideal candidate combines deep virtual desktop expertise with a commitment to service excellence, strong troubleshooting ability, and a passion for automation and Infrastructure as Code. This role blends level 3/4 project-based work with operations and managed services engineering, supporting both daily incidents and long-term platform health, governance, and continuous improvement in a cloud-first, customer-obsessed environment.

EUC Operations & Support

- Provide Level 3 and Level 4 support and engineering expertise for managed Citrix and Azure Virtual Desktop environments.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex virtual desktop, application delivery, user profile, session performance, and endpoint issues.

- Participate in escalation rotations and major incident response activities.

- Perform daily health checks, patching, upgrades, and incident remediation across hosted EUC environments.

- Ensure adherence to established service levels and operational standards.

Citrix & AVD Platform Management

- Manage Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, including Studio, Director, Citrix Policy, Machine Catalogs, and Delivery Groups.

- Deploy, configure, and optimize Azure Virtual Desktop environments and administer Nerdio Manager for Enterprise.

- Manage Citrix Gateway (NetScaler), Citrix Cloud and hybrid configurations, and supporting Azure Resource Manager resources and virtual networking.

Endpoint, Identity & Security

- Deploy and enforce Group Policy Objects, security baselines, and compliance configurations across desktop and server estates.

- Support endpoint management and thin client configurations such as Stratodesk, IGEL, and Unicon.

- Apply Zero Trust principles, Conditional Access, and modern endpoint security integrations.

- Support Imprivata implementation and integration with virtual desktops and authentication workflows.

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

- Implement Infrastructure as Code for environment automation using Terraform, Ansible, and Packer.

- Develop automation using PowerShell, Nerdio automation scripting, Nerdio Runbooks, and image build pipelines.

- Identify opportunities to increase operational efficiency and reduce repetitive manual effort.

Monitoring & Reliability

- Monitor, analyze, and improve system performance, availability, and security posture across client environments.

- Develop and maintain standardized operational documentation, runbooks, and support playbooks.

- Participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution for hosted EUC environments.

Client Success & Advisory

- Serve as a trusted advisor to assigned customers.

- Collaborate with internal architects and client stakeholders to ensure platform integrity and alignment with SLAs.

- Present recommendations related to optimization, modernization, governance, and end user computing best practices.

- Support onboarding of new managed services clients.

- Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior engineers and technicians.

Platform Health & Optimization

- Analyze session performance, capacity, and Azure consumption trends across EUC workloads.

- Identify opportunities to reduce hosting cost through right-sizing, autoscaling, and image optimization.

- Recommend governance improvements and configuration standardization across client environments.

- Participate in customer optimization and modernization initiatives.

Requirements

 Experience

- 5+ years of supporting Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops or Azure Virtual Desktop in a managed services or enterprise environment.

- 4+ years of administering production virtual desktop environments, including Machine Catalogs, Delivery Groups, and image management.

- Experience supporting multiple client environments simultaneously.

- Exposure to ITSM ticketing tools such as ServiceNow or Remedy, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues independently and communicate clearly with customers.

 Technical Expertise

 • Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops

 • Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)

 • Citrix Studio, Director, and Citrix Policy

 • Nerdio Manager for Enterprise

 • Citrix Gateway (NetScaler)

 • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Packer)

 • Group Policy, Active Directory, and Windows internals

 • PowerShell automation

 • Azure Resource Manager and virtual networking

 • Thin client and endpoint management (Stratodesk, IGEL, Unicon)

 Preferred Certifications

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty (AZ-140)

- Citrix Certified Associate – Virtualization (CCA-V)

- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate

 Desired Characteristics

- Strong customer-facing communication skills

- Consultative mindset

- Sense of ownership and accountability

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively

- Strong documentation skills

- Passion for learning and adopting emerging Microsoft, Citrix, and automation technologies

- Commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement

 Success Metrics

 Client Experience

- Client satisfaction and trusted-advisor impact

 Service Delivery

- SLA adherence and effective escalation support

 Technical Quality

- Incident resolution quality and preventive improvements

 Automation

- Adoption of repeatable automation and Infrastructure as Code

 This role is designed as an L3/L4 EUC Support Engineer / End User Computing Operations Engineer, combining advanced technical support with managed services delivery, project execution, client advisory, automation, governance, and platform optimization.

You'll work across the entire technology stack—from device firmware to cloud-scale data processing. Your solutions will handle billions of records in AWS while maintaining Amazon's high security standards. You'll collaborate with engineers across Amazon to continuously raise the security bar and enable Customer Service to introduce innovative customer experiences.
You'll play a critical role in every interaction where Customer Service operations personnel access and handle customer data. This includes securing how associates view customer information, how data moves across the network, and how we protect customer trust at every touchpoint.

Key job responsibilities
You will own the design, implementation, and operation of systems and infrastructure that secure Customer Service endpoints. You will dive deep into complex technical problems—debugging issues across operating systems, networking layers, and cloud services—and deliver solutions that are both secure and reliable at scale.
You will define and execute on technical solutions that deliver value to our customers quickly and sustainably. You will contribute to technical planning, identify opportunities to improve our systems, and drive projects from design through deployment. You will spend your time writing code, building automation, and operating the systems that keep Customer Service secure. You will troubleshoot production issues, conduct code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions. On a regular basis, you will collaborate with your team to tackle the biggest technical challenges and participate in operational reviews to ensure our systems meet their availability and security goals.

We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

 ABOUT THE ROLE:

Radiant is seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to own the systems that keep the company running day-to-day within Microsoft 365 GCC High. You'll own the tenant, build our identity and access automation from the ground up in an Entra-native environment with no on-prem Active Directory or Group Policy, and manage the endpoint, email security, and SaaS infrastructure the business runs on. You'll implement and evidence the technical controls behind our CMMC assessment as part of the normal job, not a detour. This is a high-ownership seat in an interdisciplinary environment, advancing milestones toward commercializing the first mass-produced nuclear reactor.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

 - Own Microsoft 365 GCC High: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and the tenant configuration underneath them; be the authority on what's possible in this cloud and what has to be built in-house

 - Own Entra end-to-end: conditional access, privileged access, app registrations, and single sign-on

 - Build the IAM automation layer, the centerpiece of the role: joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle, entitlements driven by HR data, provisioning through Graph and SCIM, and access reviews that run themselves

 - Own Windows and endpoint management through Intune, Autopilot, compliance policy, and update rings across the fleet, with no Group Policy underneath

 - Own email security and information protection: Defender for Office, mail flow and anti-phishing posture, and Purview for DLP, labeling, and retention in an environment handling CUI

 - Own SaaS administration and integration across the business application portfolio, including Box and Slack; some running today, some a project waiting for an owner

 - Own the workloads, services, and licensing infrastructure running in AWS, in constant contact with the IT DevOps engineer who owns the account layer

 - Take new platform projects from idea to deployed, integrated, and documented

 - Implement and evidence the technical controls in these areas for the CMMC assessment ahead, as normal work rather than a detour

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

 - Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a similar field (4 years of work experience in lieu of a degree)

 - 7+ years administering and engineering production systems

 - Deep, hands-on experience across the responsibilities above: GCC High tenant administration, Entra, self-built IAM automation, Intune without Group Policy, email security and Purview, and SaaS/AWS administration

 - Solid networking fundamentals: VLANs, routing, firewall policy, DNS/DHCP, VPN, wireless

 - Treats compliance control implementation and evidence collection as normal work

 - Service is the job; tier-1 handles day-to-day support, but nobody's too senior to help the person at their desk

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:

 - Purview depth: DLP, sensitivity labeling, retention, or eDiscovery

 - CMMC or NIST 800-171 exposure; leading an assessment is not required

 - Stood up identity governance tooling: Entra ID Governance, SailPoint, Okta Workflows, or equivalent

 - Automation experience with PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, or similar)

 - Written and maintained PowerShell modules other people use, not just scripts

 - Deployed Box, Slack, or comparable platforms into a regulated environment and handled the data boundary questions

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

 - Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

 - Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

 - One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

 - Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

 - Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

 - Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

 - 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

 - Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

 - Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

 - Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

 - Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The 13,000 people of our global, fifth-generation family company are committed to making the world a better place today and for future generations.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Associate Manager, Modern Endpoint Engineer, you will drive modernization and technical direction for a highly visible endpoint platform, ensuring solutions meet business needs while balancing security, supportability, and end-user experience. This role also owns key architecture deliverables within the Endpoint space.

The role combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with accountability for architecture governance, operating model discipline, and design quality—ensuring solutions are scalable, aligned to standards, and consistently executed.

You will partner closely with the Endpoint Manager and engineering team to drive roadmap alignment, solution design, and execution across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

This role works cross-functionally—particularly with InfoSec (GIS)—to integrate modern deployment solutions and cloud-first strategies, supporting project delivery, M&A activity, and ongoing operational needs.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

-
Lead endpoint solutioning across Windows, macOS, and mobile, combining hands-on engineering expertise with conceptual and logical architecture design

-
Define and enforce endpoint architecture governance, including standards, templates, checklists, policies, and quality frameworks

-
Define and manage endpoint roadmap, including feature prioritization, vendor insights, roadmap cadence, and improvement of project submission and resource estimation quality

-
Partner with engineering teams to validate feasibility, guide PoCs, and ensure solutions align with architecture standards and enterprise design expectations

-
Develop and maintain deep expertise in the endpoint ecosystem, including hardware, OS, applications, security, and end-user experience considerations

-
Set and monitor MSP standards, SLAs/XLAs, and performance metrics while ensuring adherence to security policies and infrastructure management processes

-

University Degree and 5+ years of relevant experience

Strong understanding of Modern Device Management concepts, the Digital Workspace Industry direction, Enterprise sized Endpoint ecosystem use cases, including Windows OS, Mac OS, and Mobile concepts.

Minimum 2 years of demonstrated experience in two or more of the following:

Administration, configuration and design for Modern Endpoint Management (Microsoft Intune, JAMF)

Experience working with at least two of the following: Active Directory, Microsoft Azure AD, SCCM, GPO, or CPC

-
Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship for full-time employment.

Full Time- regular schedule for corporate

jobs.description:
About Zipline
 Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.
 Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.
 Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.
 We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.
 About You and The Role
 As an ML Training & Inference Infrastructure Engineer on the Data Platform team you will be building and scaling the systems powering our data flywheel. This person will work at the intersection of autonomy and the infrastructure, owning systems that make ML development faster, reproducible, observable, and safe.
 This role is for a strong software engineer who enjoys the full ML development cycle: data ingestion, processing pipelines, dataset management, distributed training, continuous model integration, evaluation, and deployment. The ideal candidate has strong production engineering habits and is excited to build infrastructure that helps real autonomous systems improve over time.
 What You'll Do

 Build and operate software infrastructure that enables learning algorithms to leverage Zipline’s large-scale (quickly growing!) fleet data.
 Design scalable, maintainable data and ML infrastructure for autonomy teams, including dataset creation, validation, training, evaluation, and deployment.
 Own and improve data pipelines that feed into the ML development loop.
 Identify and mitigate bottlenecks in the ML development cycle, especially around orchestration, performance, and reproducibility to increase the rate at which we can improve and scale the delivery experience.

 What You'll Bring

 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally including ML infrastructure, data infrastructure, robotics, autonomy, aerospace, medical devices, or another safety-critical hardware/product environment.
 Strong software engineering practices in Python in a production setting; comfort designing APIs, services, schemas, jobs, and operational workflows.
 Experience building reproducible data pipelines and machine-learning pipelines.
 Experience monitoring data statistics, system performance metrics, pipeline failures, and model/evaluation signals.
 Working knowledge of ML concepts such as datasets, training, evaluation, optimization, statistics, and modern deep learning workflows.
 Generalist mindset and willingness to work across cloud services, data platforms, developer tooling, and embedded/robotics-adjacent constraints.
 Experience with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks.
 Strong ownership, clear communication, and interest in building secure systems for mission-critical workflows.
 Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems for production workloads.
 Experience with cloud and on-premise production infrastructure, preferably AWS, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

 BONUS POINTS

 Experience deploying or evaluating ML systems on real robots, autonomous vehicles, drones, or other hardware products.
 Experience with large-scale training systems, feature stores, data/versioned artifact stores, model registries, or experiment tracking.
 Experience with annotation systems, dataset inspection tooling, or active-learning workflows.

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering (CPE) team delivers trusted devices at scale: secure by default, reliable by design, and effortless to use. We own platform capabilities across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, spanning endpoint posture and device trust, application delivery, onboarding, updates, telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. The team partners deeply with Security, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering groups to enable and protect OpenAI while reducing friction for the people advancing our mission.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager for CPE, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for the strategy, delivery, and operation of OpenAI’s cross-platform client foundation. You will combine people leadership with strong technical judgment: setting direction, developing engineers, reviewing architecture and tradeoffs, and creating the operating mechanisms that turn ambiguous needs into durable platform outcomes. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of security, reliability, developer velocity, and employee experience.

CPE is a highly technical platform engineering organization delivering first-party services, automation, observability, and safe fleet operations. We’re looking for a leader who can guide its next chapter, scaling the team and its systems, partnering across the company, and raising the bar for secure, reliable, low-friction experiences across every supported platform.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team; hire thoughtfully, coach engineers, create clarity, and foster an inclusive, high-accountability culture that pushes perceived limits.

 - Define and execute a multi-year client-platform strategy and roadmap across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, including how Codex and agents can reshape employee computing.

 - Provide technical direction for endpoint posture, device trust, application delivery, device onboarding, updates, fleet telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. Lead the team to rethink the platform from first principles as Codex and agent capabilities advance: what software needs to be built, what agents can own end to end, and which employee workflows no longer need to exist.

 - Guide architecture and engineering tradeoffs across first-party services, open-source tooling, SaaS platforms, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure. Decide what to build, buy, standardize, retire, or redesign as AI changes what the platform can do.

 - Establish clear goals, ownership, planning, design reviews, and execution rhythms that let the team move quickly without sacrificing quality.

 - Raise the bar for reliability and evidence-backed security through observability, drift detection, staged rollouts, release gates, rollback paths, incident learning, runbooks, and healthy operational ownership. Use telemetry to see friction, measure outcomes, and improve before issues become tickets.

 - Partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, Product, and specialized engineering teams to align priorities and land company-wide changes, dogfood OpenAI products in real employee workflows, and continuously improve internal platforms.

 - Balance strong security and compliance controls with developer velocity, employee experience, and operational simplicity. Define where agents can act, where humans approve, and how actions are evaluated, audited, and reversed.

 - Use adoption, reliability, evidence-backed security posture, data freshness, employee experience, workflow completion, friction, agent effectiveness, and operational-load metrics to steer investment and communicate impact.

 - Partner with IT and Security teams to compound CPE’s impact across employee experience, security posture, and operational scale.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

 - Built and led teams that owned secure, reliable, mission critical services and infrastructure at scale, from strategy through production operations.

 - Delivered internal platforms, tooling, and services that materially improved reliability, security, and employee experience.

 - Made sound software and infrastructure engineering decisions at scale. Deep endpoint expertise is strongly preferred.

 - Raised production readiness through direct technical review of architecture, automation, code, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational tradeoffs.

 - Operated infrastructure with material security or identity risk through staged rollouts, incidents, and decisions that balanced risk, compliance, and employee or developer experience.

 - Committed to joining the team’s engineering on call rotation after ramp up and using firsthand operational context to improve reliability and reduce toil.

 - Built inclusive teams that do excellent work, communicated with clarity and candor, and influenced partners across Security, IT, and Product/Engineering.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Deep experience with one or more client-platform tool ecosystems such as Jamf, Intune, Android Enterprise, FleetDM/osquery, Munki/AutoPkg, or Linux configuration management.

 - Experience building internal platforms or services for app delivery, device posture/trust, onboarding, notifications, workflow orchestration, or fleet telemetry.

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Terraform, Kubernetes/containers, service orchestration, and large-scale observability.

 - Experience partnering with security, compliance, or privacy teams in high-assurance environments.

 - Experience supporting research, developer, robotics, hardware-lab, or other specialized computing environments.

 - A record of contributing to open-source tooling, engineering communities, or cross-company technical standards.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT SECURITY ENGINEER - TOP SECRET CLEARANCE

 SpaceX is looking for an IT Security Engineer with deep knowledge and broad experience across enterprise security technologies, in addition to broader experience with identity, endpoint protection, SIEM, and vulnerability management. This employee will be a member of the Information Technology team and will support SpaceX personnel and systems on classified networks. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment. They should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess the ingenuity to excel at this position.

   RESPONSIBILITIES

- Work closely with o ther SpaceX IT administrators and engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support security solutions and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams. Build highly resilient, high-performance, scalable, and flexible systems.

- Take lessons learned and technology standards from the SpaceX Enterprise and apply them in smaller classified environments.

- Exercise a high degree of responsibility for the processes, systems, and tools you create and manage; all supporting the goal of making humanity an interplanetary species.

- Design, deploy, and operate security controls for classified corporate-style IT networks, including authentication and identity services (hardware tokens, certificate-based authentication, privileged access), on-premises SIEM for logging and detection, endpoint/host protection, and vulnerability management.

- Harden and secure traditional IT services used by engineering staff (email, file servers/shares, directory services, collaboration tools, and internal applications); review and improve permissions, group membership, and access models to reduce standing privilege.

- Partner with systems, network, and application owners to securely design, deploy, and operate applications (authentication/authorization, logging, patching, least privilege).

- Lead or support detection, triage, and incident response for the classified IT environment.

- Make recommendations, justify, and implement improvements using an accepted change control methodology .

- Work within a diverse group to design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner by interacting with internal business units.

- Define, document, and follow standards and best practices for systems design, testing, and implementation.

- Drive scripting and automation to develop solutions to common problems and repeatable security tasks (baselines, evidence collection, health checks).

       BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or another STEM discipline; OR 4+ years of professional experience in enterprise IT security engineering in lieu of a degree.

- 3+ years of hands-on experience securing traditional IT environments (identity/MFA, endpoint security, SIEM, vulnerability scanning, email or file services).

- Experience administering or operating at least two of the following: on-premises SIEM, enterprise EDR/AV, enterprise vulnerability management platform.

- Active Top Secret / SCI (TS/SCI) clearance.

       PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- Experience securing IT for engineering or corporate users in classified or restricted networks.

- Strong practical experience with hardware-token / FIDO2 / smart-card MFA and directory-integrated identity.

- SIEM administration or detection engineering experience (on-premises).

- Enterprise EDR/AV policy and operations experience.

- Enterprise vulnerability management and remediation workflows.

- Hardening Windows and Linux servers; securing file shares, email gateways, and internal applications.

- Permissions/access reviews, least privilege, and privilege-escalation reduction.

- SOC or blue-team incident response experience on enterprise IT estates.

- Scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ansible) for security operations.

- Familiarity with NIST 800-53 control families as implemented by IT security engineering.

- Excellent communication skills with IT systems engineers and engineering end users.

- Ability to work independently in a closed environment and deliver durable security operations.

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00
Level 2: $150,000.00 - $195,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:
